t1729116.movie_title_original: それいけ！アンパンマン　パンタンと約束の星
t1729116.synopsis:
映画『それいけ！アンパンマン パンタンと約束の星』で物語のキーワードは「約束」。本作で中心キャラクターとして登場するのは、新キャラクターであるレッサーパンダの旅人・パンタン。パンタンは、昔ある冒険家と交わした大切な約束を守るために、夜空に輝く虹の星にあるとされる宝物を探して大冒険をくり広げます！そして、宝物を探す旅の中で出会ったアンパンマン、クリームパンダら仲間たちと一緒に力を合わせて、次々と襲いかかる困難に立ち向かう！はたして、パンタンたちに一体、どんな冒険が待ち受けているのか？そして、宝物を手に入れることができるのか...？ハラハラドキドキのスリルあふれる壮大なストーリーを、お楽しみに！
遠い昔に、ある冒険家と交わした大切な約束を守るため、旅をしていたレッサーパンダのパンタン。しかし、旅の途中で、ばいきんまんの赤ちゃんスプレーを浴びて子どもの姿になってしまいました！ アンパンマンたちに助けられ、旅をする理由と大切な約束を破ってしまったという後悔の気持ちをみんなに話します。すると、「約束は守ろうとする気持ちが大事なんじゃないかな」とジャムおじさんに勇気づけられ『今度こそ約束を守る』と気持ちを新たにし、クリームパンダと一緒に虹の星を目指すことにします。クリームパンダは「絶対にあきらめない！」とパンタンと約束をして冒険の旅についてきますが、たくさんのピンチにくじけそうに。
そこへこっそり飛行機に乗り込んでいたばいきんまんたちも宝物を目当てにやってきて…。 何があっても絶対にあきらめない！と頑張るパンタンたち。 虹の星がもう一度輝いた時、約束の場所で見たものは…。
パンタンは今度こそ約束を守ることができるのでしょうか。 大切な約束と友情の物語―
t1729116.synopsis_en: The key word in the film 'Anpanman: Pantan and the Star of Promise' is 'promise.' The central character in this work is a new character, a red panda traveler named Pantan. Pantan embarks on a grand adventure to find a treasure said to be on the Rainbow Star shining in the night sky, in order to keep a precious promise made long ago with a certain adventurer! Along the way, Pantan meets Anpanman, Cream Panda, and other friends, and together they join forces to face one challenge after another! What kind of adventure awaits Pantan and the others? And will they be able to obtain the treasure...? Enjoy a thrilling, suspenseful, and epic story! Long ago, the red panda Pantan was traveling to keep a precious promise made with a certain adventurer. However, during the journey, he was hit by Baikinman's baby spray and turned into a child! Helped by Anpanman and the others, he tells everyone about the reason for his journey and his regret over breaking that important promise. Jam Uncle encourages him, saying, 'Isn't the important thing the feeling of wanting to keep a promise?' Renewing his resolve to 'keep the promise this time,' Pantan sets off for the Rainbow Star with Cream Panda. Cream Panda promises Pantan, 'I will never give up!' and joins the adventure, but is nearly discouraged by many crises. Meanwhile, Baikinman and his gang, who secretly boarded the plane, also come after the treasure... Pantan and the others keep trying, determined never to give up no matter what! When the Rainbow Star shines again, what they see at the promised place is... Can Pantan keep his promise this time? A story of precious promises and friendship.
t1729116.tmdb_overview_en: Anpanman saves Pantan, the old red panda. Pantan needs to fulfill his promise.

nハワの手習い.synopsis: アフガニスタン出身の女性ジャーナリスト、ナジーバ・ヌーリが監督を務め、幼少時に教育の機会を奪われ13歳で結婚させられた母ハワにカメラを向けたドキュメンタリー。 アフガニスタンの首都カーブルで、30歳上の認知症の夫を世話しながら暮らすハワ。結婚を強いられたときハワはまだ13歳で、父は幼い彼女を教育から遠ざけ、母は出産について何も助言してくれなかった。6人の子を産んだ彼女は、娘たちが同じ道に進まぬよう教育の機会を与え、次女ナジーバはジャーナリストとして自立した生活を送っている。母の味方になることを決意したナジーバは彼女にカメラを向け、夫の愚痴や秘密の恋、そして“やってみたかったこと”について話を聞く。ハワは民族手芸の商売と読み書きの学習を始めるが、ささやかな夢が動き出した矢先、長女の元夫と暮らす孫娘ザハラーが支配的な父のもとから逃れてくる。孫娘を引き取り一緒に読み書きを学ぶハワだったが、タリバンによる襲撃と占領は日ごとに進み、ザハラーと彼女を匿う家族にも命の危険が迫る。2021年8月にタリバンが復権すると、報道の自由を封殺する動きが強まり、ナジーバは兄アリーにカメラを託して母国を後にする。 山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2025にて市民賞を受賞したほか、世界各地の映画祭で多数の賞を受賞した。
nハワの手習い.synopsis_en: A documentary directed by Najiba Nouri, an Afghan female journalist, who turns the camera on her mother Hawa, who was denied education as a child and forced into marriage at age 13. Hawa lives in Kabul, the capital of Afghanistan, caring for her husband, who is 30 years older and has dementia. Hawa was only 13 when she was forced into marriage; her father kept her from education, and her mother gave her no advice about childbirth. After giving birth to six children, she ensured her daughters received education so they wouldn't follow the same path. Her second daughter, Najiba, lives independently as a journalist. Determined to support her mother, Najiba points the camera at her and listens to her complaints about her husband, secret love, and 'things she wanted to do.' Hawa starts a folk craft business and learns to read and write, but just as her modest dreams begin to take shape, her granddaughter Zahra, who lives with her eldest daughter's ex-husband, flees from her domineering father. Hawa takes in her granddaughter and learns to read and write with her, but Taliban attacks and occupation advance daily, putting Zahra and the family sheltering her in mortal danger. When the Taliban regained power in August 2021, moves to suppress press freedom intensified, and Najiba entrusted the camera to her brother Ali and left her homeland. The film won the Citizens' Prize at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2025 and numerous awards at film festivals worldwide.

nPEACOCK／ピーコック.director: ベルンハルト・ウェンガー
nPEACOCK／ピーコック.synopsis: 完璧な息子、教養ある恋人、デート中にヒーローになりたい人のためのチンピラ役――。マティアスはどんなシチュエーションもこなせる理想的な人物を提供する代理店「マイ・コンパニオン」のトップパフォーマー。求められる役割を完璧に演じ分け、日々さまざまな人格を生きている。しかし恋人ソフィアとの突然の別れやあるクライアントとの想定外の出来事をきっかけに、マティアスの歯車は少しずつ狂いはじめ、やがて現実と虚構の境界も曖昧になっていく...。
nPEACOCK／ピーコック.synopsis_en: The perfect son, a cultured lover, a thug for hire for those who want to play hero on a date—Matthias is the top performer at "My Companion," an agency that provides ideal personas for any situation. He flawlessly plays the roles demanded of him, living out various personalities every day. However, triggered by a sudden breakup with his girlfriend Sofia and an unexpected incident with a client, Matthias's gears begin to slowly grind out of alignment, and the boundary between reality and fiction gradually blurs...

t1151272.synopsis: 失踪した娘を捜すため砂漠のレイブパーティに参加した父と息子の旅の行方を、奇想天外なストーリーとクールなダンスミュージックを融合させて描き、本国スペインをはじめヨーロッパ各国で話題を集めたロードムービー。 ルイスは砂漠でのレイブパーティに参加したまま行方がわからなくなった娘を捜すため、息子エステバンとともにモロッコの山岳地帯から砂漠の奥地へと車を走らせる。やがて彼らは現実と幻覚が混濁するような野外レイブ会場にたどり着くが、そこにはすでに娘の姿はなかった。父子はレイブの参加者グループを追い、娘が向かったと思われる次のレイブ会場を目指すが……。 父ルイス役に「パンズ・ラビリンス」のセルジ・ロペス。「ファイアー・ウィル・カム」のオリベル・ラシェが監督・脚本を手がけ、製作にはスペインを代表する名匠ペドロ・アルモドバルが名を連ねた。タイトルの「シラート」はアラビア語で「道」を意味し、宗教的な意味においては審判の日に天国と地獄の上に架けられる細い橋を象徴するとされる。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、審査員賞など4冠に輝いた。第98回アカデミー賞では国際長編映画賞と音響賞にノミネート。
t1151272.synopsis_en: This road movie, blending a fantastical story with cool dance music, follows a father and son's journey through a desert rave party in search of a missing daughter, sparking buzz across Spain and Europe. Luis drives with his son Esteban from the Moroccan mountains deep into the desert to find his daughter, who disappeared after attending a desert rave. They reach an outdoor rave site where reality and hallucination blur, but she is not there. The father and son chase a group of ravers, heading to the next rave site where they believe she went. Sergi López ("Pan's Labyrinth") plays father Luis. Directed and written by Oliver Laxe ("Fire Will Come"), the film is produced by renowned Spanish master Pedro Almodóvar. The title "Siraat" means "path" in Arabic and, in a religious sense, symbolizes the narrow bridge over heaven and hell on Judgment Day. Screened in the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025, it won four awards including the Jury Prize. It was nominated for the Academy Awards for Best International Feature Film and Best Sound at the 98th Academy Awards.
t1151272.tmdb_overview_en: A man and his son arrive at a rave lost in the mountains of Morocco. They are looking for Marina, their daughter and sister, who disappeared months ago at another rave. Driven by fate, they decide to follow a group of ravers in search of one last party, in hopes Marina will be there.
t1151272.tmdb_overview_jp: 砂漠で行われるレイブパーティに参加したまま失踪した娘を探すため、父ルイスと息子エステバンは、モロッコの山岳地帯から砂漠の奥深くへと車を走らせる。行き着いたのは、現実と幻覚が混濁するような野外レイブのカオス。耳をつんざく重低音、赤い照明の海、沈黙を貫く父親の背中。だがそこにはすでに娘の姿はなく、父と息子は、レイブの参加者グループを追って、娘が向かったと思われる次のレイブ会場を目指すことになるが......。

nウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム.movie_title: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
nウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム.movie_title_jp: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
nウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム.director: パスカル・プリッソン
nウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム.synopsis: ハンディキャップを抱えながらも夢を抱き挑戦し続ける、5カ国・6人の子どもたちの姿を追ったドキュメンタリー。 フランスのモードは出生時に片足を切断せざるを得ず、重度の聴覚障がいも抱えながら、バレエや音楽に熱中している。ルワンダに暮らすサビエルは、アルビノであることで好奇のまなざしや身の危険を感じているが、医師になる夢を抱き熱心に勉強している。ネパールのニルマラとケンドはそれぞれ2015年の大地震で片足を失ったが、無二の親友として互いに支え合い、義足でダンスの練習に励む。生まれつき視覚障がいがあるケニアのチャールズは、同じく視覚障がいを持つ伝説のランナーに憧れ、長距離ランナーになる夢を抱く。ブラジルのアントニオは自閉症と注意欠如多動症、聴覚障がいを抱えているが、家族の深い愛情を受け、さまざまなことに興味を持つ。子どもの可能性を信じ、深い愛情とより良い教育環境を与えようと奮闘する親たち、友人として当たり前に手を差し伸べともに学び遊ぶ仲間たち、インクルーシブな支援を模索する教師や周囲の大人たち。子どもたちは身体的・社会的に直面する困難を、家族や仲間たちと共に乗り越えていく。 「世界の果ての通学路」のパスカル・プリッソン監督が、6人の子どもたちの日常や挑戦、家族や仲間たちとの関わりを丁寧に映し出す。
nウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム.synopsis_en: A documentary following the lives of six children in five countries who, despite their disabilities, continue to dream and take on challenges. In France, Maud, who had one leg amputated at birth and has severe hearing impairment, is passionate about ballet and music. Xavier, living in Rwanda, feels the stares of curiosity and danger because of his albinism, but dreams of becoming a doctor and studies diligently. In Nepal, Nirmala and Khendo each lost a leg in the 2015 earthquake, but as inseparable best friends, they support each other and practice dancing with prosthetic legs. Charles in Kenya, born with a visual impairment, admires a legendary runner who is also visually impaired and dreams of becoming a long-distance runner. Antonio in Brazil has autism, ADHD, and a hearing impairment, but receives deep love from his family and shows interest in various things. The film also portrays parents who believe in their children's potential and strive to give them deep love and a better educational environment, friends who naturally lend a hand and learn and play together, and teachers and other adults seeking inclusive support. The children overcome their physical and social difficulties together with their families and peers. Director Pascal Plisson, known for 'On the Way to School,' carefully captures the daily lives, challenges, and relationships of these six children with their families and friends.

nTHE BELDHAM ベルダム.director: アンジェラ・グルナー
nTHE BELDHAM ベルダム.synopsis: 幼い娘を連れて母親の家に滞在する女性が、そこに潜む不気味な存在に翻弄され狂気に陥っていく姿を描いたサイコロジカルホラー。脚本家としても活躍する俳優アンジェラ・ガルナーが長編初メガホンをとり、自身の家族との体験をもとに、母娘の関係性と愛情の機微から生じる恐怖を繊細に描き出す。 娘を出産したばかりのハーパーは、母親が売りに出そうとしている郊外の一軒家を訪れる。そこには母親のパートナーや、ホームヘルパーだという女性も暮らしていた。ハーパーも家の改修を手伝うためしばらく滞在することになるが、家の中で不気味な存在を感じ、娘に危険がおよぶことを恐れて平常心を保てなくなっていく。その様子を見かねた母親たちはハーパーから娘を強制的に引き離すが、不気味な存在は変わらずハーパーを悩ませ続け、精神的な不安定さは日ごとに増していく。娘を取り戻したい一心でその存在の正体を探る彼女は、やがて思わぬ真実にたどり着く。 Netflixドラマ「アッシャー家の崩壊」のケイティ・パーカーが主人公ハーパーを演じ、テレビドラマ「HEY!レイモンド」のパトリシア・ヒートン、「パーフェクト・トラップ」のエマ・フィッツパトリック、「メジャーリーグ」シリーズのコービン・バーンセンが共演。
nTHE BELDHAM ベルダム.synopsis_en: In the house she visits with her young daughter, an eerie presence lurks in the shadows. Her love for her child gradually drives her mad—. The director, Angela Garner, who has appeared in numerous works as an actress and has also blossomed as a screenwriter with works drawing attention for addressing her own experience with eating disorders, makes her feature directorial debut with this film. Known for works with autobiographical elements, she delicately portrays the horror born from the nuances of a mother-daughter relationship and love, based on her own family experiences. Katie Parker, from the Netflix series "The Fall of the House of Usher" and "The Haunting of Hill House," plays the protagonist Harper. She brilliantly portrays a woman desperately protecting her child from the eerie shadows lurking in the house while gradually being consumed by madness. The setting is a suburban house that Harper's mother is preparing to sell. An unidentified black shadow dwells there, but only Harper can perceive its presence... A small sense of unease eventually leads to a truth that overturns expectations. Are Harper's actions, threatened by the eerie presence, born of love? Or madness—? This unpredictable psychological horror accelerates the fear through its masterful story development, leading you to an unprecedented finale.

n気狂いピエロ PIERROT LE FOU.movie_title: 気狂いピエロ 　 PIERROT LE FOU
n気狂いピエロ PIERROT LE FOU.movie_title_jp: 気狂いピエロ 　 PIERROT LE FOU
n気狂いピエロ PIERROT LE FOU.director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
n気狂いピエロ PIERROT LE FOU.synopsis: 自由！挑発！疾走！目くるめく引用と色彩の氾濫。饒舌なポエジーと息苦しいほどのロマンチスム。ゴダールのミューズでありながらゴダールと離婚したばかりのカリーナ、『勝手にしやがれ』で大スターになりこの映画でゴダールと決別することになるベルモンド。各自がキャリアの臨界点で燃焼しつくした奇跡的傑作！ 【STORY】 フェルディナンは、金持ちの妻との生活に退屈し、逃げ出したい衝動に駆られていた。ある夜、夫婦がパーティに出かけるため、幼い娘のベビーシッターがやって来る。彼女はなんと、かつての恋人マリアンヌだった。パーティを抜け出し、1人で帰宅したフェルディナンは、彼女を車で送り、そのまま一夜を共にする。翌朝目覚めると、彼女の部屋に、首に鋏を突き立てられた男の死体が。驚く彼とは裏腹に、平然と朝食を作り歌うマリアンヌ。フェルディナンは、訳は後で話すという彼女と一緒に、着の身着のままでパリを後にし、マリアンヌの兄がいる南仏へ向かうが...。
n気狂いピエロ PIERROT LE FOU.synopsis_en: Freedom! Provocation! Headlong rush! A dizzying flood of quotations and colors. Loquacious poetry and suffocating romanticism. Karina, Godard's muse but recently divorced from him, and Belmondo, who became a huge star in 'Breathless' and would part ways with Godard through this film. A miraculous masterpiece where each burned out at the critical point of their careers! [STORY] Ferdinand is bored with his life with his wealthy wife and driven by an urge to escape. One night, a babysitter arrives for their young daughter as the couple heads to a party. She turns out to be his former lover, Marianne. Ferdinand slips out of the party, returns home alone, drives her home, and spends the night with her. Waking up the next morning, he finds a dead man with scissors stuck in his neck in her apartment. In contrast to his shock, Marianne calmly makes breakfast and sings. Ferdinand, leaving Paris with only the clothes on his back, follows her as she promises to explain later, heading to the south of France where her brother lives...

n【ジョン・ヒューストン特集】ワイズ・ブラ.movie_title: 【ジョン・ヒューストン特集】ワイズ・ブラ
n【ジョン・ヒューストン特集】ワイズ・ブラ.movie_title_jp: 【ジョン・ヒューストン特集】ワイズ・ブラ

t42179.director: ジョン・ヒューストン
t42179.synopsis: 「マルタの鷹」「黄金」「アフリカの女王」など数々の名作を残したアメリカ映画界の巨匠ジョン・ヒューストンが、1979年に手がけた長編作品。アメリカ南部文学の名作家フラナリー・オコナーの小説「賢い血」を映画化し、アメリカ南部特有の風土や精神性を鮮やかに描き出した異色のドラマ。 アメリカ陸軍を除隊した青年ヘイゼル・モーツが帰郷すると、実家には箪笥と墓標だけが残されていた。彼は見知らぬ街で「キリストのいない教会」の布教を始め、盲目の説教師やその娘、純朴な青年といった奇妙な人々と出会う。やがてヘイゼルは狂気と絶望に囚われていき……。 ヘイゼル役は「カッコーの巣の上で」でアカデミー助演男優賞にノミネートされたブラッド・ドゥーリフ。共演にエイミー・ライト、ハリー・ディーン・スタントン、ネッド・ビーティら。日本では劇場未公開だったが、2026年にジョン・ヒューストン生誕120年を記念した特集上映「生誕120年　ジョン・ヒューストン特集」で劇場初公開される。
t42179.synopsis_en: A feature film directed in 1979 by John Huston, the master of American cinema who left behind numerous classics such as 'The Maltese Falcon,' 'The Treasure of the Sierra Madre,' and 'The African Queen.' An unconventional drama that adapts the novel 'Wise Blood' by Flannery O'Connor, a leading figure of Southern literature, vividly portraying the unique atmosphere and spirituality of the American South. When young Hazel Motes is discharged from the U.S. Army and returns home, he finds only a wardrobe and a tombstone left in his family home. In a strange city, he begins preaching the 'Church Without Christ' and encounters a motley cast of characters, including a blind preacher, his daughter, and a simple young man. Eventually, Hazel becomes consumed by madness and despair... Brad Dourif, nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for 'One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest,' plays Hazel. The cast also includes Amy Wright, Harry Dean Stanton, and Ned Beatty. Although it was never theatrically released in Japan, it will have its Japanese theatrical premiere in 2026 as part of the special screening series 'John Huston 120th Anniversary' commemorating the 120th anniversary of his birth.

t842924.synopsis: 作家スティーブン・キングが2020年に発表した短編小説「チャックの数奇な人生　イフ・イット・ブリーズ」を、「ドクター・スリープ」のマイク・フラナガン監督が映画化したヒューマンミステリー。 大規模な自然災害と人災が次々と地球を襲い、世界は終わりを迎えつつあった。インターネットもSNSもつながらないなか、街頭やテレビ、ラジオに突如として、「チャールズ・クランツに感謝します。素晴らしい39年間に、ありがとう、チャック」という謎の広告が大量に現れる。高校教師マーティーが元妻フェリシアに会うため家を飛び出すと、誰もいない街はチャックの広告で埋め尽くされていた。無事に出会えたマーティーとフェリシアが星々を眺めながら終末の到来を感じ、手を握り合っていると、場面は一転して広告の人物・チャックの視点に切り替わり、彼の人生をさかのぼる物語が美しい映像で紡がれていく。 「アベンジャーズ」シリーズのトム・ヒドルストンが主人公チャックを演じ、「それでも夜は明ける」のキウェテル・イジョフォー、「ガーディアンズ・オブ・ギャラクシー」シリーズのカレン・ギラン、「ワンダー　君は太陽」のジェイコブ・トレンブレイ、「スター・ウォーズ」シリーズのマーク・ハミルが共演。「ラ・ラ・ランド」の振付師マンディ・ムーアがダンスシーンの振り付けを担当。2024年・第49回トロント国際映画祭で最高賞にあたる観客賞を受賞。
t842924.synopsis_en: A human mystery film adaptation of Stephen King's 2020 short story "The Life of Chuck," directed by Mike Flanagan of "Doctor Sleep." As massive natural and man-made disasters strike the Earth one after another, the world is nearing its end. With no internet or social media, mysterious advertisements suddenly appear everywhere on street signs, TVs, and radios, reading: "Thanks to Charles Krantz. For 39 great years, thanks, Chuck." When high school teacher Marty rushes out of his house to see his ex-wife Felicia, the deserted city is filled with Chuck's ads. As Marty and Felicia, who have safely reunited, gaze at the stars, feeling the apocalypse approaching, and hold hands, the scene shifts to the perspective of the man in the ads, Chuck, and a story tracing his life unfolds through beautiful imagery. Tom Hiddleston of the "Avengers" series plays the protagonist Chuck, with Chiwetel Ejiofor of "12 Years a Slave," Karen Gillan of the "Guardians of the Galaxy" series, Jacob Tremblay of "Wonder," and Mark Hamill of the "Star Wars" series co-starring. Mandy Moore, choreographer of "La La Land," choreographs the dance scenes. It won the Audience Award, the top prize, at the 2024 Toronto International Film Festival.
t842924.tmdb_overview_en: In this extraordinary story of an ordinary man, Charles 'Chuck' Krantz experiences the wonder of love, the heartbreak of loss, and the multitudes contained in all of us.

t1015079.movie_title: 血を吸うスマトラオオコンニャク
t1015079.movie_title_jp: 血を吸うスマトラオオコンニャク
t1015079.synopsis: イスラム教の悪霊祓いと、東南アジアに生息する世界最大級の花「スマトラオオコンニャク」を題材に、母から受け継いだ霊能力を持つ祓魔師見習いの少年が、花に宿った禁忌の呪詛と対決するさまを描いたマレーシア発のゴアホラー。 イスラム教徒の祓魔師ノーマンのもとで育った息子イクバルは、母ディナから受け継いだ類まれな霊能力の持ち主だった。ある時、その力の強さゆえに狙われたイクバルをかばい、ディナは悪霊に憑り殺されてしまう。自らの強すぎる力を恨む息子を案じた父ノーマンは、彼の力の一部を封印する。だが、傷ついた家族のもとには「死体花」の呪詛がもたらす惨劇が次々と這い寄ってくる。 CGに頼らず特殊メイクやSFXを駆使し、往年の特撮怪奇映画を思わせる作風で、シッチェス・カタロニア国際映画祭など各国のファンタ系映画祭で注目を集めた。
t1015079.synopsis_en: Set in Malaysia, this demon-combining exorcism gore horror film takes on the Islamic exorcism rites of the state religion and Southeast Asia's most enigmatic flower, the titan arum. A boy apprentice exorcist, who inherited spiritual powers from his mother, engages in a deadly struggle against the forbidden curse dwelling within the "corpse flower." Iqbal, raised under the wing of Norman, a Muslim exorcist, possesses rare spiritual abilities inherited from his mother Dina. One day, Dina is possessed and killed by an evil spirit while shielding Iqbal, who was targeted because of the strength of his powers. Grief-stricken, Iqbal resents his own overwhelming power, and his father Norman, worried about his son's future, seals away part of his abilities. Crawling toward the wounded family are a series of tragedies brought by the curse of the "corpse flower." Can Iqbal overcome his sorrow and exorcise a curse steeped in mystery and taboo?
t1015079.tmdb_overview_en: A young apprentice healer tries to suppress his supernatural abilities so he can fit in with the other kids, but when a malicious spirit breaks out in his apartment, he decides to use his abilities while dark family secrets are revealed.

t1683000.movie_title: トーキョーナイトフォール
t1683000.movie_title_jp: トーキョーナイトフォール
t1683000.clean_title_jp: トーキョーナイトフォール
t1683000.movie_title_original: トーキョーナイトフォール
t1683000.synopsis: 混沌とした東京の夜を舞台に、都会の片隅で孤独や行き場のない苦悩を抱えて生きる若者たちの姿を、ナイトクラブで行われる集団心中という過激な題材を取り上げながらも、繊細なまなざしで描き出すヒューマンドラマ。長編監督デビュー作「僕の中に咲く花火」で注目を集めた清水友翔が脚本・監督を手がけた。 青年・雨無（あめなし）の妹アンナは、高校生の時に同級生の自殺遺体を目にして以来、様子が変わり、やがて自らも命を絶ってしまう。アンナの死に責任を感じながら生きる雨無は、彼女の面影を追い続けていた。ある夜、東京のネオン街の片隅で密かに行われる集団心中イベントの存在を知り、引き寄せられるように会場のナイトクラブへと足を踏み入れる。親友の能津と服部は、雨無の行動を怪しみ、彼の後を追ってナイトクラブに潜入。絶望を抱えた若者たちが集う閉ざされた場所で、3人は脱出を試みるが、やがてそれぞれの胸の奥に抱えていた感情と向き合うことになる。 主人公の青年・雨無を安部伊織、妹アンナを葵うたのが演じ、ふたりは「僕の中に咲く花火」に続いて清水監督とのタッグとなった。そのほかの共演に田中光輔、廣中太河ら。さらにラッパーの漢 a.k.a. GAMIや梵頭、アイザックら多彩な顔ぶれが脇を固める。プロデューサーは「太秦ライムライト」の落合賢。
t1683000.synopsis_en: Set against the chaotic nightscape of Tokyo, this human drama delicately portrays young people living with loneliness and unspoken anguish on the fringes of the city, tackling the extreme subject of a mass suicide event held at a nightclub. Directed and written by Yuto Shimizu, who gained attention with his debut feature 'The Fireworks That Bloomed Inside Me.' A young man named Amenashi loses his sister Anna, who changed after witnessing a classmate's suicide in high school and later took her own life. Burdened by guilt over her death, Amenashi continues to chase her shadow. One night, he learns of a secret mass suicide event held in a corner of Tokyo's neon-lit streets and, drawn to it, steps into the nightclub venue. His friends Notsu and Hattori, suspicious of his actions, follow him and infiltrate the club. In this closed space filled with despairing youth, the three try to escape but are forced to confront the emotions buried deep within their hearts. Amenashi is played by Iori Abe, and his sister Anna by Utano Aoi, both reuniting with director Shimizu after 'The Fireworks That Bloomed Inside Me.' The cast also includes Kosuke Tanaka and Taiga Hironaka, with rappers Kan a.k.a. GAMI, Bontou, and Isaac among the diverse supporting roles. The producer is Ken Ochiai of 'Uzumasa Limelight.'
t1683000.tmdb_overview_en: A young man named Amenashi is haunted by the death of his younger sister Anna, who took her own life after witnessing a classmate’s suicide in high school. Burdened by guilt, he continues to chase her memory. One night, he learns of a secret mass suicide event held in a Tokyo nightclub and is drawn to it. His close friends, Nozu and Hattori, grow suspicious and follow him inside. In a closed-off space filled with despairing youths, the three attempt to escape, but are ultimately forced to confront the emotions they have each been carrying deep within.
t1683000.tmdb_overview_jp: 『それからアンナはおかしくなった。』 女子高生の頃に同級生の自殺遺体を見て以来、様子の変わったアンナの兄・雨無は、その後、自殺した妹・アンナの死因は自分にあるの ではないかと悩む日々を過ごしていた。とある晩に東京のネオン街の片隅で密かに行われる絶望した若者の心中を目的としたイベント。 自責の念に駆られた雨無は、アンナを失った後悔と共に夜のネオンの街へ姿を消してしまう。雨無の親友である服部と能津は、雨無の挙 動を怪しみ、イベントが行われるというナイトクラブへ侵入することを決める。東京の冷たい社会から虐げられた若者たちが心中を決意 する最後の空間で、脱出を試みる三人であったが、徐々に彼らの胸の奥に秘めていた感情が姿を現す。

t72592.movie_title: ハチミツとクローバー
t72592.movie_title_jp: ハチミツとクローバー
t72592.clean_title_jp: ハチミツとクローバー
t72592.movie_title_original: ハチミツとクローバー
t72592.synopsis: 羽海野チカの人気漫画を櫻井翔、蒼井優らの共演で実写映画化した青春群像劇。美術大学を舞台に5人の若者それぞれの片想いを描いた。 美術大学に通う竹本、森田、真山、あゆは、花本研究室で知り合った仲間。ある日、竹本は花本先生の親類で天才的な絵を描くはぐみと出会い、一瞬にして恋に落ちる。同じ寮に住む真山はアルバイト先の年上の女性に思いを寄せ、あゆはそんな真山に片想い。一方、天才肌で自信家の森田が大学に戻り、はぐみの才能に強く引かれていく。 竹本役を櫻井翔、はぐみ役を蒼井優、森田役を伊勢谷友介、真山役を加瀬亮、あゆ役を関めぐみが演じる。監督は「ライフカード」のCMなどで知られる人気CMディレクターの高田雅博。脚本は人気グループ「嵐」主演の映画「ピカ☆ンチ LIFE IS HARDだけどHAPPY」などを手がけた河原雅彦が、高田雅博と共同で手がけた。主題歌には「スピッツ」が本作のために書き下ろした「魔法のコトバ」、エンディングテーマにはスガシカオが楽曲提供した「嵐」の「アオゾラペダル」を起用。音楽は菅野よう子が担当した。2006年の公開から20周年を記念した2026年にリバイバル上映。
t72592.synopsis_en: Takemoto (Sakurai Sho), a student at Hama Art University, one day finds himself falling for Hagumi (Aoi Yu), a girl who paints with complete absorption. She is a transfer student rumored to be a prodigy and a relative of university professor Hanamoto (Sakai Masato). Takemoto cannot get Hagumi out of his head, but the presence of the extraordinary senior Morita (Iseya Yusuke), who also cares for her, stirs up Takemoto's feelings.
t72592.tmdb_overview_en: Adapted from the popular manga of the same name, director Masahiro Takada's coming of age drama follows five Hama Art College students as they prepare to venture out into the real world on a great voyage of self-discovery.
t72592.tmdb_overview_jp: 浜美大に通う竹本（櫻井翔）は、ある日、一心不乱に絵を描く少女・はぐみ（蒼井優）に恋心を抱く。彼女は大学の教授・花本（堺雅人）の親戚で、天才少女とうわさされる転入生だった。はぐみのことが頭から離れない竹本だったが、彼と同様にはぐみを気にかける非凡な先輩・森田（伊勢谷友介）の存在が竹本の恋心をかき乱す。

n軍服を着た神様.synopsis_en: A documentary exploring the mystery of "Japanese gods" found across Taiwan. In Taiwan, once a Japanese colony, there are over fifty locations where Japanese men in military uniforms are enshrined as deities. Cultural anthropologist Yohei Fujino and documentary filmmaker Kyo Endo spent six years, including the COVID-19 pandemic, traveling across Taiwan to visit these "Japanese gods." As they trace the mystery, the fact that each Japanese god truly existed as an individual human being comes to light, revealing their extraordinary fates, the nature of Taiwanese folk beliefs, and the lingering traces of war Japan left in Taiwan. Through the souls of Japanese people wandering in a foreign land after death, the Taiwanese who soothe these souls and enshrine them as gods, and the Japanese descendants who reconnect with their deified ancestors, the film portrays an unknown exchange between Japan and Taiwan born from the heart of mourning and honoring the dead. Directed by Kyo Endo, who specializes in folkloric motifs and won the 73rd Mainichi Film Award for Best Documentary for "Meguri Kagura." Music and animation are by Tetsutaro Take, a member of the music unit "Bakurocho Band" who also works as an artist.

t1688584.movie_title_original: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
t1688584.synopsis: 東京の上野公園を舞台に、1人の人間の生き方としての“失踪”に焦点を当てながら人と人とのつながりに迫った、日本・中国・韓国の合作によるヒューマンミステリー。 上野で「ゴージョー」と呼ばれていたホームレス男性が亡くなった。彼の本名も、生前に何をしていたのかも、なぜ公園のテントハウスにたどり着いたのかも知る者はいない。ソーシャルワーカーのサツキは、妻を亡くし公園で暮らすトシの助けを借り、ゴージョーが遺した日記を手がかりに彼の正体を求めてホームレスのネットワークを訪ね歩く。やがて1人の女性の存在が浮かび上がり、ゴージョーが自ら家族との縁を切ったという過去が判明する。それは、サツキの人生をも大きく揺るがす事実だった。 自らの生い立ちにとある喪失を抱えるソーシャルワーカーのサツキ役で門脇麦が主演を務め、サツキと行動をともにするホームレスのトシ役で竹中直人が共演。監督・脚本は、幼少期を日本で過ごしイギリスで映像制作を学んだワン・チイ。「スモーク」「ジョイ・ラック・クラブ」などの監督として知られるウェイン・ワンが共同脚本・企画に名を連ねた。
t1688584.synopsis_en: Set in Ueno Park in Tokyo, this human mystery, a Japan-China-Korea co-production, explores human connections while focusing on "disappearance" as a way of life. A homeless man known as "Gojo" in Ueno has died. No one knows his real name, what he did in life, or why he ended up in a tent in the park. Satsuki, a social worker, with the help of Toshi, a man living in the park after losing his wife, searches through the homeless network to uncover Gojo's identity, using his diary as a clue. Eventually, the existence of a woman comes to light, and it's revealed that Gojo had cut ties with his family. This fact also profoundly shakes Satsuki's own life. Kadowaki Mugi stars as Satsuki, a social worker carrying a certain loss from her own past, and Takenaka Naoto co-stars as Toshi, a homeless man who accompanies Satsuki. The director and screenwriter is Wang Qii, who spent his childhood in Japan and studied filmmaking in the UK. Wayne Wang, known for directing "Smoke" and "The Joy Luck Club," is credited as co-writer and project planner.
t1688584.tmdb_overview_en: In 2023, over 80,000 people went missing in Japan, with 30,000 dying alone. Ten percent remained unidentified, known as “muenbotoke” (buddhas without connections).  Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident. Guided by the diary, they embark on a journey into the past to uncover the man’s identity, which is deeply intertwined with Ueno’s post-war history. Along the way, they meet those whose lives the ghost touched, each revealing a story of a man who willingly cut ties with his family. Satsuki’s dreams and memories lead her astray, uncovering a bitter truth. Her search for answers about the vanished finds resolution in Toshi, who waits for the third reincarnation of his late wife.

t1275095.tmdb_overview_en: Can high school friendships last a lifetime ? One thing's for sure: before long, Aurore, Nours, Jeanne, Diane and the others will say goodbye to their boarding rooms, swimming in the Drôme and parties in the mountains. Louison will cut his dreads and the little family will break up. For some of them, it's not the first time, and it hurts even more.

t208837.synopsis: 「女っ気なし」などで注目されるフランスの若手監督ギョーム・ブラックが、年を重ね、先行きのない未来に苦悩する落ち目のミュージシャンが、やがて本当に愛することの意味を見出していく姿を描いた人生賛歌のドラマ。主演は、ブラック監督作品おなじみのバンサン・マケーニュ。いまや世間から忘れ去られようとしているミュージシャンのマクシムは、フランス・ブルゴーニュ地方の生まれ故郷の町トネールに戻ってくる。一人暮らしの父親クロードはアウトドアスポーツを楽しみ、女性関係も華やかで人生を謳歌しているが、都会での生活に疲れ果てたマクシムは生きる気力を失っていた。そんな折、地元情報誌の若い女性記者メロディがマクシムを取材にしにやってくる。その若さと笑顔にひかれたマクシムは、メロディと距離を縮めていくが……。
t208837.synopsis_en: A life-affirming drama by rising French director Guillaume Brac, known for 'A Summer's Tale,' depicting an aging, down-and-out musician struggling with a bleak future as he gradually discovers the true meaning of love. Starring Vincent Macaigne, a regular in Brac's films. Maxime, a musician now nearly forgotten by the world, returns to his hometown of Tonnerre in the Burgundy region of France. His single father Claude enjoys outdoor sports, has a vibrant love life, and revels in life, but Maxime, exhausted by city living, has lost his will to live. Then, a young female journalist named Mélodie from a local information magazine comes to interview Maxime. Drawn to her youth and smile, Maxime grows closer to her...
t208837.tmdb_overview_en: The story of Maxime, a 33-year-old musician, who has come to find refuge in his father’s home in the town of Tonnerre. There he will have the joy and the bad luck of meeting Mélodie, a 21-year-old girl trapped by her love for her childhood sweetheart. One and the other will not experience the same story at the same time, which will trigger a series of incidents.

t1418515.movie_title: メレディス・モンク　踊る声、歌う身体
t1418515.movie_title_jp: メレディス・モンク　踊る声、歌う身体
t1418515.clean_title_jp: メレディス・モンク 踊る声、歌う身体
t1418515.synopsis: ニューヨークに暮らす83歳の伝説的アーティスト、メレディス・モンクの創作と人生に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 ニューヨーク、トライベッカのロフトで亀と暮らす、三つ編みがトレードマークの女性メレディス・モンク。1942年11月20日に生まれニューヨークで育った彼女は、作曲家・歌手・演出家・振付家、そしてさまざまな音楽劇や映画、インスタレーションを手がけるパフォーマンスアーティストとして活躍し、多くのミュージシャンに影響を与えてきた。現代における芸術表現のパイオニアである彼女は、3オクターブ以上の声域の声を「楽器」ととらえ、ジャンルを超越したオリジナルな表現を追求し続けている。 映画では、メレディス・モンクの舞台やパフォーマンスを記録した豊富なアーカイブ映像に、モンクを敬愛するビョークやデビッド・バーンらのインタビュー映像を織り交ぜながら、彼女の60年にわたる活動の断片をコンセプトアルバムのようにつなぎ合わせ、その独創的な表現と人生を描く。1960年代の男性優位の社会で活動を始め、ときに批評家からの冷笑にさらされながらも自身の道を歩み続けた彼女の、強くしなやかでチャーミングな人物像を浮かび上がらせていく。
t1418515.synopsis_en: A documentary exploring the creative life of 83-year-old legendary New York-based artist Meredith Monk. Living in a TriBeCa loft with a turtle, the woman with trademark braids, Meredith Monk, was born on November 20, 1942, and raised in New York. She has worked as a composer, singer, director, choreographer, and performance artist creating various music-theatre works, films, and installations, influencing many musicians. A pioneer of contemporary artistic expression, she treats her voice—spanning over three octaves—as an instrument, continuously pursuing original, genre-transcending expression. The film weaves together extensive archival footage of Monk's stage and performance works with interviews from admirers like Björk and David Byrne, connecting fragments of her 60-year career like a concept album to depict her unique expression and life. It highlights her strong, resilient, and charming persona, having started her career in the male-dominated 1960s and continued her own path despite occasional critical scorn.
t1418515.tmdb_overview_en: Visionary composer and performer Meredith Monk overcame hostile critics to become one of the great artists of her time. In her seventh decade of creativity, she ponders how such singular work can continue without her.

nカニングハム.synopsis: ダンスの概念を根本から再定義したマース・カニングハムの生誕100周年を記念し、彼の活動の軌跡をたどったドキュメンタリー。 1930年代後半からアメリカで振付師・舞踊家として活躍したマース・カニングハムは、「音楽と振付は独立して存在する」という画期的な哲学や、偶然性を振付に取り入れる手法などにより、ダンスの新たな領域を切りひらくパフォーマンスで世界に衝撃を与えた。 本作では、未公開のアーカイブ映像を通してカニングハムの哲学や肉声に触れると共に、生涯のパートナーであった前衛音楽の巨匠ジョン・ケージや、ロバート・ラウシェンバーグ、アンディ・ウォーホルら20世紀を代表する芸術家たちとの協働の裏側に迫る。さらに、無名時代の1944年から名声を確立する1972年までの約30年間に生み出された14の代表作を、現代のダンサーたちが再演。ビルの屋上や森の中など規格外のロケーションで、空間と身体が躍動する様子を映し出す。日本では、特集上映企画「パフォーマンス・アート：身体と空間をめぐる映画祭」（2026年8月1日〜、ユーロスペースほか全国順次公開）にて劇場初公開。
nカニングハム.synopsis_en: A documentary commemorating the 100th anniversary of the birth of Merce Cunningham, who fundamentally redefined the concept of dance. Active as a choreographer and dancer in the United States from the late 1930s, Merce Cunningham shocked the world with performances that opened up new frontiers in dance, through his groundbreaking philosophy that 'music and choreography exist independently' and his incorporation of chance into choreography. The film explores Cunningham's philosophy and voice through never-before-seen archival footage, and delves into the behind-the-scenes collaborations with his lifelong partner, avant-garde music master John Cage, and 20th-century representative artists such as Robert Rauschenberg and Andy Warhol. Furthermore, 14 representative works created over approximately 30 years, from his unknown days in 1944 to his establishment of fame in 1972, are re-staged by contemporary dancers. It captures the dynamism of space and body in extraordinary locations such as building rooftops and forests. The film will have its first theatrical release in Japan as part of the special screening project 'Performance Art: A Film Festival Around Body and Space' (starting August 1, 2026, at Eurospace and other theaters nationwide).

nブレイキング・ザ・フレーム.movie_title: ブレイキング・ザ・フレーム
nブレイキング・ザ・フレーム.movie_title_jp: ブレイキング・ザ・フレーム
nブレイキング・ザ・フレーム.director: マリエル・ニトスラウスカ
nブレイキング・ザ・フレーム.synopsis: パフォーマンスアートやフェミニズムアートの先駆者として50年以上にわたって活動し、現代の身体芸術やジェンダー表現に多大な影響を与えたキャロリー・シュニーマンの生涯と芸術世界を、実験的アプローチで描いたポートレートドキュメンタリー。 抽象画家としてキャリアをスタートしたキャロリー・シュニーマンは、やがて自らの身体を素材として用いるようになり、1975年にフェミニズムアートにおける極めて重要で過激なパフォーマンス「Interior Scroll（体内の巻物）」を発表した。女性への身体的抑圧に抵抗する作品群は、男性優位の美術界で女性のセクシュアリティや肉体性を生々しく提示し、大きな衝撃を与えた。 本作では、シュニーマンの作品記録や絵日記、そして彼女自身が語る言葉を通して、タブーに挑み続けた彼女が感じていた孤独や怒り、作品への情熱を浮き彫りにしていく。特集上映企画「パフォーマンス・アート：身体と空間をめぐる映画祭」（2026年8月1日～、ユーロスペースほか全国順次公開）にて日本初公開。
nブレイキング・ザ・フレーム.synopsis_en: A portrait documentary that experimentally depicts the life and artistic world of Carolee Schneemann, who has been active for over 50 years as a pioneer of performance art and feminist art, greatly influencing contemporary body art and gender expression. Starting her career as an abstract painter, Carolee Schneemann eventually began using her own body as material, and in 1975 she presented the extremely important and radical feminist performance 'Interior Scroll'. Her works, which resisted physical oppression of women, vividly presented female sexuality and physicality in the male-dominated art world, causing a major shock. The film highlights the loneliness, anger, and passion for her work that Schneemann felt as she continuously challenged taboos, through her artwork records, illustrated diaries, and her own spoken words. The film will have its Japanese premiere as part of the special screening project 'Performance Art: A Film Festival Around Body and Space' (starting August 1, 2026, at Eurospace and other theaters nationwide).

t1637456.synopsis: 柄本佑が主演を務め、家族の記憶と記録をテーマに描いたドラマ。 東京で妻子と暮らす雄太は、足を骨折した義父・誠が回復するまで身の回りの世話をするため、九州の田舎町へやって来る。雄太は義父が営む昔ながらの写真館の仕事を手伝いながら、東京にいる妻と娘との間で、スマートフォンで撮った映像を交わす日々を過ごす。大きな事件は起こらなくても、日々の些細な出来事の記録と記憶の連なりに、家族の人生という長い時間が静かに、鮮やかに浮かび上がっていく。 父の世話を雄太に託して東京で仕事と子育てを続ける妻・ゆきを「SHOGUN 将軍」「少女邂逅」の穂志もえか、雄太との日々を言葉少なに過ごす義父・誠をイッセー尾形、家族の大切な記憶を象徴する人物を香椎由宇が演じる。京都造形芸術大学在学中から短編作品で注目を集め、卒業後は石井裕也監督作の助監督や土井裕泰監督作のメイキングカメラマンなどを務めてきた坂西未郁監督が長編初メガホンをとった。
t1637456.synopsis_en: Starring Tasuku Emoto, this drama explores themes of family memory and records. Yuta, who lives with his wife and daughter in Tokyo, travels to a rural town in Kyushu to care for his father-in-law Makoto, who has broken his leg, until he recovers. While helping out at Makoto's old-fashioned photo studio, Yuta exchanges videos taken on his smartphone with his wife and daughter back in Tokyo. Even without major events, the accumulation of daily trivial records and memories quietly and vividly reveals the long span of a family's life. Moka Kamishiraishi ("Shōgun," "Girl Encounters") plays Yuta's wife Yuki, who continues working and raising their child in Tokyo. Issey Ogata plays Makoto, the taciturn father-in-law, and Yū Kashii plays a character symbolizing precious family memories. Director Miu Sakanishi, who gained attention for short films while at Kyoto University of Art and Design and later worked as an assistant director for Yūya Ishii and a making-of cameraman for Yūichirō Doi, makes her feature-length directorial debut.
t1637456.tmdb_overview_jp: 雄太が九州の田舎町へとやって来たのは、足を骨折した義父が回復するまで身の回りの世話をするためだった。義父が営む昔ながらの写真館の仕事を手伝いながら、東京にいる妻と娘との間で、スマホで撮った映像を交わす。大きな事件は何も起こらないが、日々の些細な出来事と、その記録と記憶の連なりに、家族の人生という長い時間の存在が、静かに、鮮やかに浮かび上がってくる──。

t525894.synopsis: 「女っ気なし」「やさしい人」などのギョーム・ブラック監督が、パリ近郊の街セルジー・ポントワーズにあるレジャー施設「レジャー・アイランド」でのひと夏を切り取ったドキュメンタリー。 エリック・ロメール監督作「友だちの恋人」の舞台として知られ、ブラック監督自身も幼少時に頻繁に訪れたというレジャー・アイランド。バカンス客で溢れるその施設には派手なアトラクションは一切なく、水と緑の土地が広がっている。 美しい陽光が降りそそぐ中、施設に忍び込もうとする少年たちや、女性をナンパする青年たち、過去を懐かしむ老人、施設の管理や警備をする従業員たちなど、老若男女さまざまな人々の自然な姿を映し出していく。
t525894.synopsis_en: A documentary by Guillaume Brac, director of 'A Summer's Tale' and 'The Gentle Ones,' capturing a summer at the leisure facility 'Leisure Island' in Cergy-Pontoise, a suburb of Paris. Known as the setting for Éric Rohmer's 'My Girlfriend's Boyfriend,' and a place Brac himself frequently visited as a child, Leisure Island is filled with vacationers but has no flashy attractions, only expanses of water and greenery. Under beautiful sunlight, the film captures the natural moments of various people: boys trying to sneak into the facility, young men hitting on women, an elderly man reminiscing about the past, and employees managing and guarding the place.
t525894.tmdb_overview_en: A summer on an island of leisure in the Paris region. Land of Adventures, dredge and transgression for some, place of refuge and escape for the other. Its pay range to its hidden nooks, the exploration of a Kingdom of childhood, in resonance with the bustle of the world.

t1631314.synopsis: 「サマータイムマシン・ブルース」「リバー、流れないでよ」など数々の話題作で映画脚本を手がけてきた劇団「ヨーロッパ企画」代表の上田誠が長編初監督を務め、下北沢にある実在のビル「シェルボ下北沢」を舞台に斬新なギミックで描いた青春コメディ。 「シェルボ下北沢」の2階にある映画館・トリウッド。下北沢の劇作家・マドカと三軒茶屋のバンドマン・カズマはそれぞれ映画を見に行くが、互いの出来事が映画としてスクリーンに映し出されるという、ありえない構造が生まれてしまう。そんな中、映画館の両隣の店「グッドヘブンズ」と「三日月ロック」で問題が発生。マドカとカズマはこの構造を利用しながら問題の解決に挑むが、互いの映画は影響し合い、事態は予想外の方向へと展開していく。 劇作家のマドカ役で「サマーフィルムにのって」の伊藤万理華、バンドマンのカズマ役で「ミュジコフィリア」の井之脇海がそれぞれ主演を務め、マドカが主宰する劇団の団員役で前田旺志郎と菊池日菜子、カズマのバンドのメンバー役で金子鈴幸と三河悠冴、「三日月ロック」に出入りする半グレ役で今井隆文、刑事コンビ役でお笑いコンビ「ザ・ギース」が共演。さらに、石田剛太、金丸慎太郎、藤谷理子らヨーロッパ企画のメンバーが個性的なキャラクターたちを演じる。
t1631314.synopsis_en: A youth comedy directed by Makoto Ueda, head of the theater group "Europe Kikaku," known for writing screenplays for numerous hit films like "Summer Time Machine Blues" and "River, Don't Flow On." This is his feature directorial debut, set in the real-life building "Shelbo Shimokitazawa" in Shimokitazawa, employing innovative gimmicks. At the cinema Tollywood on the second floor of "Shelbo Shimokitazawa," Madoka, a playwright from Shimokitazawa, and Kazuma, a band musician from Sangenjaya, each go to see a movie. An impossible structure emerges where each other's events are projected onto the screen as a film. Meanwhile, problems arise at the shops adjacent to the cinema, "Good Heavens" and "Mikazuki Rock." Madoka and Kazuma try to solve the problems using this structure, but their films influence each other, and the situation spirals in unexpected directions. Starring Maria Ito ("Summer Film ni Notte") as Madoka the playwright and Kai Inowaki ("Musicophilia") as Kazuma the band musician. The cast also includes Oshiro Maeda and Hinako Kikuchi as members of Madoka's theater troupe, Suzuyuki Kaneko and Yusuke Mikawa as members of Kazuma's band, Takafumi Imai as a semi-delinquent who frequents "Mikazuki Rock," and the comedy duo "The Geese" as a pair of detectives. Additionally, members of Europe Kikaku, including Gota Ishida, Shintaro Kanamaru, and Riko Fujitani, play unique characters.
t1631314.tmdb_overview_en: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

n《シネマ歌舞伎》.synopsis: 歌舞伎舞踊の大曲「娘道成寺」を二人で踊る「二人道成寺」。玉三郎と八代目菊五郎の華やかな舞いに、映像ならではの工夫を加えた幻想美の世界。
n《シネマ歌舞伎》.synopsis_en: "Ninin Dojoji" is a performance of the grand Kabuki dance piece "Musume Dojoji" danced by two people. The brilliant dance of Tamasaburo and the eighth-generation Kikugoro is enhanced with cinematic techniques, creating a world of fantastical beauty.

t1379266.synopsis: 任侠の家に生まれながらも、歌舞伎役者として芸の道に人生を捧げた男の激動の人生を描いた人間ドラマ。日本映画界を席巻した話題作、ついに上映！
t1379266.synopsis_en: A human drama depicting the tumultuous life of a man born into a yakuza family who dedicates his life to the path of art as a Kabuki actor. A talked-about sensation that has taken the Japanese film world by storm, finally screening!
t1379266.tmdb_overview_en: Nagasaki, 1964: Following the death of his yakuza father, 15-year-old Kikuo is taken under the wing of a famous kabuki actor. Alongside Shunsuke, the actor’s only son, he decides to dedicate himself to this traditional form of theatre. For decades, the two young men grow and evolve together – and one will become the greatest Japanese master of the art of kabuki.
t1379266.tmdb_overview_jp: 後に国の宝となる男は、任侠の一門に生まれた。抗争で父を亡くした喜久雄（吉沢亮）は、上方歌舞伎の名門の当主・花井半二郎（渡辺謙）に引き取られ、歌舞伎の世界へ飛び込む。そこで、半二郎の実の息子として、生まれながらに将来を約束された御曹司・俊介（横浜流星）と出会う。正反対の血筋を受け継ぎ、生い立ちも才能も異なる2人は、ライバルとして互いに高め合い、芸に青春を捧げるが、多くの出会いと別れが運命の歯車を狂わせていく……。

t967941.movie_title: ウィキッド 永遠の約束＜字幕版＞
t967941.movie_title_jp: ウィキッド 永遠の約束
t967941.clean_title_jp: ウィキッド 永遠の約束
t967941.synopsis: オズの国に隠された真実を知り、それぞれの道を歩んだふたりの魔女は、もう一度かけがえのないかつての友と向き合う…。不朽のミュージカルの後編。
t967941.synopsis_en: Having learned the truth hidden in the land of Oz and walked their separate paths, two witches once again face their irreplaceable former friend. The second part of the timeless musical.
t967941.tmdb_overview_en: As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, Glinda and Elphaba will need to come together one final time. With their singular friendship now the fulcrum of their futures, they will need to truly see each other, with honesty and empathy, if they are to change themselves, and all of Oz, for good.

nロベール・ブレッソン傑作選.movie_title: ロベール・ブレッソン傑作選
nロベール・ブレッソン傑作選.movie_title_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン傑作選

t55847.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t55847.synopsis: フランスの巨匠ロベール・ブレッソンが、1969年製作の「やさしい女」に続き文豪ドストエフスキーの短編を翻案して描いたドラマ。 孤独な画家の青年ジャックは、理想の女性との出会いを妄想しては、その思いをテープレコーダーに吹き込んでいる。ある夜、ジャックはセーヌ河にかかる橋、ポン・ヌフで思いつめた表情の美しい女性マルトと出会う。マルトは恋した相手が1年前にアメリカ留学に発ち、「結婚できる身分になったら1年後に会おう」と言われていたが、1年が経ったその夜に相手は現れなかったのだという。マルトに熱い気持ちを抱いたジャックは、彼女が約束の相手に会えるように尽くすが、相手は現れない。そしてやがて、マルトの心もジャックに惹かれ始める。 舞台は原作の19世紀ペテルブルクから、撮影当時のパリに移されている。日本では1978年に劇場初公開され、2012年に35ミリニュープリント版が公開された。2025年、4Kレストア版でリバイバル公開。2026年にも、「ロベール・ブレッソン傑作選」にてリバイバル公開。
t55847.synopsis_en: Jacques, an aspiring painter, saves a young woman named Marthe from throwing herself into the Seine one night. She had a lover who left for America a year ago, and that very night was when they had promised to reunite. Jacques finds her, sunk in anguish, beautiful. Driven by a fierce impulse of love, he forces himself to remain calm, hoping her heart will drift away from her lover, while feeling guilt over this. Like the 1957 version, this is a modern adaptation of Dostoevsky's famous tragic love story, a poignant work revealing Bresson's awakened worldview. Visconti's romanticism is absent here; the young man's blind love is brutally exposed as he pours out his feelings into a mini tape recorder, a habit of his, making it painful to watch.
t55847.tmdb_overview_en: Jacques, a young man with artistic aspirations, spends four nights wandering Paris with a young woman, whom he rescued from suicide.
t55847.tmdb_overview_jp: 画家の卵であるジャックはある夜、セーヌに身投げしようとする少女マルトを助ける。彼女には一年前アメリカ留学に発った恋人がおり、二人が再会を約束したのがその晩だったのだ。青年は苦悶に沈む彼女を美しいと思った。そして、激しい愛の衝動につき動かされながら、努めて平静を装い、彼女の心が恋人から離れるのを望み、そこに罪悪感を覚える。'５７年版と同じく、有名なドストエフスキーの悲恋小説を現代を舞台に翻案した、ブレッソンの覚醒した世界観を窺わす痛烈な作品だ。ヴィスコンティのロマンチズムはここになく、青年の盲愛が、彼の習性である思いのたけをミニ・テレコに吹き込むという形で、露骨に顕わになる様が見ていく苦しいほどだ。 ＜allcinema＞

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t39951.synopsis: 東映動画初のSF長篇。黒田昌郎が単独で演出した最初の長篇でもあり、デザイン性の高い画面構成やミュージカル調の作風が、寓話性を帯びた世界観を際立たせる。メタ映画的な構造を取り入れる野心的な試みもなされ、東映動画における新世代の躍進を思わせる一作となった。ラストに明かされる王女の秘密には文明批判の意図が滲むが、これは動画スタッフだった宮崎駿の発案による。
t39951.synopsis_en: Toei Animation's first sci-fi feature. It is also the first feature-length film solely directed by Kuroda Yoshiro, whose highly designed compositions and musical style highlight the allegorical world. Ambitious meta-cinematic structures are employed, marking a breakthrough for a new generation at Toei Animation. The princess's secret revealed at the end carries a critique of civilization, an idea proposed by then-animator Hayao Miyazaki.
t39951.tmdb_overview_en: The story concerns a homeless boy named Ted. After seeing a movie about Gulliver he meets Professor Gulliver himself in a forest. Gulliver is now an elderly, space-traveling scientist. With Dr. Gulliver's assistant Crow, and Ted's companions, a talking dog and a toy soldier, they travel the Milky Way to the Planet of Blue Hope, which has been taken over by the Queen of Purple Planet and her evil group of robots. Armed with water-pistols and water balloons, which melt the villains, Ricky and Gulliver restore Blue Hope to its doll-like owners.
t39951.tmdb_overview_jp: 両親も住む家もない、貧しいが多くの夢を持つ少年のテッド。ある日科学者のガリバー博士と出会った彼は、博士と一緒にロケット「ガリバー号」に乗って宇宙探索へ行くことに!?希望の星を目指して旅する2人だったが、やっとたどりついた星には希望がなく…。

t314223.movie_title_en: The World of Hans Christian Andersen
t314223.synopsis: 「私の一生は一篇の童話であった」というアンデルセンの言葉から着想を得た音楽劇で、「赤い靴」や「親指姫」などの童話を織り交ぜながらアンデルセンの少年時代を描く。夜空には色とりどりの星が輝き、オーケストラの音色が物語を包む。小山礼司の美術と宇野誠一郎の音楽が、メルヘンの世界を甘美に表現している。
t314223.synopsis_en: Inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's words, 'My life is a fairy tale,' this musical drama weaves together tales like 'The Red Shoes' and 'Thumbelina' while depicting Andersen's boyhood. The night sky sparkles with colorful stars, and the orchestra's melodies envelop the story. The art by Reiji Koyama and the music by Seiichiro Uno sweetly bring this fairy-tale world to life.
t314223.tmdb_overview_en: During his boyhood, young Hans Christian Andersen is exposed to the musical fairy-tale dream world by his Uncle Ole.
t314223.tmdb_overview_jp: 童話作家になるのが夢のハンス少年のもとに、眠りの精オーレおじさん（Ole）がやってくる。アンデルセン童話の有名な「マッチ売りの少女」や、「親指姫」、「赤い靴」などのエピソードを織り交ぜて、ミュージカル仕立てのストーリーは展開する。

t1694409.synopsis: 死神が営む不思議な美容室を舞台に、死ぬまでの数日間をその美容室で過ごすことになった女性が、さまざまな出会いと別れを通じて自分の人生を見つめ直していく姿を描いたヒューマンファンタジー。日本大学藝術学部の授業の課題で提出された梅木陽一の企画書を原案に、「この動画は再生できません THE MOVIE」の谷口恒平が脚本を執筆し、「れいこいるか」などのいまおかしんじ監督がメガホンをとった。 職場でもプライベートでもうまくいかず苛立ちを募らせていた美容師の佐伯美帆は、階段で足を滑らせてしまう。目を覚ました彼女は新米の死神・サクマに連れられ、怪しい美容室「冥供愛富（メイクアップ）」にたどり着く。そこは、死神美容師たちが亡くなった人間にお色直しを施し、現世にいる家族や大切な人を1日だけつなぐことで「最期の別れ」を手助けする場所だった。しかし美帆の本当の死は数日後で、彼女を連れてきたのはサクマの早とちりであったことが判明。美帆は死を迎えるまでの間、冥供愛富で過ごすことになる。 桜井日奈子が美帆役、ダンス＆ボーカルグループ「STARGLOW」の日穏（KANON）がサクマ役で主演を務め、冥供愛富のオーナー役でお笑いトリオ「ハナコ」の岡部大、美帆の恋人役で平井亜門、美帆が働くヘアサロンの店長役で猪塚健太、美帆の母役で美保純が共演。
t1694409.synopsis_en: A human fantasy set in a mysterious beauty salon run by Death, where a woman who must spend her final days there reexamines her life through various encounters and farewells. Based on a proposal by Yoichi Umeki submitted for a Nihon University College of Art class assignment, with a screenplay by Kohei Taniguchi ('This Video Cannot Be Played THE MOVIE') and directed by Shinji Imaoka ('Reiko Iruka'). Hairdresser Miho Saeki, frustrated by troubles at work and in her private life, slips on stairs. Waking up, she is led by rookie Death Sakuma to a suspicious salon 'Meikup' (Makeup), where Death hairdressers touch up the deceased to connect them with loved ones for one last day. However, Miho's actual death is days away, and Sakuma jumped the gun. She stays at the salon until her death. Hinako Sakurai plays Miho, KANON from dance & vocal group STARGLOW plays Sakuma. Okabe Dai (comedy trio Hanako) plays the salon owner, Hirai Amon plays Miho's boyfriend, Inuzuka Kenta plays her salon manager, and Miho Jun plays her mother.
t1694409.tmdb_overview_en: A hairdresser who is increasingly frustrated with things not going well slips on the stairs. When she wakes up, she is led by a rookie grim reaper to a mysterious beauty salon, where grim reaper hairdressers give makeovers to the deceased to help them in their final goodbyes.
t1694409.tmdb_overview_jp: 職場でもプライベートでもうまくいかず苛立ちを募らせていた美容師の佐伯美帆は、階段で足を滑らせてしまう。目を覚ました彼女は新米の死神・サクマに連れられ、怪しい美容室「冥供愛富（メイクアップ）」にたどり着く。そこは、死神美容師たちが亡くなった人間にお色直しを施し、現世にいる家族や大切な人を1日だけつなぐことで「最期の別れ」を手助けする場所だった。しかし美帆の本当の死は数日後で、彼女を連れてきたのはサクマの早とちりであったことが判明。美帆は死を迎えるまでの間、冥供愛富で過ごすことになる。

t1364904.movie_title: ユースフル・ゴースト
t1364904.movie_title_jp: ユースフル・ゴースト
t1364904.clean_title_jp: ユースフル・ゴースト
t1364904.movie_title_original: ผีใช้ได้ค่ะ
t1364904.director: ラッチャプーム・ブンバンチャーチョーク
t1364904.synopsis: 愛する妻を亡くした男性と、掃除機に宿って彼のもとへ戻った妻が繰り広げる壮大な愛と抵抗の物語を描いた、タイ発の奇想天外なホラー映画。死後も現世にとどまり夫との愛を深めた女性メー・ナークにまつわるタイの怪談「メー・ナーク・プラカノーン」に着想を得て、記憶と忘却、個人と社会、愛と有用性といったテーマを盛り込みつつ、コメディ、ロマンス、ホラー、SFなどさまざまなジャンルを横断して描く。 粉じん公害が深刻化するバンコク。最愛の妻ナットを呼吸器疾患で亡くしたマーチは、悲嘆に暮れる日々を過ごしていた。そんな彼のもとにナットの魂が掃除機の姿を借りて舞い戻り、ふたりは再び愛を確かめ合う。その頃、マーチの家族が経営する工場では、死亡した従業員の霊が機械に取り憑き、操業停止を余儀なくされていた。霊に悩まされる家族や社会から拒絶されたナットは、工場の除霊に協力することで、自分が“役に立つ幽霊”であることを証明しようとする。 同じくメー・ナークの怪談を描いた「愛しのゴースト」でメー・ナーク役を務めたダビカ・ホーンが主演を務め、掃除機に宿る幽霊という難役を演じた。監督・脚本は、本作が長編デビューとなるタイの新鋭ラッチャプーム・ブンバンチャーチョーク。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭の批評家週間にてグランプリを受賞。
t1364904.synopsis_en: In Bangkok, Thailand, where dust pollution is severe, March (Wisarut Himmarat) spends his days in grief after losing his beloved wife Nat (Davika Hoorne) to a respiratory disease. One day, Nat's soul returns, inhabiting a vacuum cleaner, and the two reaffirm their love. Meanwhile, at the factory run by March's family, the spirit of a deceased employee possesses the machinery, bringing operations to a halt. Rejected by family troubled by the spirit and by society, Nat tries to prove her true love for her husband and her own existence as a 'useful ghost' by helping with the factory's exorcism...
t1364904.tmdb_overview_en: Worried about her husband being allergic to dust, Nat, a recently-dead woman, returns as a ghost possessing a vacuum cleaner to clean the house and protect her family from other vengeful ghosts in the house. To become a useful ghost, she needs to get rid of the useless ones.

t108071.tmdb_overview_en: On August 9, 1945, the Americans dropped an atomic bomb on Nagasaki. This film, based on a story by Mitsukaru Inoue, describes the daily life of people in Nagasaki the day before that fateful event. It presents the human drama of people's lives, and their feelings of joy and sadness. These include a newlywed couple, an expectant mother, and lovers who must say farewell because the boy is called to serve in the army. Each of these people, like others in the city, hoped to live with their dreams for ‘tomorrow’. But tomorrow never comes for them, as their lives are brought to an abrupt and unexpected end. Knowing how the story ends, in this case, doesn't detract from it at all; rather, it enhances the emotional impact, which is further heightened by the poignant musical score from Teizo Matsumura. 'Ashita' is the first film in Kazuo Kuroki's 'War Requiem Trilogy,' which also includes 'Utsukushii Natsu Kirishima' (2002) and 'Chichi to Kuraseba' (2004).

t108078.synopsis_en: Three years after losing her family and friends in the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, Mitsue lives alone. Suddenly, her father, who should have died, appears before her. She tells him about a young man she met at the library where she works.
t108078.tmdb_overview_en: Based on a play by Hisashi Inoue, it focuses on the sufferings of the survivors of Hiroshima. The film takes place during 4 days in the summer of 1948, as the ghost of her father visits Mitsué (Rié Miyama). He had somehow learned that she has fallen in love, and tries to convince her to start her new life. But Mitsué obstinately refuses his warm and humorous encouragements : « People were killed in my place. I do not have the right to find happiness », she says.
t108078.tmdb_overview_jp: 3年前広島に落とされた原爆で家族や友を失い、一人暮らしをする美津江の前に、突然亡くなったはずの父が現れる。彼女は父に勤務先の図書館で会った青年の話をする。

t1005251.synopsis_en: A courtroom dark thriller based on the real 'Parents Murder and Dismemberment Case' that occurred in Tai Kok Tsui, Hong Kong in March 2013, and the subsequent trial. Henry Chong, a young man with deep resentment towards his parents, conspires with his friend Angus Tong to murder them, dismembering and disposing of their bodies. The two are soon arrested, and the crime seems certain, but when the trial begins, Angus denies the murder, testifying that Henry killed his parents and that he was threatened into dismembering the bodies. Henry, on the other hand, insists they killed them together, directly contradicting Angus's testimony. As everything begins to unravel, the trial descends into a labyrinth, with intense battles between defense and prosecution, and the jurors' ethics and emotions sway, until the time for the verdict arrives. The actual trial concluded in 2015, and the perpetrator is serving time. The film depicts this case, which is said to still hold lingering mysteries about whether the verdict was correct. Due to some graphic depictions, it received an R18 rating in Hong Kong (R15+ in Japan) but was a huge hit. It garnered attention, winning Best Actor at the Hong Kong International Film Festival and Best New Director and Best Editing at the Hong Kong Film Awards.
t1005251.tmdb_overview_en: Adapted from a sensational real-life case in 2013, the intricate story begins when a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, the defense attorneys soon turn on each other, as the defendants play the devil and idiot game. Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

t543504.synopsis: 「バーニング・ダウン　爆発都市」のラウ・チンワンが主演を務め、中国で大ヒットを記録したサスペンスアクション。かつて「神探」（神の捜査官）と呼ばれた元刑事が、香港を震撼させる連続殺人事件に挑む姿を描く。 ジョニー・トーとワイ・カーファイが共同監督を務めた2007年製作の映画「MAD探偵 7人の容疑者」の後日談的作品で、本作ではカーファイ監督が単独でメガホンをとった。2023年・第41回香港電影金像奨で監督賞・主演男優賞・脚本賞・撮影賞を受賞。2022年・第35回東京国際映画祭でもガラ・セレクション部門で上映された。 ヒューマントラストシネマ渋谷＆シネ・リーブル梅田で開催の「未体験ゾーンの映画たち2024」上映作品。
t543504.synopsis_en: A suspense action film starring Lau Ching-wan of 'Burning Down' fame, which was a huge hit in China. It depicts a former detective once called the 'God of Detectives' taking on a series of murders that shocks Hong Kong. A sequel to the 2007 film 'Mad Detective' co-directed by Johnnie To and Wai Ka-fai, this installment is directed solely by Wai Ka-fai. It won awards for Best Director, Best Actor, Best Screenplay, and Best Cinematography at the 41st Hong Kong Film Awards in 2023. It was also screened in the Gala Selection section at the 35th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2022. Screened at the 'Unseen Zone Films 2024' event held at Human Trust Cinema Shibuya and Cine Libre Umeda.
t543504.tmdb_overview_en: When Hong Kong is rocked by multiple gruesome murders, the police forms a task force to investigate.

t18311.synopsis: ウォン・カーウァイ監督が1990年に手がけた長編第2作で、1960年代の香港で若者たちが織り成す恋愛模様を疾走感あふれる映像美で描き、カーウァイ監督の名を一躍世界に知らしめた青春群像劇。 ヨディはサッカー場で売り子をしていたスーに声をかけ、ふたりは恋に落ちる。しかしヨディは、自分が実の母親を知らないことに複雑な思いを抱えていた。スーと別れたヨディは、ナイトクラブでダンサーとして働くミミと一夜をともにする。部屋を出たミミはヨディの親友サブと出くわし、サブは彼女に一目ぼれする。夜間巡回中の警官タイドはスーに思いを寄せるが、スーはヨディのことを忘れられずにいた。キャストにはレスリー・チャン、マギー・チャン、カリーナ・ラウ、トニー・レオン、アンディ・ラウ、ジャッキー・チュンら香港映画界を代表する人気スターが集結。 日本初公開は92年。2018年2月、Bunkamuraル・シネマほかにてデジタルリマスター版が公開。2023年12月、特集上映「ウォン・カーウァイ　ザ・ビギニング」にて4Kレストア版が公開。
t18311.synopsis_en: Director Wong Kar-wai's second feature film from 1990, this youth ensemble drama depicts the romantic entanglements of young people in 1960s Hong Kong with a sense of rushing visual beauty, catapulting Wong Kar-wai to international fame. Yuddy approaches Su, who works as a vendor at a soccer stadium, and they fall in love. However, Yuddy is troubled by not knowing his biological mother. After breaking up with Su, Yuddy spends a night with Mimi, a dancer at a nightclub. Leaving the room, Mimi encounters Yuddy's best friend Zeb, who falls in love with her at first sight. Tide, a policeman on night patrol, has feelings for Su, but she cannot forget Yuddy. The cast features Hong Kong cinema's biggest stars, including Leslie Cheung, Maggie Cheung, Carina Lau, Tony Leung, Andy Lau, and Jacky Cheung. First released in Japan in 1992. A digital remastered version was released in February 2018 at Bunkamura Le Cinema and other venues. A 4K restored version was released in December 2023 as part of the special screening "Wong Kar-wai: The Beginning."
t18311.tmdb_overview_en: Yuddy, a Hong Kong playboy known for breaking girls' hearts, tries to find solace and truth after discovering the woman who raised him isn't his mother.
t18311.tmdb_overview_jp: L・チャンを主軸に、M・チャン、C・ラウ、A・ラウ、J・チュン、T・レオンと、当時人気絶頂の香港のトップスターたちがきら星のごとく顔をそろえて各自の魅力を存分に発揮。彼らが繰り広げる甘く切ない男女の擦れ違いの恋愛劇を、ウォン監督がスタイリッシュな映像と話法でムード満点に描いて評判を呼び、第10回香港電影金像奨で、作品賞、監督賞など主要5部門を制覇。これが2作目だったウォン監督の異才ぶりをより広く知らしめ、世界中でそれにしびれる熱狂的ファンが続出することとなった。 1960年の香港。競技場の売店の販売員スーは、プレーボーイのヨディからきざなセリフで口説かれ、彼を愛するようになるが、ヨディはやがて、クラブのダンサーのミミに心が移ってしまう。彼に捨てられて心傷つき、夜の街をひとりさまようスーを巡回中の若い警官タイドは慰め、彼女に恋心を抱くが、それは片想いに終わる。“お前の実の母親は外国にいる”と養母から告げられたヨディは、実母に会いにフィリピンへと旅立つが……。

nNEWシネマ歌舞伎 四谷怪談.movie_title: NEWシネマ歌舞伎　四谷怪談
nNEWシネマ歌舞伎 四谷怪談.movie_title_jp: NEWシネマ歌舞伎　四谷怪談
nNEWシネマ歌舞伎 四谷怪談.synopsis: 歌舞伎の舞台を映画館でデジタル上映する「シネマ歌舞伎」シリーズ第28弾。1994年に十八世中村勘三郎らによって、渋谷シアターコクーンでスタートした「渋谷・コクーン歌舞伎」。その第1回目の演目でもある鶴屋南北の「東海道四谷怪談」を串田和美の新たな演出、構成により上演された、2016年6月「コクーン歌舞伎」第15弾の舞台を収録。己の欲に忠実に生きる伊右衛門、直助権兵衛、男たちの刹那。男たちに翻弄されるお袖、お岩、女たちの哀しさ。「四谷怪談」が持つ本能と欲の物語は現代にも通じるという串田流解釈による「四谷怪談」が芝居小屋ならではの臨場感を重視した映像で再現される。伊右衛門役を中村獅童、直助権兵衛役を中村勘九郎、お袖を中村七之助、お岩役を中村扇雀がそれぞれ演じ、片岡亀蔵、笹野高史ら「コクーン歌舞伎」常連俳優に加え、大森博史、バレエダンサーの首藤康之など、歌舞伎としては異色のキャストも出演。
nNEWシネマ歌舞伎 四谷怪談.synopsis_en: The 28th installment in the "Cinema Kabuki" series, which digitally screens kabuki stage performances in movie theaters. This recording captures the June 2016 performance of the 15th "Cocoon Kabuki," featuring Tsuruya Nanboku's "Tokaido Yotsuya Kaidan" in a new direction and composition by Kushida Kazumi. The production originated in 1994 at Shibuya's Theater Cocoon, led by Nakamura Kanzaburo XVIII, and this was the first program in that series. Iemon, who lives faithfully to his own desires; Naosuke Gonbei; the fleeting moments of men. Osode and Oiwa, toyed with by men; the sorrow of women. Kushida's interpretation of "Yotsuya Kaidan" as a story of instinct and desire that still resonates today is recreated with footage emphasizing the unique sense of presence of a live theater. Nakamura Shido plays Iemon, Nakamura Kankuro plays Naosuke Gonbei, Nakamura Shichinosuke plays Osode, and Nakamura Senjaku plays Oiwa. Along with regular "Cocoon Kabuki" actors like Kataoka Kamezo and Sasano Takashi, the cast also features unconventional choices for kabuki, including Omori Hiroshi and ballet dancer Shuto Yasuyuki.

n新作歌舞伎 風の谷のナウシカ 後編.movie_title: 新作歌舞伎　風の谷のナウシカ　後編

n新作歌舞伎 風の谷のナウシカ 後編.director: を務めたアニメ映画版では描かれなかった、原作漫画全7巻の壮大な物語のすべてを歌舞伎化し、新橋演舞場にて昼の部（前編）・夜の部（後編）通しで上演された話題の舞台を映像収録。主人公ナウシカを尾上菊之助、ナウシカと対する皇女クシャナを中村七之助が演じ、脚本には「ゲド戦記」「借りぐらしのアリエッティ」などスタジオジブリ作品を数多く手がける丹羽圭子が参加。演出は「新作歌舞伎『NARUTO
n新作歌舞伎 風の谷のナウシカ 後編.synopsis: 宮崎駿の漫画版「風の谷のナウシカ」を歌舞伎化した「新作歌舞伎　風の谷のナウシカ」の後編。 宮崎駿が自ら監督を務めたアニメ映画版では描かれなかった、原作漫画全7巻の壮大な物語のすべてを歌舞伎化し、新橋演舞場にて昼の部（前編）・夜の部（後編）通しで上演された話題の舞台を映像収録。主人公ナウシカを尾上菊之助、ナウシカと対する皇女クシャナを中村七之助が演じ、脚本には「ゲド戦記」「借りぐらしのアリエッティ」などスタジオジブリ作品を数多く手がける丹羽圭子が参加。演出は「新作歌舞伎『NARUTO ナルト』」を手がけたG2が担当した。 後編となる本作には、全7幕のうち、四幕目「大海嘯」、五幕目「浄化の森」、六幕目「巨神兵の覚醒」、大詰「シュワの墓所の秘密」を収録。新橋演舞場で2019年12月6日から25日に上演された舞台を映像収録し、ディレイビューイングとして2020年2月に東劇、新宿ピカデリーほかで上映された（前編：2020年2月14日から2月20日／後編：2020年2月28日から3月5日の各1週間限定上映）。
n新作歌舞伎 風の谷のナウシカ 後編.synopsis_en: The second part of the "New Kabuki: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind," a kabuki adaptation of Hayao Miyazaki's manga version of "Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind." This kabuki adaptation covers the entire epic story of the original seven-volume manga, which was not depicted in the anime film directed by Miyazaki himself. The stage production was performed at the Shinbashi Enbujō Theatre as a daytime (first part) and evening (second part) continuous performance, and this is a filmed recording of that acclaimed stage. Kikunosuke Onoe plays the protagonist Nausicaä, and Shichinosuke Nakamura plays Princess Kushana, Nausicaä's adversary. The script was written by Keiko Niwa, who has worked on many Studio Ghibli films such as "Tales from Earthsea" and "The Secret World of Arrietty." Direction was handled by G2, who also directed "New Kabuki: NARUTO." This second part includes Act 4 "Great Tsunami," Act 5 "Forest of Purification," Act 6 "Awakening of the God Warrior," and the Grand Finale "Secrets of the Shrine of Shuwa" from the total of seven acts. The stage performance at Shinbashi Enbujō from December 6 to 25, 2019, was filmed and screened as a delay viewing at Tōgeki, Shinjuku Piccadilly, and other venues in February 2020 (first part: February 14–20, 2020; second part: February 28–March 5, 2020, each for a limited one-week run).

nカウント・ベイシー.synopsis_en: A documentary exploring the life and music of Count Basie, the American jazz pianist who built the golden age of swing jazz. Starting his career as a jazz pianist in his twenties, Count Basie met many top musicians in Kansas City, Missouri, joined the Blue Devils in 1928, and later honed his skills with the Bennie Moten Orchestra before forming his own Basie Orchestra. Fusing jazz and blues and revolutionizing rhythm, he was hailed as the 'King of Swing' and remains beloved by jazz fans and musicians across generations in Japan. The film focuses not only on his public triumphs but also on his private life, which Basie rarely discussed. Through home videos, photo albums, and letters from his family, it reveals his love for his daughter Diane, born with cerebral palsy, and his wife Catherine, who supported the African American civil rights movement. Featuring interviews with current Basie Orchestra members, friends like Quincy Jones and Annie Ross, and archival materials, the documentary traces his legacy and the turbulent social history of 20th-century America. Directed by British filmmaker Jeremy Marre, known for many music documentaries including 'Roots Rock Reggae.'

t273433.synopsis_en: A high school in Hiroshima. In the third-year class taught by Kitagawa, student Michiko Oba collapses with a nosebleed. It is caused by leukemia from the atomic bomb. In this class, a full one-third of the students are hibakusha (atomic bomb survivors). On that day, Yukiko's sister was exposed to the bomb while working on evacuation duties and died in a river. Endo Yukio's father could not save his wife, who was trapped under a building and engulfed in flames. When radish sprouts appeared in Hiroshima, where it was said no grass would grow for 75 years after the bombing, people found hope in those sprouts.
t273433.tmdb_overview_en: Historical fiction about the aftermath of the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, Japan, on 6 August 1945, and its effects on various civilians, especially children, of that city.
t273433.tmdb_overview_jp: 広島にある高校。北川が受け持つ三年生のクラスで、生徒の大庭みち子が鼻血を出して倒れた。それは原爆による白血病が原因だった。このクラスでは、実に三分の一の生徒が被爆者だったのだ。あの日、ゆき子の姉は疎開作業中に被爆し、川の中で絶命した。遠藤幸夫の父親は、建物の下敷きになり炎に包まれた妻を助けることができなかった。原爆投下から七十五年は草木が生えないといわれた広島に大根の芽が出たとき、人々はその芽に希望を見いだしていた。

nひろしま～1945年8月6日、原子雲の下の真実～〈デジタルリマスター版〉.movie_title: ひろしま～1945年8月6日、原子雲の下の真実～〈デジタルリマスター版〉
nひろしま～1945年8月6日、原子雲の下の真実～〈デジタルリマスター版〉.movie_title_jp: ひろしま～1945年8月6日、原子雲の下の真実～〈デジタルリマスター版〉

t783740.movie_title: 赤い糸 輪廻のひみつ
t783740.synopsis_en: From Giddens Ko, director of "Mon Mon Mon Monsters!" and "You Are the Apple of My Eye," comes a pure love fantasy inspired by the Taiwanese folk deity "Yue Lao" (the God of Matchmaking) and the concept of reincarnation. After being struck by lightning and brought to the underworld, Xiao Lun, along with Pinky who also arrives there, returns to the mortal world as the Taiwanese matchmaking god "Yue Lao" to tie the fates of people together. One day, a dog appears before them, triggering Xiao Lun to recover his lost memories of his past life. He remembers a promise he made to his first love, Xiao Mi, which he was unable to fulfill due to his sudden death. Starring popular Taiwanese actors: Ku Chen-dong ("You Are the Apple of My Eye") as Xiao Lun, Vivian Sung ("Our Times") as Xiao Mi, and Wang Jing ("The Soul of the Banquet," "My Ghost Friend") as Pinky.
t783740.tmdb_overview_en: Ah Lun, who has a choice to make in the underworld, decides to be a god of love in Chinese mythology. As he advances with his tasks on Earth, his biggest challenge is to tie a red string with the woman he loves the most.

t1365683.synopsis_en: A drama based on the true story of composer Vivaldi's appointment as a violin teacher at the Ospedale della Pietà in Venice in the early 18th century, depicting the growth of a lonely girl whose talent blossoms under his guidance, and Vivaldi's inner ambition, craving recognition for his own genius. Venice, 1716, at the Ospedale della Pietà. Cecilia, raised without knowing her mother's presence or love, secretly slips out of bed every night to write letters to her mother with no address. To leave the Pietà and live in the outside world, her mother must come for her, or she must marry a nobleman. Amidst this, Antonio Vivaldi, arriving as a violin teacher, discovers Cecilia's exceptional violin skill and appoints her as the leader of the first violins. Under Vivaldi, Cecilia endures rigorous practice, hones her violin skills, and they gradually grow close. However, the officer the Pietà has chosen as Cecilia's husband returns from war, and an incident soon occurs. Tekla Insolia, noted for the Italian TV drama 'The Art of Joy,' plays Cecilia, and Michele Riondino of 'The Sleeping Beauty' plays Vivaldi. The film is directed and written by Damiano Michieletto, a leading Italian opera director who served as creative director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics.
t1365683.tmdb_overview_en: In 18th-century Venice, 20-year-old violin virtuoso Cecilia lives at the Pièta orphanage, where, despite her talent, she remains confined, knowing that marriage is the only way out. Yet, her life takes a turn after she meets Antonio Vivaldi, a brilliant and ambitious composer who becomes the new violin teacher. Guided by Vivaldi and his music, Cecilia finds the strength to challenge the destiny that once seemed inevitable.
t1365683.tmdb_overview_jp: 1716 年、ヴェネツィアのピエタ院。赤ちゃんポストに置き去りにされたチェチリア（テクラ・インソリア）は、母の姿も愛情も知らずにこの院で育ち、毎晩こっそりベッドから抜け出してはろうそくの灯りで、宛名のない母への手紙を綴っていた。院から出て外の世界で暮らすには、母親が迎えに来るか、貴族に見いだされ結婚するかしかなかった。そんな中、ピエタ院にアントニオ・ヴィヴァルディ（ミケーレ・リオンディーノ）がヴァイオリン教師として赴任すると、卓越したヴァイオリンの技術を持つチェチリアを見出し、第一ヴァイオリンのリーダーに任命する。ヴィヴァルディからの厳しい練習に耐え、ヴァイオリンの腕があがっていくチェチリア。いつしか二人は心を通わせるようになる。そんな折、ピエタ院が決めたチェチリアの結婚相手である将校がトルコとの戦争から戻り、結婚が迫ったある日、事件が起こる……。

n偏向報道.synopsis: 「池島譚歌」「私の骨 MY BLOOD BONE」の荻野欣士郎が監督・脚本を手がけ、テレビ局などの報道機関が特定の立場や意図に基づいて情報を編集・強調することで受け手の考えを誘導する「偏向報道」をテーマに制作した社会派ドラマ。かつてテレビ番組制作ディレクターとして報道に携わった経験をもつ荻野監督が、自身の体験した風通しの悪い縦社会を舞台に、下請け制作会社のディレクターがテレビ局上層部の悪習に立ち向かう姿を描き出す。 地方都市のテレビ局・テレビトップの下請け制作会社に所属する、はっきりとものを言う性格のディレクター・油神鈴子。ある時、テレビ局の子会社が、知事のパワハラに関する真偽不明な情報をもとにねつ造映像を制作する。鈴子はその映像の放送を差し止めてほしいと頼まれるが……。 俳優としても活躍するお笑いタレントの鳥居みゆきが油神鈴子役で主演を務め、権力で子会社や下請け会社を威圧する報道局長役で誠直也が共演。東さや香、大迫一平、時東ぁみ、郷田ほづみ、小野進也、螢雪次朗ら個性豊かな俳優陣が脇を固める。
n偏向報道.synopsis_en: A social drama directed and written by Kinshirō Ogino ('Ikushima Tanga,' 'My Bone MY BLOOD BONE'), focusing on 'biased reporting'—how news organizations edit and emphasize information based on specific stances or intentions to sway public opinion. Drawing from his own experience as a TV program director, Ogino depicts a rigid, top-down society where a director at a subcontracting production company confronts the corrupt practices of TV network executives. Suzuko Aburakami, a blunt-speaking director working for a subcontractor of the local TV station 'TV Top,' is asked to stop the broadcast of a fabricated video produced by the network's subsidiary, based on dubious information about the governor's harassment. Comedian and actress Miyuki Torii stars as Suzuko, with Seiya Makoto as the news director who intimidates subsidiaries and subcontractors. The cast includes Sayaka Higashi, Ippei Ōsako, Ami Tokitō, Hozumi Gōda, Shinya Ono, and Setsujirō Hotaru.

t1630435.synopsis_en: Based on the debut novel by physician-author Yo Hisakabe published in 2003, this human suspense film stars Shota Sometani. At the daycare facility 'Ijinzaka Clinic,' an innovative treatment devised by director Kuranosuke Urushibara spreads quietly among the elderly. Aiming for cost-effective care, the treatment involves 'useless limbs' (paralyzed body parts with no hope of recovery), and unexpected 'favorable side effects' have appeared, such as 'feeling lighter in body and mind' and 'a harsh personality softening.' Hearing rumors, editor Yagura senses potential for a revolution in geriatric medicine and proposes publishing a book to Urushibara. However, everything takes a dark turn when an internal whistleblowing about the daycare leaks to a weekly magazine, and a shocking incident occurs at a patient's home. Sometani delivers a haunting performance as Urushibara, a doctor who, in pursuit of his ideals, steps into the gap between rationality and madness. The cast includes Yuki Kitamura as editor Yagura, Naomasa Rokudaira as elderly patient Iwagami who reclaims his life through Urushibara's treatment, and Kumi Takiuchi as Urushibara's wife Kikuko. The film is directed and written by Mitsuki Yoshida, who has gained international attention for works such as 'Family X' and 'Three Lights.'
t1630435.tmdb_overview_en: At the "Ijinzaka Clinic" day service, a revolutionary treatment devised by Director Urushihara is secretly spreading among the elderly. Aiming for the ultimate cost-effective care, the amputation of "Disusebody" (limbs with no hope of recovery) has reportedly led to unexpected positive side effects, such as patients feeling "lighter in body and mind" or "developing a gentler personality." Yagura, an editor who hears these rumors, senses a potential revolution in geriatric medicine and proposes a book deal to Urushihara. However, an internal whistleblower leak about the daycare center soon surfaces in a weekly magazine. Following a shocking incident at a patient's home, everything begins to spiral into darkness.

t473262.movie_title: 残響のメロディ魂の放浪者ニコ、最後の旅路
t473262.director: スザンナ・ニッキャレッリ
t473262.synopsis_en: A musical biopic depicting the later years of Nico, the German-born chanteuse of the American rock band The Velvet Underground and muse of pop art pioneer Andy Warhol, who dominated the 1960s scene. Focusing on the two years before her death in 1988 at age 49, it interweaves her stage presence with personal struggles, realistically portraying the loneliness and rebirth behind the glamorous legend. In 1986, Nico, in her late 40s and living alone in England, distances herself from past fame and embarks on a European tour with her new manager Richard and her band. But the journey is harsh, forcing her to confront her unstable psyche, drug addiction, and conflicts with those around her. Burdened by regret and conflict as a mother, she retrieves her son Ari, who is in a French rehabilitation facility for drug addiction and a suicide attempt, and brings him along on tour... Trine Dyrholm (from "Into Eternity") stars as Nico and performs the songs herself. John Gordon Sinclair ("Gregory's Girl") plays manager Richard, and Anamaria Marinca ("4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days") plays violinist Sylvia. Directed by Italian filmmaker Susanna Nicchiarelli, known for "Miss Marx." It won the Best Film award in the Orizzonti section at the 74th Venice International Film Festival in 2017.
t473262.tmdb_overview_en: Approaching age 50, singer/songwriter Nico leads a solitary existence, far from her days as a Warhol superstar and celebrated vocalist for the Velvet Underground in the 1960s. Her life and career on the fringes, Nico's new manager convinces her to hit the road again and tour in Europe to promote her latest album. She longs to rebuild a relationship with her son, whose custody she lost long ago.

n無敵なカタチ.synopsis_en: A documentary tracing the journey of Mentaiko Kid, a professional wrestler from Kyushu Pro Wrestling who retired in May 2025. As a boy in a small town, Manabu Katagami dreamed of becoming a pro wrestler but gave up due to his short stature, eventually forgetting the dream. After a gloomy adolescence and a period as a ronin, he entered university without a clear goal. There, he discovered the pro wrestling research club, rekindling his childhood impulse and setting him on a path with the clear goal of becoming a pro wrestler. After making his long-awaited professional debut in Mexico and facing repeated setbacks, he grew through various encounters and support from those around him, eventually becoming known as 'the pro wrestler most loved by children in the world.' At the peak of his popularity, while he could still perform to his own satisfaction, Mentaiko Kid decided to retire. The director is Takashi Shimomoto, a film director and singer-songwriter who has released documentary works such as 'Blank Live,' '6600 Volts,' and 'Cloud Journey.'

n岡本万太.synopsis_en: The protagonist, Manta Okamoto (Sojiro Sanada), is a 26-year-old part-timer. Plagued by mounting irritation over life’s minor inconveniences, he lives in constant fear of whether he can suppress his own impulses. For Manta is a man of uncontrollable rage. Once a month, his stress reaches a breaking point—his "Limit Day." To cope, he locks himself away at home, strapped to a bed with restraints. Because these days strike without warning, he frequently misses work, leading to a cycle of being fired and drifting from one job to the next. One day, Nakamura (Masaki Miura), a former senior colleague from a publishing house that let him go, approaches him with a new opportunity. The job is simple: store some cardboard boxes for a few days in exchange for a large sum of money. But...

n劇場版 かげる針路.movie_title: 劇場版 かげる針路
n劇場版 かげる針路.movie_title_jp: 劇場版 かげる針路
n劇場版 かげる針路.synopsis_en: A documentary that delves into the serious 'shadow' beginning to appear over Fukushima's course, which was set on the ideals of 'nuclear phase-out' and 'renewable energy promotion' following the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident. This is a theatrical remake of the Fukushima TV documentary program 'Kageru Shiro' (Shadowy Course), which aired in May 2025 and sparked a huge response. Fukushima Prefecture, having experienced one of the world's worst nuclear accidents, shifted course toward abandoning nuclear power and promoting renewable energy. Fifteen years after that turning point, Fukushima now stands at a critical crossroads. As mega-solar plants rapidly expand, carving up mountains, issues like shoddy construction and landscape degradation have surfaced, intensifying headwinds against renewable energy. Meanwhile, with the government still unable to show a clear picture of completing the decommissioning of the crippled Fukushima Daiichi plant, it has shifted its energy policy back toward nuclear power, moving to restart reactors. The film turns its camera on the environmental destruction and friction with local residents caused by the rapid expansion of mega-solar, and the government's return to nuclear power, which becomes clearer as the end of decommissioning remains out of sight, vividly capturing Fukushima's present wavering between ideals and reality.

t1264805.synopsis_en: Summer 2008, Seoul. University students Uno and Jeong-won meet fatefully on a long-distance bus. Uno, who dreams of becoming a game creator, and Jeong-won, who aspires to be an architect. Supporting each other through their urban days filled with dreams and anxieties, they eventually fall in love, deeply and truly. However, faced with the harshness of reality that youth cannot resist, they choose to part ways. Ten years later, in the summer of 2024, they coincidentally reunite on a flight to Seoul. As they look back on their memories, Uno asks Jeong-won a question he has kept buried deep in his heart: 'What if, back then...'
t1264805.tmdb_overview_en: Seoul, 2008. On a bus heading to their hometown, fate brings Eun-ho and Jeong-won together, sparking an unlikely friendship. While battling  a bustling and weary city life, they find themselves sharing lofty dreams and a love that comes to feel extraordinary. But, eventually, the harsh realities of life lead them to part ways. Over a decade after the separation, the two unexpectedly reunite on a flight back to Korea, where they reflect on their lost time.
t1264805.tmdb_overview_jp: 地方からソウルへ上京し夢を抱く二人。かつて激しく愛し合い別れたウノとジョンウォンが、10年ぶりの偶然の再会をきっかけに思い出をたどる。

n劇場版 ほんとうにあった怖い話～ゾクゾク変な間取り～.movie_title: 劇場版 ほんとうにあった怖い話～ゾクゾク変な間取り～
