nいってらっしゃいの花.movie_title: いってらっしゃいの花
nいってらっしゃいの花.movie_title_jp: いってらっしゃいの花
nいってらっしゃいの花.synopsis_en: A fantastical human drama themed around "accepting the death of a loved one," depicting a woman who returns to the world as a ghost after losing her life. Ayaka, who dies suddenly at a young age, wakes up in a "waiting room" that connects the afterlife and the living world. Told by a male guide she meets there that she has a grace period to return to the world, she becomes a ghost and visits her father, her best friend Chiaki, and her fiancé Sota, but no one notices her presence. As Ayaka wishes to exchange words with them just one more time, and Chiaki and Sota are consumed by grief, each reflects on the past and their feelings. Directed, written, and edited by Rei Shiina (known for "Gradation" and "Koko Igai no Dokoka e"), with cinematography by Akira Kawachi (known for "Fear of Missing Out"). Starring Ao Morimoto as Ayaka, Rei Fukuda as Chiaki, and Django Yamada as Sota, with supporting roles by Yusuke Sunaga, Takehiko Fujita, and Ikko Konatsu. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Jūsan Shitamachi Film Festival.

t1518269.movie_title_en: In Their Own Words: The Women of Kurokawa
t1518269.synopsis: 戦時下の満州で黒川開拓団の女性たちに起きた「接待」という名の性暴力の実態に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 1930～40年代に日本政府の国策のもと実施された満蒙開拓により、日本各地から中国・満州の地に渡った満蒙開拓団。日本の敗戦が濃厚になるなか、1945年8月にソ連軍が満州に侵攻し、開拓団の人々は過酷な状況に追い込まれた。岐阜県から渡った黒川開拓団の人々は生きて日本に帰るため、数えで18歳以上の15人の女性を性の相手として差し出すことで、敵であるソ連軍に助けを求めた。帰国後、女性たちを待ち受けていたのは差別と偏見の目だった。心身ともに傷を負った彼女たちの声はかき消され、この事実は長年にわたり伏せられることになる。しかし戦争から約70年が経った2013年、黒川の女性たちは手を携え、幾重にも重なる加害の事実を公の場で語りはじめた。 そんな女性たちのオーラルストーリーを、「ハマのドン」の松原文枝監督が丁寧に紡ぎ出す。俳優の大竹しのぶが語りを担当。
t1518269.synopsis_en: A documentary that investigates the reality of sexual violence euphemistically called "entertainment" inflicted on the women of the Kurokawa settlement group in Manchuria during wartime. As part of the Japanese government's national policy in the 1930s-40s, the Manchuria-Mongolia settlement groups were sent from across Japan to Manchuria, China. As Japan's defeat became imminent, the Soviet army invaded Manchuria in August 1945, plunging the settlers into dire circumstances. To survive and return to Japan, the Kurokawa settlement group from Gifu Prefecture offered 15 women aged 18 and older (by traditional count) as sexual partners to the enemy Soviet army in exchange for help. After returning to Japan, the women faced discrimination and prejudice. Their voices, physically and mentally scarred, were silenced, and the truth was concealed for many years. However, about 70 years after the war, in 2013, the women of Kurokawa joined hands and began to speak publicly about the layers of harm they suffered. Director Fumie Matsubara, known for "Hama no Don," carefully weaves together these women's oral stories. Actress Shinobu Otake provides narration.
t1518269.tmdb_overview_en: A documentary exposing the sexual violence euphemistically termed "entertainment" inflicted on women of the Kurokawa settler group during Japan’s imperialist expansion in Manchuria. Under state-led colonization in the 1930s–40s, Japanese settlers occupied Chinese lands. In August 1945, facing the Soviet invasion, the group offered 15 women to enemy troops in a desperate act of survival. Decades later, the survivors confront the silenced legacy of imperial violence, discrimination, and trauma. Directed by Fumie Matsubara, with narration by Shinobu Otake.

t1359916.synopsis: 「君の名は。」「すずめの戸締まり」の新海誠監督による2007年公開の劇場アニメーション「秒速5センチメートル」を、「SixTONES」の松村北斗主演で実写映画化。 1991年、春。東京の小学校で出会った遠野貴樹と篠原明里は、互いの孤独に手を差し伸べるように心を通わせるが、卒業と同時に明里は引っ越してしまう。中学1年の冬。吹雪の夜に栃木・岩舟で再会を果たした2人は、雪の中に立つ桜の木の下で、2009年3月26日に同じ場所で再会することを約束する。時は流れ、2008年。東京でシステムエンジニアとして働く貴樹は30歳を前にして、自分の一部が遠い時間に取り残されたままであることに気づく。明里もまた、当時の思い出とともに静かに日常を生きていた。 貴樹と心を通わせていくヒロイン・篠原明里役を高畑充希、貴樹に思いを寄せる高校の同級生・澄田花苗役を森七菜、高校時代の貴樹役を青木柚、貴樹の会社の同僚・水野理紗役を木竜麻生が務め、そのほかに宮﨑あおい、吉岡秀隆が共演。「アット・ザ・ベンチ」で注目を集めた映像監督・写真家の奥山由之がメガホンをとり、「愛に乱暴」の鈴木史子が脚本を手がけた。
t1359916.synopsis_en: A live-action film adaptation of Makoto Shinkai's 2007 theatrical anime "5 Centimeters Per Second," directed by Shinkai of "Your Name." and "Suzume," starring Hokuto Matsumura of SixTONES. Spring 1991. Takaki Tono and Akari Shinohara, who meet at an elementary school in Tokyo, connect through their shared loneliness, but Akari moves away upon graduation. In the winter of their first year of middle school, they reunite on a snowy night in Iwafune, Tochigi, and promise beneath a cherry tree standing in the snow to meet again at the same place on March 26, 2009. Time passes to 2008. Takaki, now working as a systems engineer in Tokyo and approaching 30, realizes a part of himself remains left behind in a distant time. Akari, too, lives her quiet daily life with those memories. Mitsuki Takahata plays Akari Shinohara, the heroine who connects with Takaki; Nana Mori plays Kanae Sumita, a high school classmate who has feelings for Takaki; Yuzu Aoki plays Takaki in high school; and Asa Kimura plays Risa Mizuno, Takaki's coworker. Also starring Aoi Miyazaki and Hidetaka Yoshioka. Directed by visual artist and photographer Yoshiyuki Okuyama, who gained attention with "At the Bench," with a screenplay by Fumiko Suzuki of "Love At Least."
t1359916.tmdb_overview_en: Spring 1991. Takaki and Akari meet in elementary school and continue to exchange letters even after she moves away. They make a final promise to each other to meet again. It is now 2008. They live their respective lives, paths never crossing. Enduring memories and a premonition of that promised day. Even now, their words from that day drift quietly, transcending time and distance. An ephemeral story of a promised reunion with someone precious.
t1359916.tmdb_overview_jp: 1991年、春。東京の小学校で出会った遠野貴樹と篠原明里は、互いの孤独に手を差し伸べるように心を通わせるが、卒業と同時に明里は引っ越してしまう。中学1年の冬。吹雪の夜に栃木・岩舟で再会を果たした2人は、雪の中に立つ桜の木の下で、2009年3月26日に同じ場所で再会することを約束する。時は流れ、2008年。東京でシステムエンジニアとして働く貴樹は30歳を前にして、自分の一部が遠い時間に取り残されたままであることに気づく。明里もまた、当時の思い出とともに静かに日常を生きていた。

t198375.synopsis_en: From the director Makoto Shinkai, known for delicate drama and visual beauty in works like 'The Place Promised in Our Early Days' and '5 Centimeters per Second,' comes a love story set for the first time in modern Tokyo. Takao, a high school student aiming to become a shoemaker, skips school on rainy days to sketch shoes in a park's Japanese garden. One such day, he meets a mysterious older woman named Yukino, and the two grow closer through meetings that happen only on rainy days. For Yukino, who says she has lost her place in the world, Takao tries to craft shoes that make her want to walk more, but... The main staff for character design, art, and music features new faces different from Shinkai's previous works. The short film 'Dareka no Manazashi' is shown as a double feature.
t198375.tmdb_overview_en: Takao, who is training to become a shoemaker, skipped school and is sketching shoes in a Japanese-style garden. He meets a mysterious woman, Yukino, who is older than him. Then, without arranging the times, the two start to see each other again and again, but only on rainy days. They deepen their relationship and open up to each other. But the end of the rainy season soon approaches.
t198375.tmdb_overview_jp: 学校をサボり、公園の日本庭園で靴のスケッチを描く高校生のタカオ。靴職人を目指すタカオはそこで、缶ビールを飲む女性、ユキノと出会う。ユキノはタカオに「また会うかもね。雨が降ったら」と告げ、その場を後にした。こうして二人は約束もないまま、雨の日の公園で逢瀬を重ねるようになる。歩き方を忘れたというユキノのため、タカオは靴を作ろうとするのだった。

t79707.synopsis_en: Makoto Shinkai, the animation artist known for delicate psychological portrayals and meticulous visual beauty in works like 'Voices of a Distant Star' and 'The Place Promised in Our Early Days,' returns with his first original feature in five years since '5 Centimeters per Second.' This juvenile animation follows a girl named Asuna who, triggered by mysterious music heard through a mineral radio left by her father, embarks on a grand adventure. The familiar staff supporting Shinkai's works, including art director Takumi Tanji and composer Tenmon, come together for this film.
t79707.tmdb_overview_en: The film centers on Asuna, a young girl who spends her solitary days listening to the mysterious music emanating from the crystal radio she received from her late father as a memento. One day while walking home she is attacked by a fearsome monster and saved by a mysterious boy named Shun. However, Shun disappears and Asuna embarks on a journey of adventure to the land of Agartha with her teacher Mr. Morisaki to meet a Shun again. Through her journey she comes to know the cruelty and beauty of the world, as well as loss.
t79707.tmdb_overview_jp: ある日、父の形見の鉱石ラジオから聴こえてきた不思議な唄。その唄を忘れられない少女アスナは、地下世界アガルタから来たという少年シュンに出会う。2人は心を通わせるも、 少年は突然姿を消してしまう。「もう一度あの人に会いたい」そう願うアスナの前にシュンと瓜二つの少年シンと、妻との再会を切望しアガルタを探す教師モリサキが現れる。そこに開かれるアガルタへの扉。3人はそれぞれの想いを胸に、伝説の地へ旅に出る―。

t916224.synopsis_en: Director Makoto Shinkai, of "Your Name." and "Weathering with You," presents a feature animation depicting the adventure and growth of a girl who journeys across ruins throughout Japan to close "doors" that bring disaster. Suzume Iwato, a 17-year-old living in Kyushu, meets Souta Munakata, a young man on a journey searching for doors. Following him to a mountain ruin, Suzume finds an old door standing as if spared from the surrounding collapse, and is drawn to reach for it. Soon, doors begin opening one after another across Japan. As calamities come from beyond the doors, Suzume embarks on a journey to close them. Despite numerous surprises and hardships, Suzume continues forward, but... Nanoka Hara, a young actress known for "The Sound of Sin" and "My Heart Beats for You," was chosen through auditions to voice the protagonist Suzume. Hokuto Matsumura of SixTONES voices Souta, marking his voice acting debut. Also voicing roles are Eri Fukatsu, Shota Someno, Sairi Ito, Kotone Hanase, and Hakuo Matsumoto, with regular Shinkai collaborators Ryunosuke Kamiki and Kana Hanazawa also appearing. Music is again by RADWIMPS, in their third collaboration with Shinkai, alongside composer Kazuma Jinnouchi. Screened in competition at the 73rd Berlin International Film Festival in 2023, marking the first Japanese animated film in competition there in 21 years since "Spirited Away," which won the Golden Bear.
t916224.tmdb_overview_en: Suzume, 17, lost her mother as a little girl. On her way to school, she meets a mysterious young man. But her curiosity unleashes a calamity that endangers the entire population of Japan, and so Suzume embarks on a journey to set things right.
t916224.tmdb_overview_jp: 九州の静かな町で暮らす17歳の少女・鈴芽（すずめ）は、「扉を探してるんだ」という旅の青年・草太に出会う。彼の後を追って迷い込んだ山中の廃墟で見つけたのは、ぽつんとたたずむ古ぼけた扉。なにかに引き寄せられるように、すずめは扉に手を伸ばすが…。  扉の向こう側からは災いが訪れてしまうため、草太は扉を閉めて鍵をかける“閉じ師”として旅を続けているという。

t568160.synopsis_en: Director Makoto Shinkai, whose "Your Name." was a historic blockbuster, presents a feature animation depicting a boy and girl in an era of disrupted weather harmony, struggling against fate while choosing their own way of life. Hodaka, a high school student who runs away from a remote island to Tokyo, quickly falls into poverty. After lonely days, he finally lands a job writing for a shady occult magazine. As if foreshadowing his future, rain falls day after day. One day, Hodaka meets a girl named Hina in a corner of the city. Living alone with her younger brother due to circumstances, she possesses a mysterious ability to clear the sky by "praying"... Kotaro Daigo, who appeared in "My Brother Loves Me Too Much," and Nana Mori, with upcoming roles in "Hell Girl" and "Last Letter," voice Hodaka and Hina respectively. Other cast members include Shun Oguri, Tsubasa Honda, Junpei Heisawa, Yuuki Kaji, and Chieko Baisho. Following "Your Name.," Genki Kawamura serves as planner and producer, Masayoshi Tanaka as character designer, and rock band RADWIMPS provides the music. Actress Toko Miura participates as female vocals on the RADWIMPS theme song.
t568160.tmdb_overview_en: The summer of his high school freshman year, Hodaka runs away from his remote island home to Tokyo, and quickly finds himself pushed to his financial and personal limits. The weather is unusually gloomy and rainy every day, as if taking its cue from his life. After many days of solitude, he finally finds work as a freelance writer for a mysterious occult magazine. Then, one day, Hodaka meets Hina on a busy street corner. This bright and strong-willed girl possesses a strange and wonderful ability: the power to stop the rain and clear the sky.
t568160.tmdb_overview_jp: “あの光の中に、行ってみたかった”。高1の夏に離島から家出し、東京にやって来た帆高。だが生活はすぐに困窮し、孤独な日々の果てにようやく見つけた仕事は、怪しげなオカルト雑誌のライター業だった。彼のこれからを示唆するかのように、連日降り続ける雨。そんな中、雑踏ひしめく都会の片隅で、帆高はひとりの少女と出会う。ある事情を抱え、弟と2人で明るくたくましく暮らすその少女・陽菜。彼女には不思議な能力があった。

t372058.synopsis_en: Director Makoto Shinkai, known for delicately portraying the nuances of male-female emotions against beautiful landscapes in works like "The Place Promised in Our Early Days" and "5 Centimeters Per Second," delivers his first original feature in three years since "The Garden of Words." Character design by Masayoshi Tanaka of "Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day" fame, animation direction by Masashi Ando, known for his work on Studio Ghibli films like "Princess Mononoke" and "Spirited Away," and music including the theme song by popular rock band RADWIMPS. The film remained in the top 10 of domestic box office rankings for 29 consecutive weeks, achieving historic blockbuster success with over 25 billion yen in revenue. It won the Award for Best Screenplay at the 40th Japan Academy Prize, a first for an animated work. One month before a comet approaches for the first time in 1000 years, Mitsuha Miyamizu, a high school girl living in a mountainous rural town, dreams she is a male high school student in Tokyo. Mitsuha, who feels cramped by her small town and longs for the city, enjoys city life in her dream. Meanwhile, Taki Tachibana, a male high school student in Tokyo, dreams he is a high school girl in a mountain town he's never visited. As the body-swapping phenomenon continues and they become aware of each other, Taki and Mitsuha eventually discover an unexpected truth. Voice cast includes Ryunosuke Kamiki as Taki and Mone Kamishiraishi as Mitsuha, with Masami Nagasawa and Etsuko Ichihara among others.
t372058.tmdb_overview_en: High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki are complete strangers living separate lives. But one night, they suddenly switch places. Mitsuha wakes up in Taki’s body, and he in hers. This bizarre occurrence continues to happen randomly, and the two must adjust their lives around each other.
t372058.tmdb_overview_jp: 1,000年に1度のすい星来訪が、1か月後に迫る日本。山々に囲まれた田舎町に住む女子高生の三葉は、町長である父の選挙運動や、家系の神社の風習などに鬱屈（うっくつ）していた。それゆえに都会への憧れを強く持っていたが、ある日彼女は自分が都会に暮らしている少年になった夢を見る。夢では東京での生活を楽しみながらも、その不思議な感覚に困惑する三葉。一方、東京在住の男子高校生・瀧も自分が田舎町に生活する少女になった夢を見る。やがて、その奇妙な夢を通じて彼らは引き合うようになっていくが……。

t33320.movie_title: 千年女優 4Kデジタルリマスター版
t33320.synopsis_en: Director Satoshi Kon of 'Perfect Blue' crafts an original feature-length animation depicting an actress who has cherished a man for decades, transcending time and space. Tachibana, the president of a small video production company, visits the secluded estate of Chiyoko Fujiwara, a legendary Showa-era actress who once dominated the silver screen, to produce a documentary about her. Chiyoko, who vanished from cinema thirty years ago and has lived in seclusion, begins to recount her memories upon seeing a single key Tachibana brings. Her narrative soon blurs the lines between reality and film episodes, unfolding into a tumultuous tale. At the 5th Agency for Cultural Affairs Media Arts Festival, it won the Grand Prize in the animation division alongside Hayao Miyazaki's 'Spirited Away.' It also received the Best Asian Film award at the 33rd Sitges Film Festival, earning high acclaim domestically and internationally, and was distributed worldwide by DreamWorks.
t33320.tmdb_overview_en: Documentary filmmaker Genya Tachibana has tracked down the legendary actress Chiyoko Fujiwara, who mysteriously vanished at the height of her career. When he presents her with a key she had lost and thought was gone forever, the filmmaker could not have imagined that it would not only unlock the long-held secrets of Chiyoko’s life... but also his own.
t33320.tmdb_overview_jp: 映像製作会社社長・立花源也は、かつて一世を風靡した大女優・藤原千代子の半生を振り返るドキュメンタリー制作を依頼された。千代子の大ファンだった立花は若いカメラマンを引き連れ、30年前に人気絶頂の中、忽然と姿を消し、以来公の場に現われなかった千代子の屋敷へ向かった。ようやく姿を現した千代子は、歳は老いても昔の清純な印象を残していた。そして、戸惑いながらも自らの人生を語り始めた。それは、女優になる前、女学生の頃に恋した名も知らぬ男性を、生涯をかけて追い求める壮大なラブ・ストーリーだった。

t1677172.tmdb_overview_en: Paranoia Agent is a Japanese anime television series created by director Satoshi Kon and produced by Madhouse about a social phenomenon in Musashino, Tokyo caused by a juvenile serial assailant named Lil' Slugger (the English equivalent to Shōnen Bat, which translates to "Bat Boy"). The plot relays between a large cast of people affected in some way by the phenomenon; usually Lil' Slugger's victims or the detectives assigned to apprehend him. As each character becomes the focus of the story, details are revealed about their secret lives and the truth about Lil' Slugger.

t12924.movie_title: 雲のむこう、約束の場所
t12924.movie_title_jp: 雲のむこう、約束の場所 - The place promised in our early days
t12924.movie_title_en: The Place Promised in Our Early Days
t12924.clean_title_jp: 雲のむこう、約束の場所 - The place promised in our early days
t12924.movie_title_original: 雲のむこう、約束の場所
t12924.synopsis_en: Makoto Shinkai, who rose to prominence with his fully digital personal animation "Voices of a Distant Star" in 2002, makes his feature-length directorial debut. Set in post-war Japan divided north and south by the Tsugaru Strait, it depicts boys struggling to save a girl burdened with the world's mysteries. In Japan under US military rule, middle school students Hiroki Fujisawa and Takuya Shirakawa in Aomori admire a giant tower standing across the strait in Hokkaido, and secretly work on assembling an airplane at an abandoned station site, dreaming of one day reaching that tower. One summer vacation, they confide their airplane secret to their classmate Sayuri Sawatari, another object of their admiration. The three share the dream of reaching the tower together, enjoying a brief period of happiness, but in the summer of their third year of middle school, Sayuri transfers away without explanation. The dream of reaching the tower by plane fades, and three years pass. Hiroki and Takuya, having gone their separate ways, reunite when dark clouds gather over the world situation and the tower's secrets gradually come to light. Voice cast includes actors Hidetaka Yoshioka and Masato Hagiwara.
t12924.tmdb_overview_en: In a post-war alternative timeline, Japan is divided into the North, controlled by the Union, and the South, controlled by the United States. A mysterious high tower rises within the borders of the Union. Three high school students promise to cross the border with a self-built airplane and unravel the secret of the tower.
t12924.tmdb_overview_jp: 日本が津軽海峡を挟んで分割占領された戦後世界。 1996年、北海道は「ユニオン」に占領され、「蝦夷」と名前を変えていた。「ユニオンの塔」と呼ばれる塔を建設し、その存在はアメリカとユニオンの間に軍事的緊張をもたらしていた。青森に住む中学３年生の藤沢浩紀と白川拓也は、飛行機を自力で組立て、そこまで飛ぶことを夢見ていた。また２人は同級生の沢渡佐由理に恋心を抱いており、いつの日にか自分たちの飛行機で、佐由理を塔まで連れて行くことを約束する。しかし、佐由理は何の連絡も無いまま姿を消し、浩紀は東京、拓也は地元の高校へ進学し、彼女が消えた喪失感を埋め合わせるように日々を送る生活が続いた。

t298467.synopsis_en: The pinnacle of Japanese musicals, depicting a salaryman struggling in the battle for foreign tourists in Tokyo just before the Olympics. Throughout the film, talented performers sing and dance, and Frankie's astonishing physical abilities leave you in awe. The grand group dance in 'Man Alone' is especially breathtaking.
t298467.tmdb_overview_en: A group of friends try to find success in corporate Japan.

n『 喜劇 ・日本列島震度0』.program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
n『 喜劇 ・日本列島震度0』.synopsis: かいせつ 女占い師が大地震を予言、東京の下町の足袋職人は避難を訴え、悪徳金融業者はひと儲けを企み…。関東大震災から50年、「日本沈没」ブームに沸くニッポンを過激に笑いとばす地震狂騒曲。フランキー、財津のコンビはやはり最高！
n『 喜劇 ・日本列島震度0』.synopsis_en: A female fortune teller predicts a major earthquake, a tabi craftsman in downtown Tokyo urges evacuation, and a shady loan shark schemes to make a quick profit... Fifty years after the Great Kanto Earthquake, this earthquake frenzy comedy wildly laughs at a Japan caught up in the 'Japan Sinks' boom. The duo of Frankie and Zaitsu is simply the best!

t354570.movie_title_en: I Want to Be a Shellfish
t354570.program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
t354570.synopsis: かいせつ 復員した田舎町の理髪店主は、思いがけず戦犯として裁かれることになる―。芸術祭賞受賞のテレビドラマを、脚本の橋本が自ら監督した映画版。戦争の不条理と残酷さを描き、フランキーの渾身の演技に心震える伝説的作品。
t354570.synopsis_en: A small-town barber who has returned from the war unexpectedly finds himself put on trial as a war criminal. This film version, directed by screenwriter Hashimoto himself, is based on a television drama that won an Art Festival Award. A legendary work that portrays the absurdity and cruelty of war, with Frankie's heartfelt performance that shakes the soul.
t354570.tmdb_overview_en: On a post-war peaceful day in Japan, Toyomatsu Shimizu, a barber as well as a good father and husband, is suddenly arrested by the Prefectural Police as a war criminal and sued for murder.

n『羽織の大将』.program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
n『羽織の大将』.synopsis: かいせつ 大学の落研から落語の世界に飛び込み、一躍人気者となった新人落語家は…。芸の世界での修行の苦労、思わぬ成功と挫折を、愉快にほろ苦く綴った佳篇。天性の芸達者・フランキーが、板についた見事な噺家ぶりをみせる。
n『羽織の大将』.synopsis_en: A new rakugo performer who jumps from his university comedy club into the world of rakugo and becomes an instant hit... This delightful and bittersweet film gently chronicles the hardships of training in the world of performance, unexpected success, and setbacks. The naturally gifted entertainer Frankie gives a superb and convincing portrayal of a storyteller.

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t41972.synopsis_en: In 1982, the deadly virus MM-88 is stolen from a research institute in East Germany. However, the plane carrying the spy who stole it crashes in the Alps, and the virus spreads across the Earth, wiping out humanity except for a small group of survivors in Antarctica. One of these survivors, earthquake researcher Yoshizumi, realizes an even greater danger is approaching: a massive earthquake could strike the eastern United States, potentially triggering the launch of nuclear missiles.
t41972.tmdb_overview_en: Scientists in Antarctica desperately try to find a cure to a military virus that was released in a plane crash and has wiped out the rest of the world.
t41972.tmdb_overview_jp: 1982年、東ドイツの研究所から猛毒ウイルスMM－88が盗まれた。ところが盗み出したスパイの乗った飛行機はアルプス山中で事故に遭い、ウイルスが蔓延した地球は、南極にわずかな人類を残して滅亡する。その生存者の一人、地震研究者吉住は、さらに大きな危険が近づいていることに気づく。アメリカ東部に大地震がおきる可能性があり、それは核ミサイルの発射を誘発するものだった。

t66788.movie_title: 『セーラー服と機関銃』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t66788.synopsis_en: The boss of a small yakuza gang called Medaka-gumi, who has only four underlings, dies leaving a will stating that his successor must be a blood relative. Around the same time, high school girl Izumi Hoshi is saying her final goodbye at the crematorium to her father Takashi, who died after being hit by a car in front of Narita Airport. Izumi's mother passed away long ago, leaving her truly alone. When Izumi returns to her apartment, a woman named Mayumi is there, carrying a letter from her father that says, 'If I die, please take care of Izumi.' The next day, a crowd of men in black suits lines up in front of her school. Ignoring her friends Tomoki, Tetsuo, and Shuhei, who try to stop her, Izumi heads toward the school gate. The man from the crematorium steps forward and says, 'You're Izumi Hoshi, right?' This man, named Sakuma, takes her to a shabby office and asks her to succeed as the fourth-generation boss of the Medaka-gumi.
t66788.tmdb_overview_en: A high-school girl inherits a declining yakuza organization, which seeks to repair its fortunes under her leadership.
t66788.tmdb_overview_jp: 四人しか子分のいない小さなヤクザ、目高組の親分が跡目は血縁者にと遺言を残して死んだ。その頃、女高生の星泉は、成田空港の前で車に轢かれて死んだ父・貴志と火葬場で最後の別れを惜しんでいた。泉の母はずっと昔に亡くなって、これで彼女は本当の一人ぼっちだ。泉がマンションに帰ると、マユミという女がおり、彼女は「もし自分が死んだら泉をよろしく」という父の手紙を持っていた。翌日、黒いスーツを着こんだ大勢の男たちが学校の前に並んでいる。泉のとりまき、智生、哲夫、周平が止めるのを無視して、泉は校門に向った。すると、あの火葬場にいた男が歩み出て「星泉さんですね」と言う。佐久間というその男に汚ない事務所に連れていかれた泉は、そこで、目高組四代目組長を襲名してほしいと頼まれた。

t155509.movie_title: 『麻雀放浪記』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t155509.synopsis_en: In Ueno just after Japan's defeat in the war. One day, a young man named Tetsu unexpectedly runs into Joshu Tora, who once taught him how to gamble. Led by Tora into the Chinchiro slums, Tetsu bets his last bit of money on a game run by Dosa Ken, a professional gambler. He wins a considerable amount, but most of it is taken by Dosa Ken as a coaching fee.
t155509.tmdb_overview_en: A mahjong neophyte loses everything to game master only to hone his skills, take on all challenges and plan for an ultimate revenge match.
t155509.tmdb_overview_jp: 敗戦直後の上野。青年・哲は、ある日、以前バクチを教えてくれた上州虎と偶然会う。虎に連れられチンチロ部落に足を踏み入れた哲は、なけなしの金でプロのバクチ打ちであるドサ健の張りにノッた。おかげで相当勝ったが、その大半をコーチ料としてドサ健にとられてしまう。

t422956.synopsis_en: Murayama Takashi, who suffered from a serious illness since early childhood, discovers shogi during repeated hospitalizations and, at age 15, becomes a disciple of Mori Nobuo. Ten years later, Takashi moves to Tokyo to fulfill his dream of becoming a Meijin champion. Supported by those around him, he devotes himself fully to shogi, and after reaching the rank of 7-dan, he develops a fierce rivalry with Habu Yoshiharu, who won the Meijin title in the same generation. Takashi immerses himself even deeper in shogi, but cancer gradually consumes his body...
t422956.tmdb_overview_en: Satoshi Murayama, the shogi (Japanese chess) master known as the arch-rival of Yoshiharu Habu, the shogi genius of the century, died of an intractable disease at age 29. Satoshi devoted his life to fighting not only the disease but also his rivals, feverishly pursuing the highest title, at risk to his life. Director Yoshitaka Mori (Hyakuhachi (2008), Space Brothers (2012)) depicts Murayama's true struggling life, full of love from his parents and teacher, based on the non-fiction novel written by Yoshio Osaki. Kenichi Matsuyama intensely portrays Satoshi and physically embodies the character.
t422956.tmdb_overview_jp: 幼少期から難病を患う村山聖は、入退院を繰り返す中で将棋と出会い、15歳で森信雄に師事する。10年後、名人になる夢をかなえるべく上京した聖は周囲に支えられながら将棋に全力を注ぎ、七段に昇段したころ、同世代で名人のタイトルを獲得した羽生善治に激しいライバル心を抱く。さらに将棋に没頭する聖だったが、がんが彼の体をむしばんでいく……。

t488.director: ジョン・ヒューストン
t488.synopsis: 「マルタの鷹」などの巨匠ジョン・ヒューストンが、イギリスの小説家セシル・スコット・フォレスターの同名冒険小説を映画化。 第1次世界大戦中のアフリカ。イギリス人のローズは宣教師の兄サミュエルと共に布教活動に励んでいたが、滞在している村がドイツ軍に襲撃され、そのショックからサミュエルが命を落としてしまう。ひとり残されたローズは、村に食糧や郵便などを届けにきていたチャーリーに助けられ、彼が船長を務めるおんぼろ蒸気船「アフリカの女王号」に乗り込む。チャーリーは戦争が終わるまで仕事を休もうと考えていたが、復讐に燃えるローズに強引に誘われ、たったふたりでドイツ軍に反撃するべく行動を開始する。 「カサブランカ」「マルタの鷹」のハンフリー・ボガートが、それまでのハードボイルドなイメージとは正反対の粗野な船長チャーリーを好演し、1952年・第24回アカデミー賞で主演男優賞を受賞。「招かれざる客」「フィラデルフィア物語」などのキャサリン・ヘップバーンがローズを演じた。1990年には、本作の波乱に満ちた撮影の舞台裏をクリント・イーストウッド監督・主演で映画化した「ホワイトハンター　ブラックハート」が製作された。
t488.synopsis_en: Master filmmaker John Huston, known for 'The Maltese Falcon,' adapts the classic adventure novel of the same name by British author C.S. Forester. Africa during World War I. Rose, a British woman, is engaged in missionary work with her brother Samuel, a clergyman, but their village is attacked by German forces, and Samuel dies from the shock. Left alone, Rose is rescued by Charlie, who delivers supplies and mail to the village, and boards his ramshackle steamboat, the 'African Queen.' Charlie had planned to take a break from work until the war ended, but is reluctantly persuaded by the vengeful Rose, and the two of them set out to strike back at the Germans. Humphrey Bogart, of 'Casablanca' and 'The Maltese Falcon,' gives a memorable performance as the rough-hewn captain Charlie, a complete departure from his usual hard-boiled image, winning the Academy Award for Best Actor at the 24th Academy Awards in 1952. Katharine Hepburn, of 'Guess Who's Coming to Dinner' and 'The Philadelphia Story,' plays Rose. In 1990, the tumultuous behind-the-scenes story of this film's production was itself dramatized in 'White Hunter Black Heart,' directed by and starring Clint Eastwood.
t488.tmdb_overview_en: At the start of the First World War, in the middle of Africa’s nowhere, a gin soaked riverboat captain is persuaded by a strong-willed missionary to go down river and face-off a German warship.
t488.tmdb_overview_jp: 第一次大戦下の東アフリカ。船長チャーリーと宣教師の妹ローズを乗せた蒸気船“アフリカの女王”号は河を下っていくが、彼らの行く手には激流や大瀑布、そしてドイツの戦艦が待ち受けていた！ C・S・フォレスターの冒険小説を、H・ボガートとK・ヘプバーンという見事なキャスティングでJ・ヒューストンが映画化した傑作ロマン活劇。

t26347.director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
t26347.synopsis: フランスの巨匠ジャン＝リュック・ゴダールが、紛争により破壊されたサラエボの街を舞台に、世界平和への祈りを込めて撮りあげた長編劇映画。ダンテの叙事詩「神曲」を下敷きに、「地獄編」「煉獄編」「天国編」の3部構成で描き出す。 講演のためサラエボの街を訪れたゴダール監督は、復興途上の街に歴史の結節点を見いだす。それは人類の争いと虐殺の歴史でもあった。ゴダール監督はイスラエルとパレスチナ、ユダヤとイスラムの非対称性を例にとり、世界を支配する対立構造について語る。「地獄編」は戦争映像のモンタージュで構成、「煉獄編」では講演でサラエボに招かれたゴダール監督と女子学生オルガとの交流を描き、「天国編」ではこの世を去ったオルガがたどり着いた安息の世界を映し出す。 ゴダール監督が本人役で出演するほか、パレスチナの詩人マフムード・ダーウィッシュ、スペイン出身の小説家フアン・ゴイティソーロらが実名で登場。特集上映企画「21世紀のジャン＝リュック・ゴダール　わたしたちの映画 2001-2010」（2026年6月20日～、シアター・イメージフォーラム渋谷ほか全国順次公開）にて、4K修復版を国内初上映。
t26347.synopsis_en: A feature film by French master Jean-Luc Godard, shot in the war-torn city of Sarajevo as a prayer for world peace. Based on Dante's epic poem 'The Divine Comedy,' it is structured in three parts: 'Hell,' 'Purgatory,' and 'Paradise.' Visiting Sarajevo for a lecture, Godard finds a historical crossroads in the rebuilding city, which is also a history of human conflict and massacre. Using the asymmetry between Israel and Palestine, and Judaism and Islam as examples, Godard discusses the dominant structures of conflict in the world. 'Hell' is composed of montages of war footage; 'Purgatory' depicts the interaction between Godard, invited to Sarajevo for a lecture, and a female student named Olga; and 'Paradise' shows the peaceful world Olga reaches after her death. Godard appears as himself, along with Palestinian poet Mahmoud Darwish and Spanish novelist Juan Goytisolo, who appear under their real names. The 4K restored version will be screened in Japan for the first time as part of the special screening series 'Jean-Luc Godard in the 21st Century: Our Films 2001-2010' (starting June 20, 2026, at Theater Image Forum Shibuya and other locations nationwide).
t26347.tmdb_overview_en: A three-chapter (Hell, Purgatory and Paradise) meditation on the city of Sarajevo in the wake of the Bosnian war, on Palestine and Israel, and on war itself.
t26347.tmdb_overview_jp: 物語の舞台は2001年アメリカ同時多発テロ事件後の現代。巨匠ジャン＝リュック・ゴダールが紛争によって破壊された街サラエヴォを舞台に、世界平和への祈りをダンテ「神曲」を下敷きに「地獄篇」「煉獄篇」「天国篇」の３章構成で紡ぎ出してゆく。

t8073.movie_title: ＜エッセンシャル・ヌーヴェルヴァーグ＞ はなればなれに　2K修復版
t8073.director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
t8073.synopsis_en: A masterpiece from Jean-Luc Godard's early period, this melodrama is based on an American crime novel and depicts in comedic fashion the love triangle and criminal scheme involving two men and one woman. Winter in Paris. Franz and Arthur, best friends with completely opposite personalities, both fall in love at first sight with Odile, a beautiful and shy woman from Scandinavia. One day, they learn that a large sum of money is hidden in Odile's aunt's house, and the three plot to steal it, but the plan takes unexpected twists and turns... This was the first production from "Anouchka Films," the production company founded by Godard and actress Anna Karina, who played Odile and were married at the time. Music by Michel Legrand of "The Umbrellas of Cherbourg." It went unreleased in Japanese theaters for many years before finally premiering in 2001.
t8073.tmdb_overview_en: Cinephile slackers Franz and Arthur spend their days mimicking the antiheroes of Hollywood noirs and Westerns while pursuing the lovely Odile. The misfit trio upends convention at every turn, be it through choreographed dances in cafés or frolicsome romps through the Louvre. Eventually, their romantic view of outlaws pushes them to plan their own heist, but their inexperience may send them out in a blaze of glory -- which could be just what they want.

t632.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t632.synopsis_en: Based on a hit Broadway play set in a Nazi-guarded American POW camp. With everyone's cooperation, two prisoners attempting to escape are shot dead. Suspicions arise among the group that there is a traitor, and the lone wolf Sefton is immediately eyed with distrust. Sefton tries to clear his name by searching for the German spy... Lead actor William Holden joined the ranks of Oscar-winning actors with this film and went on to achieve remarkable success. However, he tragically died in an accident in 1981.
t632.tmdb_overview_en: After two American prisoners are killed by guards in the act of escaping from a German POW camp in World War II, barracks black marketeer J.J. Sefton is suspected of being an informer.
t632.tmdb_overview_jp: 第二次大戦下、スイス国境近くにあるドイツ軍の第１７捕虜収容所。米空軍の軍曹ばかりが集められた第４キャンプでは、地下通路を掘る脱走計画が極秘裏に着々と進行していた。そしてクリスマス直前のある夜、ついに２人の捕虜が脱走を試みる。しかし、情報が事前に洩れたのか、待ち伏せにあった彼らは射殺されてしまう。どうやら仲間内にスパイがいるらしいと囁かれ、何事にも抜け目なく立ち回るセフトンが真っ先に疑われる。

t29884.movie_title_en: The Professor and the Burlesque Queen
t29884.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t29884.synopsis_en: At the Totten Foundation in New York, eight scholars are putting the finishing touches on an encyclopedia, but when grammar professor Potts overhears a slang term, he realizes their work has been isolated from the real world and ventures into the city to investigate. There, he seeks the help of O'Shea, a nightclub singer... Although the film was a hit in the U.S. upon release, it was never imported due to the times. Billy Wilder contributed to the script on the condition that he be allowed to observe Hawks' direction. He made his directorial debut the following year, having used this as preparation.
t29884.tmdb_overview_en: A group of academics have spent years shut up in a house working on the definitive encyclopedia. When one of them discovers that his entry on slang is hopelessly outdated, he ventures into the wide world to learn about the evolving language. Here he meets Sugarpuss O’Shea, a nightclub singer, who’s on top of all the slang—and, it just so happens, needs a place to stay.

nナム・ジュン・パイク 月は最古のTV.movie_title_jp: ナム・ジュン・パイク　月は最古のTV
nナム・ジュン・パイク 月は最古のTV.synopsis: 「ビデオアートの父」と称される現代美術家ナム・ジュン・パイクのドキュメンタリー。 アートとテクノロジーの境界を破壊し、インターネットが普及するはるか前にデジタル社会の到来を予見したナム・ジュン・パイク。彼が遺したパフォーマンス映像や手記など膨大なアーカイブ資料をひもときながら、韓国から日本、ドイツ、アメリカへと渡り歩いた人生と、先駆的な活動やビジョンに迫る。人々の想像を超える彼のアートがどのように当時の大衆文化と交差していったのかを描くとともに、彼の人生を変えた前衛音楽家ジョン・ケージとの出会い、ヨーゼフ・ボイスやシャーロット・モーマンとの過激なコラボレーションなど、1960～70年代にかけてのパフォーマンス・アートのムーブメントとの深い関わりを浮き彫りにしていく。 坂本龍一がテーマ音楽を手がけ、「ミナリ」「バーニング　劇場版」の俳優スティーブン・ユァンが手記の朗読を担当。特集上映企画「パフォーマンス・アート：身体と空間をめぐる映画祭」（2026年8月1日～、ユーロスペースほか全国順次公開）にて日本初公開。
nナム・ジュン・パイク 月は最古のTV.synopsis_en: A documentary about Nam June Paik, the contemporary artist known as the 'father of video art'. Nam June Paik destroyed the boundaries between art and technology, foreseeing the arrival of the digital society long before the internet became widespread. The film unravels his life journey from Korea to Japan, Germany, and the United States, as well as his pioneering activities and vision, by exploring a vast archive of materials including his performance videos and writings. It depicts how his art, which surpassed people's imagination, intersected with the popular culture of the time, and highlights his deep involvement with the performance art movement of the 1960s and 1970s, including his life-changing encounter with avant-garde musician John Cage and radical collaborations with Joseph Beuys and Charlotte Moorman. Ryuichi Sakamoto composed the theme music, and Steven Yeun, the actor from 'Minari' and 'Burning', narrates the writings. The film will have its Japanese premiere as part of the special screening project 'Performance Art: A Film Festival Around Body and Space' (starting August 1, 2026, at Eurospace and other theaters nationwide).

t2671.synopsis_en: Reiko Asakawa, a TV station director, is investigating an urban legend when she notices that a man and woman rumored to have been involved with a 'cursed videotape' that kills viewers within a week died at the exact same date and time as her niece, Tomoko Oishi, who had died strangely a few days earlier. As her investigation progresses, Reiko discovers that Tomoko and the other three who died simultaneously were acquaintances, that they had stayed at a rental villa in Izu called 'Izu Pacific Land' a week prior, and that the faces of the four in film photos taken at that time are eerily distorted. Seeking to uncover the mystery of their deaths, Reiko visits the villa in question, watches the suspicious tape that was rented there, and immediately receives an eerie silent phone call. From that point on, Reiko's own photos also begin to show her face distorted, just like the four deceased.
t2671.tmdb_overview_en: A mysterious video has been linked to a number of deaths, and when an inquisitive journalist finds the tape and views it herself, she sets in motion a chain of events that puts her own life in danger.
t2671.tmdb_overview_jp: 某テレビ局のディレクターである浅川玲子は、都市伝説にまつわる取材の中で、見た者を1週間後に死に至らしめる「呪いのビデオ」に関わったと噂される男女が、数日前に奇怪な死を遂げた自分の姪、大石智子と同日の同時刻に死亡していることに気づく。調査を進めた玲子は、同時に死んだ智子たち4人の間には交友関係があり、彼らが1週間前に伊豆の貸し別荘「伊豆パシフィックランド」に宿泊していたこと、そしてその際に撮影されたフィルム写真上の4人の顔が不気味に歪んでいることに着目する。彼らの死の謎を突きとめようとして問題の貸し別荘を訪れた玲子は、そこで貸出されていた不審なビデオの映像を見てしまい、直後に不気味な無言電話を受け取る。これを境に、玲子自身の写真もまた死んだ4人と同様に歪んだ顔で写るようになってしまう。

t226860.synopsis_en: After learning that his old friend Sakaguchi had attacked the president of Shimogata Construction and been arrested, Shindo returned to a small port town in Okinawa. Shimogata Construction was in charge of the town's redevelopment and had been harassing and threatening Sakaguchi to force him to sell his hotel. Shindo stayed at the hotel, the "Free Inn," and began investigating the incident. Meeting Shimogata's development chief Takabatake and Detective Tokuda, who was colluding with Shimogata, Shindo uncovered the truth: Sakaguchi had stormed Shimogata Construction to rescue his kidnapped son, Ryuta. Shindo also learned that Sakaguchi was suffering from cancer and had only a few months to live.
t226860.tmdb_overview_en: A man returns to his seaside roots to confront a yakuza boss. Along the way, he charms young men, softens a hard woman and busts a few heads.
t226860.tmdb_overview_jp: 旧友の坂口が下山建設の社長に襲いかかって逮捕されたことを知り、新藤は沖縄の小さな港町に帰ってきた。下山建設は町の再開発を担当しており、坂口が経営するホテルを買収しようと嫌がらせや脅迫を続けていたのだ。新藤はそのホテル〈フリーイン〉に泊まり、事件を探り始めた。下山建設の高畠開発部長や、下山と癒着している徳田刑事などに会い、新藤は事件の真相を知った。坂口は、誘拐された一人息子の竜太を助けようとして、下山建設に乗り込んだのだった。そして新藤は、坂口が癌に冒され、余命数ヶ月であることを知る。

t76715.movie_title: 『犬神家の一族』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t76715.synopsis_en: The will of the old family patriarch Saibee Inugami is made public, but it states that the heir to the vast fortune is the one who marries Tamayo Nonomiya, the granddaughter of Saibee's mentor. Saibee's three grandsons each scheme to claim Tamayo for themselves, but this soon escalates into a series of murders...
t76715.tmdb_overview_en: When a tycoon passes away, he unexpectedly leaves the family fortune to outsider Tamayo on the condition that she marries one of the grandsons, pitting blood against blood.
t76715.tmdb_overview_jp: 旧家の名士犬神佐兵衛の遺言状が公開されるが、莫大な遺産の相続者は佐兵衛の恩師の孫娘である野々宮珠世と結婚した者と記されていた。佐兵衛の孫にあたる3人の男はそれぞれ珠世を我が物にしようと企むのだが、やがてそれは連続殺人事件へと発展していく……。

t547151.movie_title: 『汚れた英雄』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t547151.synopsis_en: The International A-Class 500cc final (All-Japan Road Race Championship, Round 8) is held at the UGO Circuit. The fateful showdown between bike racers Akio Kitano and Keishi Oki ends just before the finish line when Oki overtakes Kitano, pushing the decisive battle to the final round. Kitano uses his handsome looks and sexual prowess to secure funding from multiple patrons to maintain his team. When Christine Adams, heir to a billion-dollar fortune and owner of an international conglomerate, arrives in Japan, Kitano quickly approaches her and successfully secures funding. Finally, Kitano faces the final race, but...
t547151.tmdb_overview_en: The 8th All-Japan Road Race Championship. The internationally ranked A-level SUGO circuit is on the edge of its seat as the 500 cc final draws near.  Akio Kitano and Keishi Ooki face off: private team versus factory team. In the final lap, Akio is overtaken by Ooki and loses by a hair. The reason for his defeat? The difference between their two machines. With their scores tied, the two wait for the next match to settle the score for good.
t547151.tmdb_overview_jp: UGOサーキットで国際A級500cc決勝(全日本選手権ロードレース第8戦)が開催。バイクレーサー北野晶夫と大木圭史の宿命の対決は、ゴール直前で北野が大木に追い抜かれて終了、勝負は最終戦にもつれ込んだ。北野はその美貌とセックステクニックを駆使し、複数のパトロンからチーム維持のための資金を得ていた。10億ドルの遺産を引き継ぎ国際的なコングロマリットのオーナーになったクリスティーン・アダムスが来日すると、北野はさっそく彼女に接近し、見事に資金を調達するのだった。そして北野はついに最終戦を迎えるのだが…。

t16090.tmdb_overview_en: Soon after a veteran returns from war, his cheating wife is found dead. He evades police in an attempt to find the real murderer.

t54083.movie_title: ゴダール・ソシアリスム
t54083.movie_title_jp: ゴダール・ソシアリスム
t54083.clean_title_jp: ゴダール・ソシアリスム
t54083.director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
t54083.synopsis: フランスの巨匠ジャン＝リュック・ゴダールが、圧倒的映像美と卓越した編集で現代ヨーロッパを描いた映像詩。ゴダール監督が前作「アワーミュージック」から6年ぶりに手がけた長編作品で、同監督作として初めて全編デジタルで撮影された。 地中海を周遊する豪華客船を舞台に、スペイン内戦時に行方不明となった黄金をめぐる人間模様を描く第1楽章「こんな事ども」、フランスの片田舎に暮らす一家が織りなす政治喜劇の第2楽章「どこへ行く、ヨーロッパ」、人類の歴史にまつわる6つの土地をめぐる歴史と文化の考察を、無数の引用とコラージュで展開する第3楽章「われら人類」で構成。さまざまな映像フォーマットを駆使し、映像・言葉・音・さらにデジタルノイズまでをも自由自在に取り込みながら、圧倒的な密度と速度で反骨精神たっぷりに描き出す。 ミュージシャンのパティ・スミス、ギタリストのレニー・ケイ、哲学者のアラン・バディウらが本人役で出演。特集上映企画「21世紀のジャン＝リュック・ゴダール　わたしたちの映画 2001-2010」（2026年6月20日〜、シアター・イメージフォーラム渋谷ほか全国順次公開）上映作品。
t54083.synopsis_en: A visual poem by French master Jean-Luc Godard, depicting modern Europe with overwhelming visual beauty and masterful editing. It is Godard's first feature film shot entirely in digital, his first in six years since 'Our Music.' Set on a luxury cruise ship touring the Mediterranean, it consists of three movements: the first movement 'Such Things' depicts human drama over gold lost during the Spanish Civil War; the second movement 'Where to, Europe' is a political comedy about a family living in the French countryside; and the third movement 'We Humans' explores history and culture across six locations related to human history, using countless quotations and collages. Utilizing various video formats and freely incorporating images, words, sounds, and even digital noise, it is depicted with overwhelming density and speed, full of rebellious spirit. Musician Patti Smith, guitarist Lenny Kaye, and philosopher Alain Badiou appear as themselves. Screened as part of the special screening series 'Jean-Luc Godard in the 21st Century: Our Films 2001-2010' (starting June 20, 2026, at Theater Image Forum Shibuya and other locations nationwide).
t54083.tmdb_overview_en: A symphony in three movements. Things such as a Mediterranean cruise, numerous conversations, in numerous languages, between the passengers, almost all of whom are on holiday... Our Europe. At night, a sister and her younger brother have summoned their parents to appear before the court of their childhood. The children demand serious explanations of the themes of Liberty, Equality and Fraternity. Our humanities. Visits to six sites of true or false myths: Egypt, Palestine, Odessa, Hellas, Naples and Barcelona.

nヒット・パレード.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
nヒット・パレード.synopsis_en: A remake of "Ball of Fire." Danny Kaye plays the role originally played by Gary Cooper, changed here to a musicologist. The rare words of the original become rare music (jazz) in this version, and the film's appeal is also enhanced by gathering many top musicians of the time. It is said that as many as eight writers were involved in completing the script for the remake, yet not a single name appears in the credits. Hawks had no interest in this project, but the box office performance was favorable.

n男の魂.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集

t6620.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t6620.synopsis_en: A romantic comedy directed by Billy Wilder, starring Audrey Hepburn in the year following "Roman Holiday." Sabrina, the daughter of a chauffeur serving the wealthy Larrabee family, falls in love with the family's younger son. To make her forget this hopeless love, her father and fellow servants send Sabrina to Paris. Two years later, Sabrina returns as a refined lady, and her transformation is so complete that the younger son and his brother fail to recognize her as the chauffeur's daughter. In 2013, a digitally remastered version was released as part of the special screening series "Screen Beauties Vol. 1: Audrey Hepburn."
t6620.tmdb_overview_en: After two years in Paris, chauffeur's daughter Sabrina returns home elegantly transformed and immediately catches the attention of David, the playboy son of her father's rich employers. David woos and wins Sabrina, who has always been in love with him, however their romance is threatened by David's serious older brother Linus, who runs the family business and is relying on David to marry an heiress in order for a crucial merger to take place.
t6620.tmdb_overview_jp: オードリー・ヘプバーンによるロマンチックコメディー。名匠ビリー・ワイルダーがサミュエル・テイラーの戯曲「サブリナ・フェア」を映画化した。大富豪の兄弟と、美しく変身したお抱え運転手の娘との恋を描く。  大富豪ララビー家のお抱え運転手の娘サブリナ（オードリー・ヘプバーン）が、主の次男デイヴィッド（ウィリアム・ホールデン）に恋心を抱くも、彼女の父は身分違いの恋を忘れさせるため娘をパリへ送り出す。2年後、洗練された淑女に変身した彼女が帰国すると、デイヴィッドはすっかり夢中に。婚約中の弟を案じる長男ライナス（ハンフリー・ボガート）は、やがて自分はサブリナが好きなことに気付き……。

n国境の南.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集

t1728113.director: ナディア・ハルグレン
t1728113.synopsis: グラミー賞に2度ノミネートされたグローバルガールズグループ「KATSEYE（キャッツアイ）」の歩みを追った音楽ドキュメンタリー。オーディション番組から世界的なポップスターへと駆け上がった彼女たちと、ファンダム「EYEKONS（アイコンズ）」との絆を描く。 HYBEとゲフィン・レコードによるオーディション番組「The Debut: Dream Academy」から誕生した、国も文化も異なるメンバーで構成されるKATSEYE。本作では、オーディションでの張り詰めたプレッシャーから、デビューを経てチャートを席巻するまでの道のりの中で彼女たちが経験してきた高揚、挫折、犠牲、そして飛躍の瞬間を描き出す。未公開映像やメンバーへのインタビュー、ファンによる映像を織り交ぜながら、グループ誕生の軌跡と、その歩みを支えてきたファンの姿を映し出していく。 監督は、KATSEYEの結成を追ったNetflixのドキュメンタリーシリーズ「ポップスター・アカデミー: KATSEYEになるまで」を手がけたナディア・ハルグレン。日本では2026年8月12日と15日を中心に、期間限定で劇場公開される。
t1728113.synopsis_en: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS offers an intimate look at the group's bold new era and serves as a tribute to the fans who have supported their journey. Through never-before-seen footage, fan videos created by the fandom EYEKONS, and candid interviews with the members, the film portrays the strong bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who have helped build the KATSEYE movement, the film reflects that this group's story is only just beginning. The documentary also captures the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments KATSEYE experienced on their path to becoming global pop stars—from the intense pressure of the HYBE and Geffen Records audition program The Debut: Dream Academy to topping the charts. Praised by media outlets including The New York Times, Vogue, Rolling Stone, and Billboard, KATSEYE has solidified its global presence as one of the most exciting new-generation global acts in pop through relentless effort and stunning live performances. The team behind Netflix's documentary series Pop Star Academy: KATSEYE returns for this film, produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures in partnership with HYBE x GEFFEN. Nadia Hallgren, who also directed the series, serves as director.
t1728113.tmdb_overview_en: This celebrates the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

t66105.movie_title: 聖闘士星矢 真紅の少年伝説
t66105.movie_title_jp: 聖闘士星矢 真紅の少年伝説
t66105.movie_title_en: Saint Seiya: Legend of Crimson Youth
t66105.clean_title_jp: 聖闘士星矢 真紅の少年伝説
t66105.movie_title_original: 聖闘士星矢 真紅の少年伝説
t66105.synopsis: 劇場版3作目。強大な力を持つ太陽神アベルが復活し、その妹アテナは一緒に戦ってきた主人公たちを捨ててアベルと共に去る。いつもは活発な主人公が涙を流す演出は、少年の純真さや脆さを強調している。TVアニメで死亡した5人の「黄金聖闘士」たちが復活するのも見どころ。「週刊少年ジャンプ」創刊20周年として75分の拡大版となり『魁!! 男塾』と併映された。
t66105.synopsis_en: The third theatrical film. The immensely powerful sun god Abel is resurrected, and his sister Athena abandons the protagonists who have fought alongside her to leave with Abel. The scene where the usually energetic protagonist sheds tears emphasizes the boy's purity and fragility. The revival of the five "Gold Saints" who died in the TV anime is also a highlight. As part of the 20th anniversary of "Weekly Shōnen Jump," this was released as a 75-minute extended version, double-billed with "Sakigake!! Otokojuku."
t66105.tmdb_overview_en: The Sun God Abel returns to life, bent on punishing the humans and cleansing Earth from their presence. When Athena joins him, leaving humans to their fate, the Bronze Saints must defend the world in their greatest battle yet.
t66105.tmdb_overview_jp: アテナの兄、伝説の太陽神アベルが復活。地上世界を神々の手に委ねるため、大洪水を起こして人類を粛清することを目論む。それを阻止せんとしたアテナ・城戸沙織は、逆にアベルの手により死の国へ墜とされてしまう。アテナを救うために聖域の禁断の地ディグニティヒルに乗り込む星矢たちだが、彼らの行く手を十二宮戦で死んだはずのサガたち黄金聖闘士、そして神話の時代からアベルを守るコロナの聖闘士たちが阻む。かつてない強敵を迎え、星矢たちの最大の激戦が始まる。

t83091.movie_title: 聖闘士星矢／聖闘士星矢 神々の熱き戦い
t83091.movie_title_jp: 聖闘士星矢 神々の熱き戦い
t83091.movie_title_en: Saint Seiya: The Heated Battle of the Gods
t83091.clean_title_jp: 聖闘士星矢 神々の熱き戦い
t83091.movie_title_original: 聖闘士星矢 神々の熱き戦い
t83091.synopsis: 星座の鎧をまとった「聖闘士」たちが女神アテナのために闘う。荒木伸吾と姫野美智のデザインによる美しく誇張の効いた身体に加え、透過光などの豪華な画面効果を伴う必殺技、スピード感のあるアクションと情感の演出、劇伴のオーケストラなどで、1980年代のアクションアニメの代表的作品となった。劇場版1作目はTVのシリーズディレクター森下孝三が監督し、邪神エリスの復活を描いた。
t83091.synopsis_en: Warriors clad in constellational armor, the 'Saints,' fight for the goddess Athena. With beautifully exaggerated bodies designed by Shingo Araki and Michi Himeno, special moves accompanied by lavish screen effects like transmitted light, fast-paced action, emotional direction, and an orchestral score, it became a representative action anime of the 1980s. The first theatrical film was directed by TV series director Toshio Morishita and depicts the resurrection of the evil god Eris.
t83091.tmdb_overview_en: Hyoga is missing somewhere in Asgard... When Seiya and the others are looking for him, Athena is kidnapped and they have to rescue her from Dolvar and some mysterious warriors.
t83091.tmdb_overview_jp: シベリアの氷原で謎の兵士たちに襲われていた赤ひげの兵士を助けた氷河は、神々の戦いが始まるというアスガルドの地の名を聞き、北欧アスガルドへ調査を向かう。彼を追って沙織や星矢たちもアスガルドへ向かうが、氷河は消息を絶ち、アスガルドのドルバル教主は聖域支配を目論んでいた。ドルバルの魔手により異次元へ封印されてしまう沙織。星矢たちは沙織の救出に向かうが、その前にアスガルドの戦士・神闘士たちが立ち塞がる。神の国の壮絶な激闘が始まろうとしていた。

t466207.tmdb_overview_en: Japanese soldiers stranded in Manokwari, New Guinea, improvise a theater play to keep their spirits up and endure the extremely difficult conditions.

t582577.tmdb_overview_en: Fukuzo, Kato and Matsuko, Kato's wife, are operating the "Kurenai Sightseeing Service" in Tokyo. Fukuzo and Kato were comrades during the war. One day Fukuzo guides Harumi, an old woman, to the Yasukuni Shrine where the souls of fallen soldiers are enshrined. Finding she has no place to go, Fukuzo carries her to his shack by the sea.

t270055.synopsis_en: From naval academy to the skies of the South Seas, and now having survived to set foot on his homeland's soil, Reikichi's only thought has been his beloved Michiko. Through rumors, he heard she had lost her husband to death and moved to Tokyo. Reikichi moves to Tokyo and stays in the apartment of his younger brother Yo, a book broker, and while working as a ghostwriter of love letters for mistresses through the help of his war comrade Yamaji, he searches for Michiko's whereabouts. The day that compressed five years into an instant finally arrives. Michiko comes to him to request ghostwriting of a love letter, just like any other 'panpan' girl. Reikichi, who had cherished the image of pure Michiko, lashes out with harsh words at the Michiko before him. From then on, Reikichi spends days of drunken agony torn between love and hatred for Michiko. Yo, who vaguely senses his brother's feelings, consults Yamaji and meets Michiko. After her husband's death in the war, unable to stay in her stepmother's home, she worked with the occupation forces in Yokohama, and out of loneliness began living with a kind foreign officer—but she was not living a dissolute life like so-called 'panpan' girls, and had since parted with that officer. Yo and Yamaji arrange for Michiko and Reikichi to meet, but Reikichi refuses. Knowing Reikichi's heart that will not forgive her, Michiko throws herself into oncoming traffic amid tangled headlights. Told by police of her serious injury, Reikichi realizes that regardless of her past mistakes, she is precious to him. In the car racing to the hospital, Reikichi sobs and prays to God for Michiko's life.
t270055.tmdb_overview_en: A sad and troubled man finds a new job five years after the end of WWII, where he writes love letters for other people.
t270055.tmdb_overview_jp: 兵学校から南海の空へ、そして今生きのびて故国の土を踏んだ礼吉がただ一つ思いしめて来たのは最愛の人道子だった。風の便りに彼女は夫と死に別れ上京しているとは聞いていたが。礼吉は上京して書籍ブローカーの弟洋のアパートへ身を寄せ、戦友山路の世話で洋妾の恋文代筆業をしながら、道子の行方を求めた。五年の歳月を一瞬にかけた日はとうとうやって来た。道子が彼の許へ他のパンパンと同じ様に恋文の代筆を依頼に来たのである。清純な道子の姿を思い抱いていた礼吉は、眼前の道子についきつい言葉を言い放った。それからの礼吉は道子への愛と憎しみに悶える泥酔の日々が続いた。兄の気持をうすうす知った洋は山路に相談して道子に会った。夫の戦死後、継母の家に居たたまれなかった彼女は、横浜の進駐軍関係に勤める中、孤独の淋しさから親切な外国士官と生活を共にするようになったが、所謂パンパンの様な荒んだ生活をしていたわけではなく、今はその士官とも別れていた。洋と山路は道子と礼吉が会う手筈まで整えたが、礼吉は拒んだ。飽くまで自分を許してくれない礼吉の心を知った道子は錯綜するヘッドライトの中に身を投げた。彼女の重傷を警察から知らされた礼吉は、彼女の過去の過失にかかわらず自分にとって大切な人である事に気がついた。一路病院へと急ぐ車の中で、礼吉は号泣しながら道子の命を神に念じていた。

t382170.movie_title: リップヴァンウィンクルの花嫁
t382170.movie_title_jp: リップヴァンウィンクルの花嫁
t382170.movie_title_en: A Bride for Rip Van Winkle
t382170.clean_title_jp: リップヴァンウィンクルの花嫁
t382170.movie_title_original: リップヴァンウィンクルの花嫁
t382170.synopsis_en: Nanami Minagawa, a temporary teacher in Tokyo, meets Tetsuya on social media and marries him. She hires Amaru, a jack-of-all-trades, to provide stand-in guests for the wedding ceremony. However, Tetsuya's affair soon comes to light. Then Nanami is accused by her mother-in-law of having an affair herself and is forced to leave the house. Amaru introduces Nanami to jobs as a stand-in wedding guest and as a live-in maid with a monthly salary of 1 million yen. There she meets her fellow maid, the unconventional and free-spirited Mashiro Satonaka.
t382170.tmdb_overview_en: A woman hires actors and strangers to pretend to be her friends and family at her wedding.
t382170.tmdb_overview_jp: 東京で派遣教員をしている皆川七海は、鉄也とSNSで知り合った後に結婚。結婚式の代理出席をなんでも屋の安室に頼む。しかし、間もなく鉄也の浮気が明るみに。ところが七海が浮気をしたと義母に責められ、家を出ていくことになる。そんな七海に安室が結婚式の代理出席や月給100万円の住み込みメイドのアルバイトを紹介。そこでメイド仲間で、型破りで自由な里中真白と出会う。

t31427.synopsis: 小説家・大岡昇平が自身のフィリピンでの戦争体験をもとに執筆した傑作戦争文学を、巨匠・市川崑監督と脚本家・和田夏十のコンビが映画化。第2次世界大戦下のフィリピン・レイテ島を舞台に、肺病におかされた中年兵士が飢餓と孤独に苦しんだ末に目の当たりにする、陰惨な戦場を描き出す。 第2次世界大戦末期のレイテ島。日本の敗戦が濃厚となるなか、肺病を患った一等兵・田村は部隊から追い出され、病院でも食糧不足を理由に入院を断られてしまう。病院の前で、田村は同じく厄介者として見放された若い兵士・永松や、足を負傷し歩けなくなった中年兵・安田と出会う。飢えに駆り立てられるように熱帯のジャングルをさまよう田村は、道中で出会った別の部隊と行動を共にするが、米軍の一斉砲撃により他の兵士が全滅してしまい……。 船越英二が主演を務め、極限状態に追い込まれた兵士役を熱演。1961年・第14回ロカルノ国際映画祭でグランプリに輝いたほか、国内外で数々の映画賞を受賞した。2025年、終戦80年企画として4K版でリバイバル公開。
t31427.synopsis_en: An anti-war film adapted from Shōhei Ōoka's novel of the same name, scripted by Kazuo Wada and directed by Kon Ichikawa. Abandoned by both the hospital and his unit, Tamura wanders the island of Leyte on the Philippine front. He reunites with fellow retreating soldiers in front of a hospital, but when the hospital comes under shelling, Tamura flees alone. With no food and having lost his comrades, Tamura survives by eating grass. Eventually he reunites with his former comrades Nagamatsu and Yasuda, who had been separated from him. The two call the soldiers they killed 'monkeys' and have been eating their flesh...
t31427.tmdb_overview_en: In the closing days of WWII, a Japanese soldier afflicted with tuberculosis is abandoned by his company and left to wander the Philippine island of Leyte.
t31427.tmdb_overview_jp: 大岡昇平の同名小説を、和田夏十が脚色し市川崑が監督した反戦映画。病院にも部隊にも見放された田村は、フィリピン戦線のレイテ島をさまよっていた。同じように敗走している仲間と病院の前で合流するが、その病院が砲撃を受けたため、田村は一人で逃げ出す。食べるものもなく、仲間を失った田村は、草を食べて生き延びていた。やがて生き別れたかつての仲間である永松と安田と再会。二人は殺した味方の兵士を“猿”と称し、その肉を食べていた…。

t360443.tmdb_overview_en: Kikuji is the scion of an Osaka merchant family whose traditional power is matrilineal. Instructed by his overbearing mother and grandmother to give them an heiress for the family business, he stands by helplessly as his wife is thrown out of the house for producing a son. Driven to a life of dissipation - his mistresses also fail to produce daughters - in the end he is just too tired to care.

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t42076.synopsis_en: The destroyer of the universe, "Genma," was approaching Earth. Luna, a princess of Transylvania and an esper, received a message from the cosmic consciousness "Froi" and began a battle to protect Earth alongside Vega, a cyborg soldier also fighting Genma. Luna decided to gather psychics from around the world to counter Genma. Among them was high school student Azuma Higashi, who was unaware of his own abilities until Vega's provocations awakened his psychic powers. However, emotionally immature, he closed his heart to Luna's pleas to join the fight to save the universe. Even so, the enemy appeared before him without mercy.
t42076.tmdb_overview_en: From the depths of space he is coming... Ancient beyond understanding, his power is immeasurable. He has destroyed half the universe and is on his way here. He is… Genma. Only two people are aware of the imminent catastrophe: Princess Luna, a modern day prophetess and Vega, a cybernetic crusader from a world long since ravaged by Genma. Determined to spare the Earth from a similar fate, Luna and Vega must try to mobilize the most potent psychics in the world. Together, this army of fledging psychic warriors must succeed where billions have tried... and failed. But will they be able to gather their champions in time? Genma’s agents are already on Earth to ensure that their master meets with no opposition!
t42076.tmdb_overview_jp: 大宇宙の破壊者“幻魔”が地球に接近しつつあった。宇宙の意識体“フロイ”のメッセージを受け取った、トランシルバニアの王女にしてエスパーの“ルナ”は、やはり幻魔と戦っているというサイボーグ兵“ベガ”と共に地球を守る戦いを開始する。ルナは全世界のサイオニクサー（超能力者）を集め、幻魔に対抗しようと考える。そのうちのひとり、高校生の東丈は自分の能力にまったく気付いていなかったが、ベガの挑発によって超能力を開花させる。しかし、精神的に幼い彼は、宇宙を守る戦いに参加するよう説得するルナに対して心を閉ざしてしまう。そんな彼の元にも敵は容赦なく現れる。

t287765.movie_title: 『人間の証明』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t287765.synopsis_en: A black man is murdered in an elevator at a luxury hotel in Tokyo, leaving behind the word 'Stoha' and a poetry collection by Saijo Yaso. Fashion designer Kyoko Yasugi and her son appear and disappear along the investigative trail. Detective Muneyori travels to the United States to trace the black man's past. The unexpected relationship between Kyoko and the black man, as well as the connection between the American detective and Detective Muneyori, comes to light.
t287765.tmdb_overview_en: When an American is murdered in a Japanese inn, Tokyo police detective Munesue follows the trail of the killer to New York. There he is joined by a New York City detective named Shuftan and together they sort out the crime.
t287765.tmdb_overview_jp: 東京の高級ホテルのエレベーターで黒人男性が殺された。“ストーハ”という言葉と、西条八十の詩集を残して。捜査線上に見え隠れするファッションデザイナー八杉恭子とその息子。黒人男性の過去を追って渡米する棟寄刑事。八杉と黒人男性の意外な関係、そしてアメリカの刑事と棟寄刑事の関係が明らかになる。

t52970.synopsis_en: Kashin Koji, a mysterious man who appears during the Sengoku period, is a master of various mystical arts, and tales of his sightings and experiences are told in many places. He is summoned by the warlord Matsunaga Hisahide. Hisahide harbors a desire for Miyoshi Yoshiyuki's wife, Ukon no Tsubone, and plots to have his way with her. Kashin proposes a plan to create an "lust stone"—an aphrodisiac capable of melting any woman's heart. It is made by having seven ninja monks under Kashin's command rape women and boiling down the resulting fluids. The sheer horror of this plan leaves the assembled Sen no Rikyū and Yagyū Shinzaemon trembling in fear.
t52970.tmdb_overview_en: A fortuneteller prophesizes that whoever marries the beautiful Ukio will become the ruler of the world. Naturally, this makes her very popular with those vying for power, particularly the insatiably greedy Lord Donjo. Only the ninja Jotaro can stop Donjo's plan, but to do so, he must first battle the deadly team of "Devil Monks" serving the lord. Will Jotaro succeed in his mission? And if so, will Ukio marry him, thus making him the ruler of the world?
t52970.tmdb_overview_jp: 戦国の世に現れた謎の男・果心居士。彼は様々な術を操り、その目撃・体験談は多くの場所で語られていた。彼が武将松永弾正のもとに呼び出された。弾正は三好義興の妻・右京太夫に恋心を抱いており、どうにかして彼女を手篭めにしようと企んでいたのだった。そこで果心が提案したのは「淫石」を作るという計画だった。「淫石」とはすなわちどんな女の心も蕩かすという催淫剤のこと。それは、女達を果心の配下である七人の忍法僧が強姦し、そこから得られる愛液を煮詰めることによって作られる。その計画のおぞましさに、居合わせた千宗易、柳生新左衛門は戦慄する。

t829549.director: ニキル・ペールワーニー
t829549.synopsis: ヒンディー語映画として初めてダウン症当時者が主演を務め、ムンバイを舞台にダウン症の青年アハーンの日常をストレートかつコミカルに描いたドラマ。 大都市ムンバイで愛情深い両親と暮らすダウン症の青年アハーン。何不自由ない生活ながらも、周囲の目を気にする両親の“配慮”により家に縛りつけられた日々を過ごす彼は、「自立したい」「仕事を見つけたい」「素敵な女性と結婚したい」という思いを募らせていた。一方、中年男性オジーは気難しい性格と潔癖症のせいで妻アヌに見限られ、家にひとり取り残されてしまう。そんな折、アヌと親交のあるアハーンがオジーの家を訪れる。オジーは妻に会うためアハーンを利用することを思いつき、自由な外出を願うアハーンとの間に奇妙な協力関係が生まれる。 ムンバイ出身のニキル・ペールワーニー監督が長編初メガホンをとり、ダウン症当事者アブリ・ママジが主人公アハーン役で俳優デビューを果たした。日本では、医療・健康領域の書籍を中心に扱う社員2人の小さな出版社「生活の医療株式会社」が配給を担当。同社代表の秋元麦踏氏が国際線の機内上映にて本作を鑑賞して感銘を受け、日本での配給権を取得した。
t829549.synopsis_en:
Ahaan, a young man with Down syndrome, lives in the Indian metropolis of Mumbai with his loving parents. Though he leads a comfortable life, his parents' overprotective "consideration"—born from their concern about how others perceive him—keeps him confined to their home. Deep down, Ahaan harbors a growing, earnest desire to become independent, find a job, and marry a wonderful woman.

Meanwhile, Ozzy, a cantankerous middle-aged man, has been left alone after his wife, Anu, finally had enough of his rigid self-imposed rules and obsessive cleanliness. It is then that Ahaan, who is close friends with Anu, pays a visit to Ozzy’s home. Ozzy hits upon the idea of using Ahaan as a way to get his hands on his wife’s home cooking, and a strange partnership begins to form with Ahaan, who longs for the freedom to go outside...

t18030.director: ロバート・アルドリッチ
t18030.synopsis_en: One night, private detective Mike Hammer picks up a woman named Christina and lets her into his car, but is suddenly attacked by three men and loses consciousness. When he comes to, Mike finds himself in a hospital bed. According to his secretary Velda, Mike and Christina were driven into a river along with the car, and Christina died. Sensing something behind it all, Mike begins to investigate Christina's background.
t18030.tmdb_overview_en: One evening, Hammer gives a ride to Christina, an attractive hitchhiker on a lonely country road, who has escaped from the nearby lunatic asylum. Thugs waylay them and force his car to crash. When Hammer returns to semi-consciousness, he hears Christina being tortured until she dies. Hammer, both for vengeance and in hopes that "something big" is behind it all, decides to pursue the case.
t18030.tmdb_overview_jp: 私立探偵のマイク・ハマーはある夜、クリスティナという女を拾い自分の車に乗せたが、突然3人の男に襲われて意識を失う。 気がつくと、マイクは病院のベッドに寝かされていた。秘書のヴェルダによると、マイクはクリスティナと車もろとも川に落とされ、クリスティナは死んだという。背後に何かがあると感じたマイクは、クリスティナの身辺を洗い始める。

t52717.director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
t52717.synopsis: フランスのヌーベルバーグを牽引した巨匠ジャン＝リュック・ゴダールが、「愛」をテーマに撮りあげたドラマ。 パリの若き芸術家エドガーは、「出会い、情熱、別れ、和解」という愛にまつわる4つの瞬間を、3組のカップルを起用して描く新作を構想する。エドガーがこの企画にふさわしいと考えるヒロイン像は、彼が2年前に出会った女性だった。それはエドガーがブルターニュでレジスタンスの歴史を調べるなかで知り合った、かつてレジスタンスに身を投じた老夫婦の孫娘だった。彼女の姿を追い求めるエドガーは、2年前のブルターニュでの記憶をよみがえらせていく。 前半パートは35ミリフィルムの陰影豊かなモノクロ映像で現在の出来事を描き、後半パートはデジタルビデオを駆使した鮮やかなカラー映像で主人公エドガーの回想を映し出す。特集上映企画「21世紀のジャン＝リュック・ゴダール　わたしたちの映画 2001-2010」（2026年6月20日～、シアター・イメージフォーラム渋谷ほか全国順次公開）にて、4K修復版を国内初上映。
t52717.synopsis_en: A drama by Jean-Luc Godard, the master who led the French New Wave, centered on the theme of 'love.' Edgar, a young artist in Paris, conceives a new work depicting four moments related to love—'encounter, passion, separation, reconciliation'—using three couples. The heroine Edgar considers ideal for this project is a woman he met two years ago. She is the granddaughter of an elderly couple who were once involved in the Resistance, whom Edgar met while researching the history of the Resistance in Brittany. Searching for her, Edgar revives his memories of Brittany two years ago. The first half depicts present events in richly shaded black-and-white 35mm film, while the second half shows protagonist Edgar's flashbacks in vivid color using digital video. The 4K restored version will be screened in Japan for the first time as part of the special screening series 'Jean-Luc Godard in the 21st Century: Our Films 2001-2010' (starting June 20, 2026, at Theater Image Forum Shibuya and other locations nationwide).
t52717.tmdb_overview_en: Someone we hear talking - but whom we do not see - speaks of a project which describes the four key moments of love: meeting, physical passion, arguments/separation and making up. This project is to be told through three couples: young, adult and old. We do not know if the project is for a play, a film, a novel or an opera. The author of the project is always accompanied by a kind of servant. Meanwhile, two years earlier, an American civil servant meets with an elderly French couple who had fought in the Resistance during World War II, brokering a deal with a Hollywood director to buy the rights to tell their story. The members of the old couple's family discuss heatedly questions of nation, memory and history.

t31996.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t31996.director: エルンスト・ルビッチ
t31996.synopsis_en: At a department store in the French resort of Riviera, American businessman Michael Brandon (Gary Cooper) insists on buying only the top half of a pair of pajamas. Conveniently appearing to take just the bottoms is Nicole (Claudette Colbert), the daughter of a poor aristocrat. Instantly smitten by her spirited nature, Brandon pursues her relentlessly and secures an engagement. However, on their wedding day, Nicole discovers Brandon has been married seven times and flies into a rage. They manage to marry only on the condition that Brandon pays Nicole a huge alimony if they divorce. Naturally, the relationship fails, and frustrated by his wife's indifference, Brandon resorts to a desperate measure.
t31996.tmdb_overview_en: American multi-millionaire Michael Brandon marries his eighth wife, Nicole, the daughter of a broke French Marquis. But she doesn't want to be only a number in the line of his ex-wives and undertakes her own strategy to tame him.
t31996.tmdb_overview_jp: フランスの避暑地リヴィエラのデパートで、パジャマの上だけを買いたいと店員に迫るアメリカ人実業家マイケル･ブランドン(ゲイリー・クーパー)。そこに都合よく「パジャマの下だけ貰うわ」と現れたのが貧乏貴族の娘ニコル(クローデット・コルベール)。気の強い彼女に一目惚れしたブランドンは猛アタックの末、婚約にこぎつける。ところが結婚式当日、ブランドンになんと7回の結婚歴があると知りニコルは激怒。離婚の際には莫大な慰謝料をニコルに支払うことを結婚の条件として、二人はどうにか夫婦となる。当然このような関係はうまくいかず、妻に相手にされないことに業を煮やしたブランドンはある手段に出る。

t61650.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t61650.synopsis_en: Set in the ruins of post-war Berlin, this film depicts a romantic rivalry involving a playboy American officer. An American female politician heading to Germany is entrusted by a woman with a gift for Captain Pringle. The woman is one of the captain's girlfriends, but upon receiving it, he immediately trades it for a mattress on the black market—so he can flirt with a German woman he has a crush on. Marlene Dietrich plays a Nazi singer, and composer Frederick Hollander, who handled the music, appears as a pianist.
t61650.tmdb_overview_en: In occupied Berlin, an army captain is torn between an ex-Nazi café singer and the US congresswoman investigating her.

t996.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t996.synopsis_en: An early work by Billy Wilder and a masterpiece of film noir suspense. Insurance salesman Walter is approached by a married woman who wants to take out an accident insurance policy on her husband without his knowledge. Sensing something amiss, he initially refuses, but captivated by the beautiful wife, he descends into becoming an accomplice in the husband's murder. The murder scene creates indirect realism by holding on the expressions of those present. The supporting characters surrounding the pair are also superb.
t996.tmdb_overview_en: An insurance representative is seduced by a dissatisfied housewife into a scheme of insurance fraud and murder that arouses the suspicion of his colleague, a claims investigator.
t996.tmdb_overview_jp: 完璧な計画の元に保険金殺人を実行した男女。だが思わぬ落とし穴が彼らを待ち受けていた……。ビリー・ワイルダー監督の初期の作品で、人間が陥りやすい暗部をじっくりと描いている。

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t368006.tmdb_overview_en: Scientist turned Entrepreneur Dr. Sethuraman tries to safeguard his newly invented time travel device from falling into the hands of his Evil Twin Brother Aathreya.

t47536.movie_title: アドルフ・ヒトラー／最後の10日間
t47536.director: エンニオ・デ・コンチーニ
t47536.tmdb_overview_en: Hitler: The Last Ten Days takes us into the depths of der Furher’s Berlin bunker during his final days. Based on the book by Gerhard Boldt, it provides a bleak look at the goings-on within, and without.

t1272405.movie_title: ギデンズ・コーの功夫
t1272405.movie_title_jp: ギデンズ・コーの功夫
t1272405.clean_title_jp: ギデンズ・コーの功夫
t1272405.synopsis_en: A wuxia fantasy action film directed by Taiwanese director Giddens Ko of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'You Are the Apple of My Eye,' starring Ko Chen-tung, who collaborated with Ko on those two previous films. Director Giddens Ko, also active as a novelist, adapts his own internet-published novel 'Kung Fu' for the screen, weaving in homages to Hong Kong and Taiwanese wuxia films from the 1980s and 90s throughout. Underachieving high school student Yuan Zai and his best friend A Yi encounter a mysterious drifter, Huang Jun, who has awakened from a 500-year slumber. Witnessing Huang Jun's overwhelming martial arts prowess as a kung fu master, Yuan Zai and A Yi become his disciples. Their classmate Yi Jing, on whom Yuan Zai has a secret crush, also joins their training. They soon learn of the centuries-old feud between Huang Jun and his junior disciple Lan Jin, and uncover a momentous secret hidden within 'kung fu' that could shake heaven and earth. Ko Chen-tung plays Yuan Zai, Berant Zhu of 'Black Education' plays A Yi, Wang Jing of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'The Return of the Condor Heroes' plays Yi Jing, veteran actor Tai Li-len plays the mysterious kung fu master Huang Jun, and Liu Kuan-ting of 'The Girl Who Robbed Time' plays Huang Jun's nemesis Lan Jin.
t1272405.tmdb_overview_en: Two loser high school students meet a wandering old man with unparalleled martial arts skills. Together, they not only strive to restore justice to their city but also unravel the mystery of the old man's identity.
t1272405.tmdb_overview_jp: 落ちこぼれ高校生の淵仔(ユエンザイ)と親友の阿義(アイー)は、500年の眠りから目覚め、カンフーの達人だと自称する謎の流れ者・黄駿(ホアン・ジュン)と出会う。圧倒的な武術を目の当たりにした淵仔と阿義は黄駿に弟子入りし、淵仔が密かに想いを寄せる同級生の乙晶(イージン)も彼らの修行に加わる。3人はやがて、500年前から続く黄駿と弟弟子の藍金(ラン・ジン)の確執を知り、さらには〈カンフー〉の裏に天地を揺るがしかねない重大な秘密が隠されていることに気付くが…。

t16664.movie_title: リリイ・シュシュのすべて
t16664.movie_title_jp: リリイ・シュシュのすべて
t16664.clean_title_jp: リリイ・シュシュのすべて
t16664.movie_title_original: リリイ・シュシュのすべて
t16664.synopsis_en: In a provincial city, middle school student Yuichi becomes close with the honor student Hoshino, but a summer trip changes the dynamics among their friends. When the new semester begins, Hoshino defeats the class's worst delinquent in a fight and gradually turns into a tyrant himself. As his actions escalate—assault, shoplifting, and forcing classmates into prostitution—Yuichi, who has become a target of bullying, is also made complicit. Turning his eyes away from reality, Yuichi creates a fan site for his idolized artist, Lily Chou-Chou.
t16664.tmdb_overview_en: Charts the troubled teenage years of students Yūichi Hasumi and Shūsuke Hoshino, exploring the shifting and complex power dynamics of their relationship against the backdrop of Yūichi's love for the dreamy and abstract music of pop star Lily Chou-Chou.
t16664.tmdb_overview_jp: 地方都市。中学生の雄一は優等生の星野と親しくなるが、夏の旅行をきっかけに友人たちの関係は変容する。新学期、クラス一の不良をけんかで倒した星野は、やがて彼自身が暴君と化していく。暴行や万引き、クラスメートに売春させるなど、エスカレートする彼の行動に、いじめの対象となった雄一も荷担させられることに。雄一は現実から目をそらすように、崇拝するアーティスト、リリイ・シュシュのファンサイトを作る。

t109302.movie_title: 打ち上げ花火、下から見るか？横から見るか？
t109302.movie_title_jp: 打ち上げ花火、下から見るか？横から見るか？
t109302.movie_title_en: Fireworks, Should We See It from the Side or the Bottom?
t109302.clean_title_jp: 打ち上げ花火、下から見るか？横から見るか？
t109302.movie_title_original: 打ち上げ花火、下から見るか？横から見るか？
t109302.synopsis_en: Summer vacation. Norimichi, an elementary school student, is invited by his classmate Nazuna—who is set to transfer schools after the summer due to her parents' divorce—to go to the fireworks festival with her that night. However, Nazuna is planning to run away from home, and Norimichi finds himself being dragged along. Meanwhile, Norimichi's friends, including Junichi, have decided to go to the festival to see for themselves whether fireworks look round or flat when viewed from the side. Nazuna remains determined to carry out her plan to run away.
t109302.tmdb_overview_en: One summer day, a group of sixth-grade boys have an argument about whether fireworks are round or flat when viewed from different angles and embark on a journey for the answer during the annual firework festival. Meanwhile, one of their classmates, Nazuna, is troubled by her parents' separation and decides to choose one of the boys to run away with.
t109302.tmdb_overview_jp: 夏休み。小学生のノリミチは、両親の離婚のため、夏休み後に転校が決まった同級生ナズナから今夜の花火大会に一緒に行こうと誘われるが、ナズナは家出しようとしており、ノリミチはそれに付き合わされそうになる。一方、ノリミチの仲間たち、ジュンイチらは、打ち上げ花火が横から見ても丸いのか、それとも平べったいのか、花火大会に行って実際に見て確かめようと決めていた。ナズナは引き続いて家出する決心を固めていた。

t68606.synopsis_en: Kuki, once a sharp editor at a publishing house but now relegated to a dead-end position, meets Rinko, a married woman who teaches calligraphy at a culture center run by a friend, and continues an adulterous affair with her. Their love only deepens, and Kuki eventually rents an apartment in Tokyo to serve as their love nest. But Rinko's husband hires a private detective and learns of her infidelity, while Kuki's wife pressures him for a divorce. Yet the more they are cornered by those around them, the more fiercely Kuki and Rinko's love burns.
t68606.tmdb_overview_en: Kuki is a veteran newspaper reporter who has been shuffled off to a book-development branch and finds escape in an illicit relationship with Rinko. Together they find the passion no longer present in their marriages.
t68606.tmdb_overview_jp: 出版社で敏腕編集者だったが閑職に飛ばされた久木は、友人が勤めるカルチャーセンターで書道の講師をする人妻、凛子と出会い、彼女と不倫の関係を続けている。2人の愛情の深さは増すばかりで、ついに久木は都内にマンションを借り、そこを凛子との愛の巣にするように。だが、凛子の夫は私立探偵を雇って妻の不貞を知り、久木のほうも妻から離婚を迫られる。しかし、周囲に追い込まれていくほど久木と凛子の恋は燃え上がる。

n11：00 - 17：30 ダイヤモンド 私たちの衣装工房.movie_title: 11：00 - 17：30 ダイヤモンド 私たちの衣装工房

t1184854.movie_title: フォー・トレイルズ 限界を超えてゆけ
t1184854.movie_title_jp: フォー・トレイルズ 限界を超えてゆけ
t1184854.clean_title_jp: フォー・トレイルズ 限界を超えてゆけ
t1184854.synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, participants must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles or portable music players, which would be advantageous on the undulating mountain paths. It is an event of extreme physical and mental challenge. This film captures 18 runners who took on the HK4TUC pushing their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong, rarely seen before. The director is Robin Lee, a British director born and raised in Hong Kong. The film began a limited release in Hong Kong at the end of 2024, but word-of-mouth spread rapidly and the number of screens increased sharply. It gained further attention when the major star Chow Yun-fat, known for the 'A Better Tomorrow' series and 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon', highly praised it, saying 'every Hong Kong person should watch it'. Supported not only by sports enthusiasts but also by general film fans, it became the biggest surprise hit of 2025, attracting 150,000 viewers. Additionally, it has won numerous awards, including the Best New Director Award at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, the Audience Award at the 22nd Hong Kong Asian Film Festival, the Recommended Film Award at the 31st Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards, and the Jury Special Award at the 2025 Hong Kong Directors' Guild Awards, earning high praise as a documentary.
t1184854.tmdb_overview_en: Overcoming a mid life crisis, an unlikely character inadvertently creates one of the world's hardest ultramarathons. This intrepid adventure becomes a journey into humanity’s indomitable spirit.
t1184854.tmdb_overview_jp: 香港に存在する4大トレイル・コース（総距離298キロ、獲得標高14,500m）を制限時間以内に走り切らなければならない、という超過酷なイベント【香港フォー・トレイルズ・ウルトラ・チャレンジ】。  60時間以内にゴールした者には「FINISHER(完走者)」、72時間以内の者には「SURVIVOR（生還者）」の称号が与えられるそのレースに出走した18人のランナーたちの極限に挑む姿と、これまで見る機会がほとんどなかった香港の美しい大自然を余すところなく収めた感動のドキュメンタリー。  香港では2024年末、小規模で公開が始まり、瞬く間に口コミが拡がって上映館数が増え、大スター チョウ・ユンファも「すべての香港人が観るべき」と大絶賛。スポーツ愛好者のみならず一般映画ファンにも支持されて15万人を動員する2025年最大のサプライズ・ヒットとなりました。  香港に生まれ育った英国人監督ロビン・リーが2年以上を費やして編集。香港電影金像奨 新人監督賞を受賞、編集賞にもノミネート。観る者は、ランナーたちが繰り広げるドラマに胸を熱くし、やがては香港という街に息づく不屈のエネルギーをも感じることが出来るでしょう。

t461674.movie_title_original: Monkey Business: The Adventures of Curious George's Creators
t461674.synopsis_en: A documentary about Hans and Margret Rey, the couple who created the beloved children's book series "Curious George," cherished worldwide. Hans and Margret, originally from Hamburg, Germany, were living in Paris and creating children's books when they invented the character Curious George, who would become the protagonist of their future bestseller. When World War II began, the Jewish couple fled Paris on bicycles to escape the Nazi invasion, carrying the original illustrations for "Curious George" with them. After the war, they continued their writing careers in New York, protecting the character of George for the rest of their lives. The film portrays their tumultuous lives using a wealth of archival footage, precious original artwork, and handwritten animation. This is the feature-length directorial debut of Ema Yamazaki, acclaimed in Japan and abroad for works like "Elementary School: A Small Society" and "Koshien: Field of Dreams," completed in 2017. It was released in theaters in 2018 as part of the Shinjuku Cinema Qualite special program "Caricolle 2018 / Qualite Fantastic! Cinema Collection 2018." A Japanese dubbed version with narration by Yuuimi Kawai is scheduled for release in 2026.
t461674.tmdb_overview_en: We all know Curious George. But what about his creators, Hans and Margret Rey? From fleeing Nazi Germany on handmade bicycles to encounters with exotic animals in Brazil, the Reys lived lives of adventure that are reflected in the pages on one of the most treasured children’s book series of all time.
t461674.tmdb_overview_jp: 世界中で愛されている絵本「ひとまねこざる」と「おさるのジョージ」シリーズ。その生みの親、ユダヤ人であるハンス・レイとマーガレット・レイ夫妻は、ナチス・ドイツの侵攻を逃れパリからアメリカに移住し、生涯ジョージのキャラクターを守り続けました。二人の波乱万丈な人生を、世界中から集めた膨大なアーカイブ映像と、貴重な原画の数々を織り交ぜ、製作期間3年で15,000枚を描いたという手書きのアニメーションで完成させた、初のドキュメンタリー映画、それが本作『モンキービジネス おさるのジョージ著者の大冒険』です。

nニッポン狂想曲.synopsis_en: Directed by Takafumi Ota, who has tackled social issues head-on in works such as *The House of the Rising Sun* and *Okinawa Rhapsody*, this documentary attempts to uncover the truth behind numerous incidents that shook the world but remain shrouded in mystery. Planned by Professor Emeritus Akira Kimura of Kagoshima University, the film features prominent intellectuals—including Taro Yamamoto, Ukeru Magosaki, Kazuhiro Haraguchi, Peter Kuznick, and Yukio Hatoyama—as they conduct a thorough investigation into subjects such as the assassination of former Prime Minister Abe, the attempted assassination of Donald Trump, the U.S. Capitol attack, the hidden struggles of the Hatoyama administration, the connection and vested interests between the Noto Peninsula earthquake and the Osaka Expo, and the COVID-19 vaccine controversy.

t30036.tmdb_overview_en: A police detective on the take tries to catch his brother's killer.
