t1537860.synopsis: . 監督のシン・チェリンが京都芸術大学映画学科の卒業制作作品として撮影した長編映画。 スタッフ５名（うち２名は主演を兼ねている）のミニマムな体制で試行錯誤を繰り返しつつ作られた作品で、大阪アジアン映画祭で取り上げられ、芳泉文化財団映像（日本映画）〈学部生対象〉研究表彰大賞を受賞する。その後も、第４７回ぴあフィルムフェスティバル、沖縄NICE映画祭などで上映された。 京都芸術大学映画学科の卒業制作作品として撮影された本作。 製作のきっかけは監督のシン・チェリンが同じ学科の同級生であるそらに寄せる「思い」だった。 映画構想段階で、シンは「（被写体が）なぜそらなのか？」というタイトルで次のように綴っている。 … 最初はただ単純にそらが魅力的すぎて撮りたくなった。存在しているだけでキラキラしていて、眩しくて、自由で、美しくて、楽しくて、面白くて。それはそらの外観だけではなく、喋り方、仕草、そらが発する言葉、その言葉の力、すべてが。知れば知るほど彼女は素敵な人だった。そらと一緒にいると自由になる気がする。後ずさりもダンスに見えるのではないかと思うくらい。 いきなり電話が鳴って出るとそらだった。すぐ会う予定だったからある程度喋ってから「じゃまた後でね！」と言ったら、そらは今は音楽聴くよりリンの声を聞きたいと言った。ある愛はこういう風に始まった。あるいは6秒間目を合わせたという理由で、同じバンドが好きだという理由で、ストッキングに穴が空いたという理由で、なぜか相手の髪を撫でたくなるという理由で、頬のニキビが可愛いと思えた理由で、たまに度数の高いメガネをかけるという理由で。このように愛が始まる過程は偶然で、類型の限界がなく不可だ。 愛の幅を測ることができると信じていた。「私をどれくらい愛してる？」と聞かれたら、腕を広げて、「하늘만큼 땅만큼!（空の広さくらい、地面の広さくらい！）」と答えた。しかし、愛は空でも地面でもなかった。ほかに比べられる物はなかった。それを私は「そら」に出会ってやっと気づくことができた。 … . .
t1537860.synopsis_en: A feature film directed, planned, and starring Korean-born filmmaker Shin Chae-rin, created as her graduation project from the Kyoto University of Arts Film Department. Shot with a minimal production setup and incorporating documentary elements, it was screened at various film festivals, including being an invited work at the 21st Osaka Asian Film Festival and selected for the 47th Pia Film Festival. Rin, who came to Kyoto from Seoul, and Sora, who came to Kyoto from Okinawa, meet at university and aspire to make films. They give form to the impulses and desires that arise in their daily lives through the act of 'making a film.' Their relationship, which seeks to know each other through actions like sending jam sandwiches flying into the sky or tracing roots in Okinawa, continues to change. Shin Chae-rin plays Rin, and Sora Itami from Okinawa plays Sora, both also participating in the production. The film was made by a small team of five staff members, including the two actresses.
t1537860.tmdb_overview_en: "Hey Rin, let’s send a jam sandwich to space." Rin came to Kyoto from Seoul, and Sola came to Kyoto from Okinawa. They met at university and have since pursued filmmaking together. They like having fun and they like filming funny things and laughing together. They want to fly a jam sandwich. They want to shoplift a film camera. They want to trace Sora's family roots in Okinawa. The two sublimate their desires to filmmaking. For the two, film is like a magic wand. They transform it into all kinds of genres and put themselves in it. The two desire to know each other, but never compromise and, instead, accept their uncertain identities just to have the greatest conversation.

t604427.movie_title_jp: はじまりの記憶　杉本博司

t604427.synopsis: 国内外で多数の賞を受賞している世界的な写真家で美術家の杉本博司に初めて長期密着したドキュメンタリー。杉本が在住するニューヨークをはじめ、日本、南仏、シドニーと国境を超えて創作活動を行う杉本の現場に密着。杉本の素顔や目指すものを明らかにしていく。2010年にWOWOWで放送された「はじまりの記憶　現代美術作家・杉本博司」に新撮映像を加え、新たに劇場版として完成させた。
t604427.synopsis_en: A documentary that provides the first long-term, in-depth look at Hiroshi Sugimoto, a world-renowned photographer and artist who has won numerous awards in Japan and abroad. The film follows Sugimoto as he works across borders, from his home base in New York to Japan, the South of France, and Sydney. It reveals his true character and what he strives for in his art. Originally broadcast on WOWOW in 2010 as "The Memory of Origins: Contemporary Artist Hiroshi Sugimoto," this theatrical version incorporates newly filmed footage.
t604427.tmdb_overview_en: This documentary follows 200 days in the life of contemporary artist Hiroshi Sugimoto— a leading presence in the world of modern art. He is the winner of many prestigious awards and his photographs are sold for millions of yen at overseas auctions. The film shows the sites of the Architecture series shot in southern France, the huge installation art work at 17th Biennale of Sydney, his new work Mathematics at Provence, his art studio while working on Lightning Fields, and more. It thoroughly pursues the question Sugimoto's works pose - "living in modern times, what are these works trying to tell us?" A thrilling look into the world of Hiroshi Sugimoto.

t39871.synopsis_en: Billy Wilder's second directorial work, which was never theatrically released in Japan. This was his highly anticipated first Hollywood film, successfully casting the era's star Ginger Rogers. To save money on train fare to Iowa, Susan disguises herself as a 12-year-old girl. A faint affection begins to blossom between her and Colonel Philip, who happens to be on the same train... Although the film touches on the theme of attraction to a minor, it was produced 12 years before the publication of the bestselling novel "Lolita."
t39871.tmdb_overview_en: Low on funds, working-class girl Susan Applegate disguises herself as a youngster in order to pay half fare home. But little 'Sue Sue' finds herself in a whole heap of grownup trouble when she hides out in a compartment with handsome Major Philip Kirby.

t599.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t599.synopsis_en: A film that synchronizes two eras: the silent era of Hollywood, the movie capital, and the 1950s. Billy Wilder stated his intention: 'I wanted to make a film about Hollywood, set in Hollywood.' Unsuccessful screenwriter Gillis stumbles into the home of Norma, a great silent film star. She longs for a comeback to the glamorous world and asks Gillis to polish her script, but... Gloria Swanson's tense performance as Norma is superb. Cecil B. DeMille, known for directing 'Cleopatra' and others, appears as himself.
t599.tmdb_overview_en: A hack screenwriter writes a screenplay for a former silent film star who has faded into Hollywood obscurity.
t599.tmdb_overview_jp: ハリウッドの売れない脚本家ジョー・ギリスはある日、借金取りに追われて逃げ込んだ屋敷で、隠居生活を送る往年の大女優ノーマ・デズモンドと出会う。彼女から脚本の執筆を依頼されたジョーは、住み込みで働き始めるが、やがて生活の全てを束縛されてゆく…。

nみんなのヴァカンス.synopsis: 「女っ気なし」「やさしい人」などのギョーム・ブラック監督が、南フランスの風光明媚な景色の中で夏のバカンスを謳歌する若者たちの姿を優しいまなざしでつづった青春映画。 夏の夜のセーヌ川のほとり。不器用な青年フェリックスはアルマに恋をし、夢のような時間を過ごす。しかし翌朝、アルマは家族とバカンスへ旅立ってしまう。フェリックスは優しい親友シェリフや相乗りアプリで知り合った生真面目な青年エドゥアールとともに、アルマを追って南フランスの田舎町ディーを目指すが……。 2017年製作の「7月の物語」に続いてブラック監督がフランス国立高等演劇学校の学生たちと制作した作品で、俳優には長編映画初出演の学生たちを起用。2020年・第70回ベルリン国際映画祭パノラマ部門で国際映画批評家連盟賞特別賞を受賞した。
nみんなのヴァカンス.synopsis_en: A youth film directed by Guillaume Brac, known for 'A Summer's Tale' and 'The Gentle Ones,' which tenderly follows young people enjoying their summer vacation amidst the scenic beauty of Southern France. On a summer night by the Seine, the awkward young man Félix falls in love with Alma and spends a dreamlike time with her. However, the next morning, Alma leaves for vacation with her family. Félix, along with his kind best friend Sheriff and the earnest young man Édouard he met through a ride-sharing app, sets off to chase after Alma to the small rural town of Die in Southern France... Following his 2017 film 'July Tales,' Brac made this work with students from the National Academy of Dramatic Arts in France, casting students appearing in their first feature film. It won the Special Prize of the International Federation of Film Critics in the Panorama section of the 70th Berlin International Film Festival in 2020.

t76721.synopsis: 原作は手塚治虫の「ぼくの孫悟空」。手塚はキャラクター設定やストーリーボードを手がけ、念願のアニメーション制作に初めて携わった。準備段階で離脱したものの、手塚が志向した現代的な作風は随所に活かされている。石ノ森章太郎と月岡貞夫が手塚の助手として参加し、原画の一部も担った月岡は作画のスピードと表現力で周囲を驚かせた。
t76721.synopsis_en: A rousing entertainment masterpiece based on Osamu Tezuka's "My Son Goku," bringing together the energy of young artists during the first golden age of Toei Animation. It is noteworthy that Osamu Tezuka himself took the lead in drawing the storyboards, and the on-site staff included a large number of talented individuals who would later carry the future of Japan's animation industry. In other words, it is one of the origins of Japanese animated films, a monumental work that greatly envisioned the future of the medium from an entertainment perspective. Winner of the Special Grand Prize at the Venice International Children's Film Festival.
t76721.tmdb_overview_en: A monkey king who learns the secrets of magic goes on a spree and causes no end of aggravation for the gods, who finally imprison him. In order to make up for all the trouble he's caused, he is sent on a mission to accompany a prince who is the son of the gods on a journey through a land filled with dangers, monsters, cannibals and demons.
t76721.tmdb_overview_jp: 手塚治虫の「ぼくの孫悟空」をベースに、東映動画初期一回目の黄金時代に若い芸術家たちのエネルギーが結集した 痛快娯楽大作。ストーリーボードを手塚治虫自信陣頭に立って描き、また現場のスタッ フには、のちにわが国のアニメーション界を背負うことになる優秀な人材が大挙参加してい るというのも見過ごせない。いわば日本のアニメーション映画の原点のひとつ、娯楽的側面 でその将来を大き く展望させた記念碑的作品。ヴェネチア国際児童映画祭特別大賞

t84480.movie_title_jp: わんぱく王子の大蛇退治
t84480.movie_title_en: The Little Prince and the Eight-Headed Dragon
t84480.clean_title_jp: わんぱく王子の大蛇退治
t84480.movie_title_original: わんぱく王子の大蛇退治
t84480.synopsis: 美術の小山礼司が平面性を重視したキャラクター造形と背景美術を提案し、日本神話の幻想的な世界が創造された。新東宝の助監督だった芹川有吾の初演出作で、森康二が作画監督を務めた。作画監督は絵柄の統一を図る重要な役職であり、本作以降、日本のアニメーションに定着していく。大塚康生と月岡貞夫が作画に半年を費やした大蛇退治の見せ場は、傑出したカメラワークとアクションで知られる。
t84480.synopsis_en: The sixth feature-length anime from Toei Animation, this adventure fantasy humorously explores Japanese mythology. In the age of the gods long ago, Prince Susanoo, born to Izanagi and Izanami, enjoys happy days on Onogoro Island. One day, his mother Izanami dies. Unable to accept her death, Susanoo sets out with a rabbit named Akahana on a journey to Yomi-no-Kuni, the land of the dead where his mother is said to be. After adventures in the Night Land ruled by his brother Tsukuyomi and Takamagahara ruled by his sister Amaterasu, Susanoo arrives in Izumo Province. There, to save the princess Kushinada, he decides to fight the Yamata-no-Orochi. This was the directorial debut of Yugo Serikawa, later known for the 'Cyborg 009' series, with original animation direction by Koji Mori. The Orochi battle scene, which took Yasuo Otsuka and Sadao Tsukioka six months to complete, is celebrated as one of the greatest moments in Japanese animation history. The music was composed by Akira Ifukube, known for 'Godzilla'.
t84480.tmdb_overview_en: In this influential cult-classic animated film based on Japanese folklore, Susano is the youngest son of Izanagi and Izanami, the heavenly couple who created the Earth. Still a young boy, Susano is devastated by the passing away of his mother. Determined to find her despite the reprimands of his father, he embarks on a journey to find his brother and his sister for spiritual guidance.
t84480.tmdb_overview_jp: わんぱく王子・スサノオ少年が、そそっかしい兎のアカハナや大男のタイタンボウをお供に、幻想の島・オノゴロ島から海底の夜オス国、火の国、天の国・タカマガ原などを巡り、不思議な冒険を繰り広げ、最後に、ヤマタノオロチと壮絶な空中戦を展開した末にこれを退治し、美少女・クシナダ姫を救うのであった。

t926281.tmdb_overview_en: Two soon-to-be kamikaze pilots stop by a local school near their base to play the piano one last time, leaving a deep impression on a teacher.  Years later, she seeks out the relatives of the pilots when the piano is old and about to be discarded.

t263557.movie_title: 日本の熱い日々 謀殺・下山事件
t263557.movie_title_jp: 日本の熱い日々 謀殺・下山事件
t263557.clean_title_jp: 日本の熱い日々 謀殺・下山事件

t263557.tmdb_overview_en: The president of the Japanese National Railways is found dead during a period in which train service is plagued by numerous layoffs, strikes and shutdowns. The government says that the president was murdered; the police claim it was a suicide. A quizzical reporter follows the case for years, but the basic question remains unanswered: was the victim killed by members of the burgeoning Communist movement in Japan, or was the death stage-managed by the authorities in hopes of discrediting the Communists?

t47794.director: クロード・シャブロル
t47794.synopsis_en: A police inspector from the Montreal Police Department solves a murder case using clues obtained from the victim's diary.
t47794.tmdb_overview_en: A Montreal police inspector cracks a murder case with clues from the victim's diary.
t47794.tmdb_overview_jp: モントリオール警察の警部が、被害者の日記から得た手がかりをもとに殺人事件を解決する。

t57238.synopsis_en: Director Morita Yoshimitsu, known for '39 Criminal Law Article 39,' adapts the novel of the same name by Kishi Yusuke, which won the 4th Japan Horror Novel Award. Wakatsuki Shinji, who works at an insurance company, encounters the hanged body of a woman's son when he visits her home to explain insurance payouts. The police rule it a suicide, and the insurance money is paid out accordingly. However, sensing something suspicious in the parents' attitude, Wakatsuki begins his own investigation, doubting the suicide verdict. Gradually, the couple's abnormal behavior concerning the insurance money comes to light.
t57238.tmdb_overview_en: A timid insurance agent investigates a possible insurance fraud case that involves a death. As the facts are slowly revealed, he becomes progressively more frightened.
t57238.tmdb_overview_jp: 第4回日本ホラー小説大賞を受賞した貴志祐介の同名小説を『39　刑法第三十九条』の森田芳光監督が映画化。保険会社に勤める若槻慎二は保険金の説明に訪れた女性の家でその女性の息子の首吊り死体に遭遇する。警察は自殺と判断し、それに基づいて保険金も支払われることになった。しかし、両親の態度に不審なものを感じた若槻は自殺に疑問を感じひとり調査を開始する。そして、夫婦の保険金をめぐる異常な行動が次第に明らかになっていく。

t73990.movie_title: 『戦国自衛隊』４Ｋデジタル修復版
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t73990.synopsis_en: Led by Lieutenant Yoshiaki Iba, 21 members of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force, armed with modern weapons, suddenly time-slip along with their supply depot to the Sengoku period while en route to an exercise. As they stand bewildered, Nagao Heizo Kagetora arrives with his retainers to meet them. Upon first seeing Iba, Kagetora takes an instant liking to him, calling him "a kindred spirit," and is drawn to their unfamiliar clothing and weapons, hoping to recruit them. Iba and his soldiers struggle to accept the reality of their time slip. However, after encountering Kagetora and being attacked by guerrilla forces of a rival feudal lord—resulting in a comrade's death—and witnessing Kagetora's battle firsthand, they are forced to come to terms with having arrived in the Sengoku period.
t73990.tmdb_overview_en: A squadron of Japanese Self-Defense Force soldiers find themselves transported through time to their country's warring states era, when rival samurai clans were battling to become the supreme Shogun.
t73990.tmdb_overview_jp: 伊庭義明三尉を隊長とする、近代武器で武装した21名の陸上自衛隊員は、演習に参加するための移動時に突然、補給地ごと戦国時代にタイムスリップしてしまった。戸惑っている彼らに長尾平三景虎が家来と共に会いに来た。景虎は伊庭と初めて会った瞬間「同族じゃ」と気に入り、異なる服装・武器に惹かれ、仲間にしたいと考える。タイムスリップした現実を安易に受け入れられなかった伊庭と自衛隊員たち。しかし景虎らに遭遇し、景虎と敵対する戦国大名のゲリラ軍に襲撃され仲間が死亡。そして景虎の戦を目の当たりにしたことで、戦国時代に来てしまったことを否応なしに受け入れていく。

n夜来風雨の声五十嵐耕平監督特集上映.movie_title: 夜来風雨の声五十嵐耕平監督特集上映
n夜来風雨の声五十嵐耕平監督特集上映.movie_title_jp: 夜来風雨の声五十嵐耕平監督特集上映
n夜来風雨の声五十嵐耕平監督特集上映.director: 五十嵐耕平、ダミアン・マニヴェル ©2017 MLD Films

t579974.synopsis: 日本でも大きな話題を集め、ロングランヒットとなった「バーフバリ」シリーズのS・S・ラージャマウリ監督が、英国植民地時代の激動のインドを舞台に、2人の男の友情と使命がぶつかり合う様を豪快に描くアクションエンタテインメント。 1920年、英国植民地時代のインド。英国軍にさらわれた幼い少女を救うため立ち上がったビームと、大義のため英国政府の警察となったラーマ。それぞれに熱い思いを胸に秘めた2人は敵対する立場にあったが、互いの素性を知らずに、運命に導かれるように出会い、無二の親友となる。しかし、ある事件をきっかけに、2人は友情か使命かの選択を迫られることになる。 「バードシャー　テルグの皇帝」のN・T・ラーマ・ラオ・Jr.がビーム、ラージャマウリ監督の「マガディーラ　勇者転生」にも主演したラーム・チャランがラーマを演じた。タイトルの「RRR」（読み：アール・アール・アール）は、「Rise（蜂起）」「Roar（咆哮）」「Revolt（反乱）」の頭文字に由来する。日本で公開されたインド映画で史上初めて興行収入10億円を超えるヒットを記録。劇中の楽曲「ナートゥ・ナートゥ（Naatu Naatu）」も話題となり、第95回アカデミー賞でインド映画史上初となる歌曲賞受賞を果たした。
t579974.synopsis_en: From S.S. Rajamouli, director of the "Baahubali" series, which was a huge hit and had a long theatrical run in Japan, comes this spectacular action entertainment set in the turbulent era of British colonial India, depicting the clash of friendship and duty between two men. In 1920, during British rule in India, Bheem rises to save a young girl kidnapped by the British army, while Rama becomes a police officer for the British government for a greater cause. Though they are on opposing sides, driven by their own passionate beliefs, fate brings them together without knowing each other's true identities, and they become inseparable friends. However, an incident forces them to choose between friendship and their missions. N.T. Rama Rao Jr., known for "Baadshah," plays Bheem, and Ram Charan, who starred in Rajamouli's "Magadheera," plays Rama. The title "RRR" is derived from the initials of "Rise," "Roar," and "Revolt." It became the first Indian film to gross over 1 billion yen at the Japanese box office. The song "Naatu Naatu" also became a sensation, winning the Academy Award for Best Original Song at the 95th Academy Awards, a first for an Indian film.
t579974.tmdb_overview_en: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.
t579974.tmdb_overview_jp: 舞台は1920年、英国植民地時代のインド。英国軍にさらわれた幼い少女を救うため、立ち上がるビーム。大義のため英国政府の警察となるラーマ。熱い思いを胸に秘めた男たちが運命に導かれて出会い、唯一無二の親友となる。しかし、ある事件をきっかけに究極の選択を迫られることに。彼らが選ぶのは、友情か？使命か？

t811941.synopsis: 「RRR」のNTR・Jr.が主演を務めた海洋バトルエンタテインメント。 1996年、クリケット・ワールドカップを前に厳戒態勢のインド警察本部に、巨大犯罪組織による破壊工作の情報が入った。特別捜査班のシヴァムは犯罪組織のリーダーを追い、南インドのラトナギリへ向かう。ラトナギリの「赤海」と呼ばれる地域を縄張りとする4つの村からなる集落は、凶悪な密輸団の巣窟として恐れられていた。情報を得るため密輸業者に成りすましたシヴァムは長老シンガッパから、12年前に始まった凄惨な抗争事件と、赤海の英雄デーヴァラとその息子ヴァラの血塗られた伝説を聞く。 NTR・Jr.が伝説の英雄デーヴァラと息子ヴァラを1人2役で演じ、デーヴァラの宿敵バイラ役で「ヴィクラムとヴェーダ」のサイーフ・アリー・カーン、ヒロイン役で「グンジャン・サクセナ　夢にはばたいて」のジャーンビー・カプールが共演。「MIRCHI ミルチ」「ジャナタ・ガレージ」のコラターラ・シバが監督・脚本を手がけた。
t811941.synopsis_en: A sea battle entertainment film starring NTR Jr. from "RRR." In 1996, on the eve of the Cricket World Cup, the Indian police headquarters, under high alert, receives intelligence about a sabotage plot by a massive criminal organization. Special investigation officer Shivam pursues the organization's leader to Ratnagiri in South India. A settlement of four villages in the region known as the "Red Sea" is feared as a den of vicious smugglers. Disguising himself as a smuggler to gather information, Shivam learns from the elder Singappa about a brutal conflict that began 12 years ago and the bloody legend of the Red Sea's hero, Devaraj, and his son Vara. NTR Jr. plays dual roles as the legendary hero Devaraj and his son Vara. Saif Ali Khan from "Vikram Vedha" plays Devaraj's nemesis Bhaira, and Janhvi Kapoor from "Gunjan Saxena: The Kargil Girl" plays the heroine. The film is directed and written by Koratala Siva, known for "Mirchi" and "Janatha Garage."
t811941.tmdb_overview_en: Devara, a fearless man from a coastal region, embarks on a perilous journey into the treacherous world of the sea to safeguard the lives of his people. Unbeknownst to him, his brother Bhaira is plotting a conspiracy against him. As events unfold, Devara passes on his legacy to his mild-mannered and timid son, Varada.

t1109086.movie_title: WAR バトル・オブ・フェイト
t1109086.movie_title_jp: WAR バトル・オブ・フェイト
t1109086.director: アヤーン・ムカルジー
t1109086.synopsis: インドで大ヒットを記録した2019年製作のスパイアクション「WAR ウォー!!」のシリーズ第2作で、「PATHAAN パターン」「タイガー」シリーズと世界観を共有する「YRF（ヤシュ・ラージ・フィルムズ）スパイ・ユニバース」シリーズの1作。世界を舞台に繰り広げられる2人の男の宿命の戦いを、壮大なスケールで描く。 かつて国家を裏切り姿を消した伝説のスパイ・カビールは、いまやインド最大の脅威へと変貌を遂げていた。誰も止めることのできない存在となったカビールを倒す切り札として、政府はインド軍の精鋭ヴィクラムを差し向ける。ある出来事によりすべてを失ったヴィクラムは、カビールの抹殺という唯一の使命に突き動かされていた。しかしその戦いは、いつしか任務からカビール個人への復讐と化していく。 「WAR ウォー!!」に登場した伝説のエージェント、カビールをリティク・ローシャンが引き続き演じ、彼と壮絶な戦いを繰り広げる軍人ヴィクラム役で「RRR」のN・T・ラーマ・ラオ・Jr.がYRFスパイ・ユニバースに初参戦。「ブラフマーストラ」のアヤーン・ムカルジー監督がメガホンをとった。
t1109086.synopsis_en: The second installment in the series following the 2019 Indian spy action blockbuster "War," this is part of the YRF Spy Universe, which shares a world with the "Pathaan" and "Tiger" series. It depicts the fateful battle between two men on a grand, global scale. Kabir, a legendary spy who once betrayed the nation and disappeared, has now transformed into India's greatest threat. To stop the unstoppable Kabir, the government deploys Vikram, an elite Indian army officer. Having lost everything due to a certain incident, Vikram is driven by the sole mission of eliminating Kabir. However, the battle soon turns from a mission into a personal vendetta against Kabir. Hrithik Roshan reprises his role as the legendary agent Kabir from "War," and N.T. Rama Rao Jr. from "RRR" makes his debut in the YRF Spy Universe as the soldier Vikram, who engages in a fierce battle with him. The film is directed by Ayan Mukerji, known for "Brahmastra."
t1109086.tmdb_overview_en: Years ago Agent Kabir went rogue, became India’s greatest villain ever.  As he descends further into the deepest shadows... India sends its deadliest, most lethal agent after him, Agent Vikram  A Special Units Officer who is more than Kabir’s equal and a relentless Terminator driven by his own demons, determined to put a bullet into Kabir’s skull.

t507148.movie_title: 書かれた顔 4Kレストア版
t507148.director: ダニエル・シュミット
t507148.synopsis: 歌舞伎役者・坂東玉三郎に迫り、女形の存在を通して、虚構としての日本の伝統的女性像を浮かびあがらせる。虚構と現実を交ぜ、幻想的に描く異色作。
t507148.synopsis_en: This film approaches Kabuki actor Bandō Tamasaburō and, through the existence of the onnagata (female-role specialist), brings into relief a traditional Japanese feminine ideal as a construct of fiction. An unconventional work that blends fiction and reality and depicts its subject in a fantastical manner.
t507148.tmdb_overview_en: In Japanese theater, women's roles are traditionally played by men. The man playing the woman's role, the Onnagata, does not imitate the woman, as in the West, but tries to capture her significance. He need not stick close to his model, but draws far more from his own identity - a shift of value takes place, which is nonetheless not a step beyond. THE WRITTEN FACE is an attempt to offer an insight into the Japanese Kabuki star Tamasaburo Bando, one of the last defenders of this ancient and disappearing performing tradition.

n父と家族とわたしのこと.movie_title: 父と家族とわたしのこと
n父と家族とわたしのこと.movie_title_jp: 父と家族とわたしのこと
n父と家族とわたしのこと.synopsis: 家族を傷つけた父や祖父には戦争への従軍という共通点があった。戦争トラウマを題材に受け継がれた痛みと向き合う人々の姿を見つめたドキュメント。
n父と家族とわたしのこと.synopsis_en:
A documentary that quietly observes people confronting inherited pain through the lens of war trauma. In recent years, the fact that many returning soldiers suffered from severe PTSD has increasingly come to light. The deep scars etched into their hearts are sometimes passed down to children and grandchildren in the form of domestic violence or addiction, leading to the breakdown of family relationships. 

The film follows three individuals: a woman who grew up suffering severe abuse from her father and went on to abuse her own daughter; a man whose childhood memories of his veteran father’s verbal abuse toward his mother left deep scars that eventually led to violence against his own wife; and a woman who developed complex PTSD due to abuse from her mother—who was devoted to a new religious movement—and who continues to struggle with her relationship with her own daughter. As the investigation delves into the roots of the "difficulty in living" shared by these three, a common thread emerges: their fathers or grandfathers all served in the war. 

The film is directed by Hyoma Shimada, who has documented individuals striving to stand on their own feet while being at the mercy of massive forces like war and national division in works such as "I'm Just Going to North Korea for a Bit" and "Live, Live, Live." The music was composed by Takashi Watanabe, known for "The Great Passage."

n拳銃 兵士の休暇.synopsis: 「マスター　先生が来る！」「レオ　ブラッディ・スウィート」などで知られるインド・タミル語映画界のスター、ビジャイが2012年に主演を務めたクライムアクション。 ムンバイ在住のタミル人で、軍人としてカシミールで勤務しているジャガディーシュは、帰省中にバスを狙った爆弾テロに遭遇する。独自に調査を進めた彼は、より大規模な同時多発テロ計画の糸口をつかみ、同僚たちとともにテロを未然に防ごうと行動を開始する。やがてジャガディーシュは、敵の司令官との間で息詰まる策略戦を繰り広げる。 「カッティ　刃物と水道管」「サルカール 1票の革命」で知られるA・R・ムルガダース監督とビジャイが最初にタッグを組んだ作品。インドでは2012年の公開時、同年のタミル語作品で最大のヒットを記録し、数々の映画賞を受賞した。
n拳銃 兵士の休暇.synopsis_en: Vijay, a star of the Indian Tamil-language film industry known for films like "Master" and "Leo: Bloody Sweet," stars in this 2012 crime action film. Jagadish, a Tamilian living in Mumbai who serves as a soldier in Kashmir, encounters a bomb attack targeting a bus while home on leave. Investigating on his own, he uncovers clues to a larger, coordinated terrorist plot and, along with his colleagues, takes action to prevent it. Jagadish soon finds himself in a tense battle of wits against the enemy commander. This is the first collaboration between Vijay and director A.R. Murugadoss, known for "Kaththi" and "Sarkar." Upon its release in India in 2012, it became the highest-grossing Tamil film of that year and won numerous awards.

t155596.synopsis: 「人間の條件」「切腹」の名匠・小林正樹監督が、戦後日本の進路を決定づけたともいえる極東軍事裁判・通称「東京裁判」の記録を、膨大な映像群からまとめあげた4時間37分におよぶ歴史的ドキュメンタリー。第2次世界大戦後の昭和23年、東京・市ヶ谷にある旧陸軍省参謀本部で「極東国際軍事裁判」、俗にいう「東京裁判」が開廷。その模様は、アメリカ国防総省（ペンタゴン）による第2次世界大戦の記録として撮影され、密かに保管されていた。50万フィートにも及んだ記録フィルムは25年後に解禁され、その中には、法廷の様子のみならず、ヨーロッパ戦線や日中戦争、太平洋戦争などの記録も収められていた。それらの膨大なフィルムを中心に、戦前のニュース映画や諸外国のフィルムも交え、小林監督のもと5年の歳月をかけて編集、製作。戦後世界の原点をひも解いていく。1983年製作・公開。2019年には、監督補佐・脚本の小笠原清らの監修のもとで修復された4Kデジタルリマスター版が公開される。
t155596.synopsis_en: A feature-length documentary that records the proceedings of the International Military Tribunal for the Far East, which determined the course of Japan's future after its defeat in the Pacific War. Released 25 years after the trial, it was edited over a five-year period from over 500,000 feet of film footage provided by the U.S. Department of Defense.
t155596.tmdb_overview_en: A look at the trial of Japanese militarists accused of war crimes; from the proceedings of the International Military Tribunal (May 1946–November 1948). It took two days to read the charges against the 100 alleged war criminals in the docket (only 28 top officials are actually in the small courtroom), and the final judgment took one week to read.
t155596.tmdb_overview_jp: 太平洋戦争敗戦後の日本の進路を運命づけた極東国際軍事裁判の模様を記録し、裁判から25年後に公開されたアメリカ国防総省の50万フィートにも及ぶ長大なフィルムを、5年の歳月をかけて編集して製作した長編ドキュメンタリー映画。

n日本鬼子（リーベン・クイズ） 日中15年戦争・元皇軍兵士の告白.movie_title: 日本鬼子（リーベン・クイズ）　日中15年戦争・元皇軍兵士の告白
n日本鬼子（リーベン・クイズ） 日中15年戦争・元皇軍兵士の告白.movie_title_jp: 日本鬼子（リーベン・クイズ）　日中15年戦争・元皇軍兵士の告白
n日本鬼子（リーベン・クイズ） 日中15年戦争・元皇軍兵士の告白.synopsis: 1931年の満州事変から15年間に及んだ日中戦争で、中国に対する侵略行為の実行者となった元日本軍兵士14人を取材し、彼らが行った加害行為の告白を記録したドキュメンタリー。生体解剖や細菌実験を繰り返した軍医、731部隊隊員や、自らの功績や名誉のために拷問と大量処刑を行った憲兵、上級者の下級者に対する私的制裁によって日本軍特有の軍隊機構を叩き込まれ、人間性を喪失した兵士たち。生い立ちや学歴、職業、軍隊での経歴も様々な証言者たちが、人間の行いうる狂気のような行為と弱さ、そして本当の戦争を伝えたいという痛切な思いから、彼ら自身が行った壮絶な事実を語る。2001年製作・公開。19年8月には、東京・シアター・イメージフォーラムにてDCP版でリバイバル上映。
n日本鬼子（リーベン・クイズ） 日中15年戦争・元皇軍兵士の告白.synopsis_en: This documentary interviews 14 former Japanese soldiers who carried out acts of aggression against China during the 15-year Sino-Japanese War, which began with the Manchurian Incident in 1931, and records their confessions of the atrocities they committed. The interviewees include military doctors and Unit 731 members who repeatedly performed vivisections and bacterial experiments, military police who conducted torture and mass executions for their own achievements and honor, and soldiers who were drilled into the Japanese military's unique structure through private punishment of lower ranks by superiors, losing their humanity. These witnesses, with diverse upbringings, educations, occupations, and military careers, speak of the horrific facts they themselves carried out, driven by a poignant desire to convey the madness-like acts humans are capable of, their weaknesses, and the true nature of war. Produced and released in 2001. A DCP version was re-screened at Theater Image Forum in Tokyo in August 2019.

t1580374.synopsis_en: A mystery drama based on the acclaimed novel by best-selling author Kanae Minato, considered her magnum opus, directed by Takahisa Zeze ('The Last 10 Years', 'Those Who Were Not Protected'). Shinomiya Mayuko fulfills her grandmother's expectations and becomes a teacher despite her complicated family background. One day, her student Saeki Akiko receives a letter from someone claiming to be 'Me, 20 years from now'. Half-doubtful, Akiko writes back, enduring the grief of losing her father and the lonely days with her withdrawn mother. But violence from her mother's boyfriend, bullying, and an unbelievable truth push her to the edge. In deep despair, Akiko and her only friend Arisa hatch a forbidden plan: 'kill the parents'. Mayuko tries to save Akiko, reaching out even as she herself is crushed by society's injustices. Yuna Kuroshima plays Mayuko, the teacher who tries to support children despite her own complicated past. Nanami Yamazaki plays Akiko, the girl struggling to survive harsh reality. Tori Matsuzaka and Kitagawa Keiko play Akiko's parents Ryota and Fumino. Ryuta Bando plays Mayuko's lover Haruki Yuki. Kanata Hosoda and Hana Kondo play Hirota Higuchi and Shinju Morimoto, who deeply influence the lives of Mayuko and Akiko.
t1580374.tmdb_overview_en: Akiko, a girl living a hard life after her father passes away and her mother's new boyfriend turns abusive, starts receiving encouraging letters from her 30-year-old-future self. Akiko also starts to get bullied in school, and her teacher Shinomiya tries to help her, but ends up losing her job. Akiko also unearths a story written to her by her father, telling her how he originally met her mother, who was the abused daughter of a politician.
t1580374.tmdb_overview_jp: 複雑な家庭環境で育ちながらも、祖母の期待に応えて教師になるという夢を叶えた真唯子。  彼女の教え子・章子のもとにある日、一通の手紙が届く。差出人は――「20年後のわたし」。  半信半疑のまま返事を書くことで、父を亡くした悲しみや、心を閉ざした母との孤独な日々に耐えていた章子だが、 母の新しい恋人からの暴力、壮絶ないじめ、そして信じがたい事実が彼女を容赦なく追い詰めていく。 深い絶望の中、章子は唯一心を通わせる友人・亜里沙と「親を殺す」という禁断の計画を立てるのだった。  そんな章子を救おうと真唯子は、残酷な現実と社会の理不尽さに押しつぶされそうになりながら、 それでも手を差し伸べようとするが――。  誰もが過酷な運命に吞み込まれようとする中で、 「未来のわたし」からの手紙が導くのは、希望か。それとも、さらなる絶望か――。

nカルロス・カイザー サッカー史上最も奇妙な成功者.movie_title: カルロス・カイザー サッカー史上最も奇妙な成功者
nカルロス・カイザー サッカー史上最も奇妙な成功者.movie_title_jp: カルロス・カイザー サッカー史上最も奇妙な成功者
nカルロス・カイザー サッカー史上最も奇妙な成功者.synopsis_en: A documentary exploring the life of Carlos Henrique Raposo, known as "Kaiser," who was dubbed "the greatest footballer who never played football." In the 1980s and 90s, before information was readily available on the internet, Kaiser, despite being a poor footballer, used his cunning conversational skills and connections to continually secure contracts with Brazilian and foreign clubs, building a career as a professional player. Once signed, he would consistently avoid playing in official matches by faking injuries or causing trouble during training. He further deceived those around him for years by using fake mobile phones to simulate offers from overseas clubs and agents. After ending his 26-year career in 2003, Kaiser began telling his story in 2010, but astonishingly, no coach, player, or reporter had ever exposed his lies. The film recounts Kaiser's many anecdotes through testimonies from Kaiser himself and football figures from that era, along with archival footage, photographs, and reenactments. The director is British documentary filmmaker Louis Myles.

t43877.program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
t43877.synopsis: かいせつ 電話交換手のアヤ子(山田)は、横領疑惑で失業した父の借金を肩代わりする約束で妻子持ちの会社社長と愛人契約を結ぶが…。溝口が戦前に撮った傑作の１本とされ、活気ある大阪の街並みも、山田のモダンなファッションも見物。
t43877.synopsis_en: Synopsis: Ayako (Yamada), a telephone operator, enters into a lover's contract with a married company president to cover her father's debts after he loses his job due to embezzlement suspicions... Considered one of Mizoguchi's masterpieces from before the war, the lively streets of Osaka and Yamada's modern fashion are also highlights.
t43877.tmdb_overview_en: Ayako becomes the mistress of her boss in order to pay her father's debt and prevent him from going to prison for embezzlement.

t85844.program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
t85844.synopsis: かいせつ 敗戦直後の大阪の焼け跡で、娼婦となって生きる女たちの凄まじい生き様を描く。田中と盟友・溝口による数々の名作の中でも、溝口の冷徹な演出と、街娼に身を落とす戦争未亡人役の田中の熱演が鮮烈な印象を残す衝撃作。
t85844.synopsis_en: Synopsis: A shocking work depicting the fierce struggle for survival of women who become prostitutes in the burnt-out ruins of Osaka immediately after Japan's defeat. Among the many masterpieces by Tanaka and her ally Mizoguchi, this film leaves a vivid impression with Mizoguchi's cold-hearted direction and Tanaka's passionate performance as a war widow forced into street prostitution.
t85844.tmdb_overview_en: In early post-war Osaka, three women—war widow Fusako, her Korean expat sister Natsuko, and Kumiko, Fusako's sister-in-law—descend into prostitution, all for their individual reasons.
t85844.tmdb_overview_jp: 敗戦後の大阪。結核で息子を失った大和田和子のもとに、夫の訃報がもたらされる。和子は会社社長の栗山の秘書となった。和子の妹の夏子はダンサーをしながら和子を捜しており、二人は偶然心斎橋で再会。夏子は和子のアパートで暮らすことになった。和子は栗山に身を任せていたが、ある日、栗山と夏子の関係に気づく。和子は男に復讐するため、アパートを出て売春婦になった。和子を捜すため心斎橋近辺を歩いていた夏子は、売春婦と間違われ警察に検挙されてしまう。

t45993.program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
t45993.synopsis: かいせつ 京都・島原遊郭の老舗置屋“井筒屋”を営む母に、破談で傷つき帰郷した娘は強く反発する…。母と娘の葛藤を軸に、花街で生きるしかない女たちの悲哀を描いた名作。戦前から長く溝口映画を支えた水谷浩の美術も圧巻。
t45993.synopsis_en: A commentary: A daughter returns to Kyoto's Shimabara pleasure district, wounded after a broken engagement, and strongly resists her mother, who runs the long-established geisha house "Izutsuya." This masterpiece centers on the mother-daughter conflict, portraying the sorrow of women who have no choice but to live in the flower and willow world. The art direction by Hiroshi Mizutani, who long supported Mizoguchi's films from before the war, is also stunning.
t45993.tmdb_overview_en: After living a traumatic experience in Tokyo, Yukiko returns to Kyoto, where Hatsuko, her mother, runs a brothel, which upsets Yukiko very much.
t45993.tmdb_overview_jp: 東京でトラウマを抱えた雪子は、母・初子が遊郭を経営する京都に戻る。

t45987.program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
t45987.synopsis: かいせつ 貴族に代わり武士が台頭した平安末期、平清盛は様々な苦難に直面し…。出生の秘密に悩む“人間”清盛を、溝口が圧倒的なスケールで描く歴史劇。デビュー間もない雷蔵が若き清盛を颯爽と演じ、濃艶な母親役の木暮も忘れ難い。
t45987.synopsis_en: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.
t45987.tmdb_overview_en: Japan, 1137. The Taira family, a samurai clan, becomes involved in the disputes between Emperor Toba and the monks of Mount Hiei.
t45987.tmdb_overview_jp: 日本、1137年。鳥羽天皇と比叡山の僧との争いに巻き込まれた武士、平氏。

t26868.movie_title: 『野性の証明』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t26868.synopsis_en: A massacre occurs deep in the Tohoku mountains, killing most of a village's residents. A self-defense force special unit member, Misawa, who was training in the mountains, happens upon the scene, kills the perpetrator, and rescues the sole survivor—a village girl named Yoriko. Later, after retiring, Misawa adopts Yoriko and works as an insurance salesperson. One day, he rescues a female journalist named Tomoko from an attacker, but she is being targeted because she tried to expose the corruption of a local businessman, Oba. Meanwhile, Detective Kitano, who suspects Misawa of being the massacre killer, continues to shadow him.
t26868.tmdb_overview_en: Special forces officer Ajisawa leaves his paramilitary group to take care of his newly-adopted daughter, Yoriko: the sole survival of a bloodbath for which he is responsible. Years later, Ajisawa is forced to return to the scene of the tragedy for his new job as a claims adjuster where he is subsequently arrested for his suspected involvement. But the threat of jail time is the least of his worries as his former organization comes gunning for him.
t26868.tmdb_overview_jp: 東北奥地で村民のほとんどが殺される虐殺事件が発生。山中で訓練をしていた自衛隊特殊部隊の味沢は偶然そこに居合わせて犯人を殺し、唯一生き残った村の少女・頼子を救う。やがて退職した味沢は頼子を養女にし、保険外交員として暮らす。そんなある日、彼は暴漢に襲われた女性記者・朋子を救うが、彼女は町を牛耳る実業家・大場の不正を暴こうとしたために命を狙われていた。一方、味沢には彼を虐殺犯と疑う北野刑事が付きまとう。

t326598.synopsis_en: Shizuka Mita is a 20-year-old woman who works hard to become an actress as a trainee at the theater troupe "Sea." Moriguchi, a 26-year-old former troupe member now working at a real estate agency, first notices sincere Shizuka in a park. Shizuka prepares for the lead role audition in the troupe's next production, "The Tragedy of W," but her peer Kaori lands the part, and Shizuka is assigned a minor role with only a single line at the beginning of the story. Downcast after failing the audition, Moriguchi confides in her about his own psychological struggles as an actor. He then proposes marriage on the condition that she never becomes a star, and conversely promises to send a large bouquet to her dressing room as a farewell if she succeeds as an actress.
t326598.tmdb_overview_en: A young theatre actress fights for her uncertain career while having to confront the personal sacrifices that will arise from it.
t326598.tmdb_overview_jp: 三田静香は劇団「海」の研究生で、女優になるために努力を重ねる20歳の女性。そんな真摯な静香を公園で見初めた森口は元劇団員の26歳、今は不動産屋の社員をしている。静香は劇団の次回公演『Wの悲劇』の主役選考オーディションに臨むが、同期のかおりが役を射止め、静香は物語の冒頭でひとことだけ台詞のある端役を担当することになった。オーディションに落ちて落ち込む静香に、森口は俳優時代の心理的な苦悩を語る。そして、森口は、静香がスターになれなかったらという条件で結婚を申し込み、反対に静香が役者として成功した場合はサヨナラの意味も込めて楽屋に大きな花束を贈ることを約束する。

t472745.tmdb_overview_en: The heavens declare the glory of God! This amazing video from the Creation Museum highlights the beauty and majesty of God’s awe-inspiring handiwork throughout the seemingly endless universe.  This compilation DVD contains the following eight programs:  Natural Laws Building Blocks A Habitable Planet DNA Plants Sun Solar System Stars

t1047020.movie_title: ユマカウンティの行き止まり
t1047020.movie_title_jp: ユマカウンティの行き止まり
t1047020.movie_title_en: The Last Stop in Yuma County
t1047020.clean_title_jp: ユマカウンティの行き止まり
t1047020.movie_title_original: The Last Stop in Yuma County
t1047020.synopsis_en: The feature-length debut of up-and-coming director Francis Galluppi, this black comedy crime thriller depicts a series of unpredictable worst-case scenarios unfolding at a desert diner. In the 1970s, in the desert region of Yuma County, Arizona. A salesman visits a diner that serves as the last gas station. When the fuel truck doesn't arrive on time, the salesman passes the time chatting with a waitress. A vicious bank robber shows up, taking the salesman and waitress hostage. However, because there's no gasoline, the bank robber can't leave the diner either. Unaware of the situation, a steady stream of quirky customers arrives at the diner: an elderly couple, an Indian chief, a hapless sheriff, and a couple aspiring to be criminals. Jim Cummings of "The Thunder Road" plays the salesman, Jocelin Donahue of "The House of the Devil" plays the waitress, and Richard Brake of "Barbarian" plays the bank robber. The film won the Best Picture award in the ORBITA section at the 2023 Sitges International Film Festival, which selects the best thrillers, suspense, and action films, earning high praise.
t1047020.tmdb_overview_en: While awaiting the next fuel truck at a middle-of-nowhere Arizona rest stop, a traveling young knife salesman is thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two similarly stranded bank robbers with no qualms about using cruelty—or cold, hard steel—to protect their bloodstained, ill-gotten fortune.
t1047020.tmdb_overview_jp: 1970 年代、ユマ郡の砂漠地帯。最後の給油所であるダイナーの戸をセールスマンが叩いた。定刻になっても給油車が来ないのだ。セールスマンはウェイトレスと話しながら時間を潰す。 そこに現れたのは、凶悪な銀行強盗。  セールスマンとウェイトレスは人質となってしまう。だがガソリンがないので銀行強盗もダイナーから出られない。そんな状況も知らずに次々とクセありの面々がダイナーを訪れる。老夫婦、インディアンのチーフ、頼りない保安官、そして犯罪者を目指すカップル…。はたしてセールスマンとウェイトレスは無事に生還できるのか！？

n泳ぎすぎた夜五十嵐耕平監督特集上映.movie_title: 泳ぎすぎた夜五十嵐耕平監督特集上映
n泳ぎすぎた夜五十嵐耕平監督特集上映.movie_title_jp: 泳ぎすぎた夜五十嵐耕平監督特集上映
n泳ぎすぎた夜五十嵐耕平監督特集上映.director: 五十嵐耕平、ダミアン・マニヴェル ©2017 MLD Films

t38804.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t38804.synopsis_en: A musical film sprinkled with comedic elements, including a parody of trademarked dogs and Freudian psychoanalysis of a dog. An American phonograph salesman arrives in Vienna. His rare phonograph is mistaken for a bomb, and he falls in love at first sight with an aristocrat's daughter, dragging his pet dog into a series of mishaps. Bing Crosby's expansive singing voice is a delight to hear. However, this became Billy Wilder's only musical film, as he later said he lacked the talent to make musicals.
t38804.tmdb_overview_en: A brash American gramophone salesman tries to get Emperor Franz Joseph's endorsement in turn-of-the-century Austria.

t743563.director: ローケーシュ・カナガラージ
t743563.synopsis: インドの国民的スター俳優カマル・ハーサンが製作・主演を務め、「JAWAN ジャワーン」のビジャイ・セードゥパティと「プシュパ　覚醒」のファハド・ファーシルと共演したクライムアクション。麻薬組織のボスと無職の中年男性、特殊工作員が繰り広げる三つどもえの戦いを壮絶なアクションで描く。 チェンナイで覆面姿の集団による3件の連続テロ事件が発生。特殊工作員アマルは、街のギャングを牛耳る麻薬王サンダナムが事件に関与していると考える。一方、サンダナムは縄張り内で消えた2トンものコカイン原料を探していた。捜査を進めていくうちに、アマルは2番目に殺害された無職の男カルナンのことが妙に気になりはじめる。カルナンには警察官である義理の息子がいたが、彼も同じテロリストたちに殺されていた。 「マスター　先生が来る！」「囚人ディリ」のローケーシュ・カナガラージが監督・脚本を手がけ、インド映画界で活躍する双子のスタントマン、アンバリブ（アンブマニ＆アリブマニ）がアクション監督を担当。
t743563.synopsis_en: A crime action film produced by and starring Indian national star Kamal Haasan, alongside Vijay Sethupathi from "Jawan" and Fahadh Faasil from "Pushpa: The Rise." It depicts a three-way battle between a drug cartel boss, an unemployed middle-aged man, and a special agent through intense action sequences. Three consecutive terrorist attacks by masked groups occur in Chennai. Special agent Amar suspects Sandhanam, the drug lord who controls the city's gangs, is involved. Meanwhile, Sandhanam is searching for two tons of missing cocaine base that vanished from his territory. As the investigation progresses, Amar becomes strangely preoccupied with Karnan, an unemployed man who was the second victim. Karnan had a police officer son-in-law, who was also killed by the same terrorists. Directed and written by Lokesh Kanagaraj, known for "Master" and "Kaithi," with action choreography by the twin stuntmen Anbariv (Anbumani & Arivumani) active in the Indian film industry.
t743563.tmdb_overview_en: Amar is assigned to investigate a case of serial killings. When Amar investigates the case, he realizes it is not what it seems to be and following down this path will lead to nothing but war between everyone involved.

t105224.synopsis: 1972年、中国から2頭のパンダが贈呈され、日本は空前のパンダブームに湧いた。その渦中で公開された本作は、クマの国の王子であるパンダのロンロンが、王となるべく数々の試練に挑む成長譚である。作画監督は、東映魔女っ子シリーズで多くのキャラクターデザインを手がけた高橋信也。森康二が参加した最後の東映動画作品でもある。
t105224.synopsis_en: In 1972, two pandas were gifted from China, and Japan was swept by an unprecedented panda boom. Released amid that frenzy, this film is a coming-of-age tale of Ron Ron, a panda prince of the Bear Kingdom, who faces numerous trials to become king. The animation director was Nobuya Takahashi, who designed many characters in the Toei Magical Girl series. It is also the last Toei Animation film in which Koji Mori participated.
t105224.tmdb_overview_en: A young panda prince is found unworthy by his mother the Queen, and expelled from the forest. In his journey, he battles dangerous enemies and gets captures and forced to work in a circus.
t105224.tmdb_overview_jp: ロンロンはクマの国の王子として生まれたが、どこでどう間違ったのかパンダであった。しかし、王子であることには変わりない。しっかりして将来の王者にふさわしい勇気と力を持って欲しいと願う母の女王クマの期待に反して、甘えん坊で弱虫とまるで見込みなし。王子としてふさわしいかどうかのテストにも失敗して、とうとうクマの国から追い出されてしまった。泣く泣く山を下っていくロンロン。ひそかに王位を狙うヒグマのデモンは、これ幸いとばかりロンロンを亡きものにするためポン太にその後を追わせた。町に出たロンロンは、一緒のピンチ共々捕まってサーカスに入れられてしまう。変な服を着せられ、厳しく芸を仕込まれるロンロン。ポン太がそのサーカスのカーテンに火をつけた。燃え上がるテント。助けを求める動物たちの声に、ロンロンは燃えるテントの中に飛び込んだ。

n’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪の大反乱／.movie_title: ’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪の大反乱／ドラゴンボール 神龍の伝説／キン肉マン 正義超人VS戦士超人）
n’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪の大反乱／.movie_title_jp: ’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪の大反乱／ドラゴンボール 神龍の伝説／キン肉マン 正義超人VS戦士超人）
n’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪の大反乱／.synopsis: 1963年に一部劇場で『わんわん忠臣蔵』にTVアニメ「狼少年ケン」の再編集版を併映したことを契機に、春夏を基本として年２回のアニメ、特撮などの子供向け作品をまとめた興行が定着した。名称は変遷があるものの1969年春以降は「東映まんがまつり」に固定され、1990年春以降は特撮を分離し「東映アニメまつり」「東映アニメフェア」として開催された。1986年12月の「’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり」はアニメ作品のみで構成される。「ゲゲゲの鬼太郎」はTVアニメ第3作の劇場版で妖怪が怪気象を使って国会議事堂を占拠する物語で、劇中に水木しげる夫妻が登場する。「ドラゴンボール」はTVアニメ本篇とパラレルストーリーとなる劇場版1作目。「キン肉マン」は劇場版7作目で唯一のスタンダードサイズとなる。
n’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪の大反乱／.synopsis_en: Beginning in 1963 when a re-edited version of the TV anime "Wolf Boy Ken" was screened alongside "Wanwan Chushingura" at some theaters, screenings that bundled children's works such as anime and special effects films became established, held twice a year in spring and summer. Though the name changed over time, it was fixed as "Toei Manga Matsuri" from spring 1969, and from spring 1990, special effects works were separated, and it was held as "Toei Anime Matsuri" and "Toei Anime Fair." The December 1986 "'87 Otoshidama Toei Manga Matsuri" consisted solely of anime works. "GeGeGe no Kitaro" is a theatrical version of the third TV anime series, telling the story of yokai using strange weather to occupy the National Diet Building, with Shigeru Mizuki and his wife appearing in the film. "Dragon Ball" is the first theatrical film, set as a parallel story to the TV anime. "Kinnikuman" is the seventh theatrical film and the only one in standard (4:3) format.

t318650.tmdb_overview_en: Richio, a young DJ, is as emotionally non-existent as no other man on the planet. He uses his tough exterior to avoid attachments to people and society.

t89800.tmdb_overview_en: 13-year-old Sachiko is about to encounter the most difficult moments in her young life. Her father abandons her and her mother attempts to commit suicide by slashing her wrist. Her teacher, whom she relies on heavily, leaves for northern Japan to take another job. Other students start to gossip about Sachiko and her former teacher. Sachiko then drops out of school and attempts to find herself.

t95240.movie_title: エリ・エリ・レマ・サバクタニ
t95240.movie_title_jp: エリ・エリ・レマ・サバクタニ
t95240.movie_title_en: My God, My God, Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?
t95240.clean_title_jp: エリ・エリ・レマ・サバクタニ
t95240.movie_title_original: エリ・エリ・レマ・サバクタニ
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t95240.tmdb_overview_en: A.D. 2015: A virus spreads in many cities globally, a suicidal disease infected by pictures. Once infected, the diseased will soon meet death. They have no way of fighting back, filled with fear and despair. The media calls it the 'Lemming Syndrome'.

t9696.synopsis_en: A violent action film based on the popular manga of the same name by Hideo Yamamoto, directed by Takashi Miike. Set in a yakuza apartment building in Shinjuku's Kabukicho district, it depicts a surreal battle between insane men with thorough violence. The boss of the Anjo-gumi yakuza group, based in Kabukicho, suddenly disappears. Kakihara, a masochist who loved the violence given by the boss, persistently searches the city. Eventually, he learns of a hitman named Ichi, and upon witnessing his deranged killing style, feels an excitement akin to love. Tadanobu Asano plays Kakihara, with bleached hair and a face full of scars, and Nao Omori plays Ichi, a weak-willed man who turns into a crying killing machine. The cast includes Shinya Tsukamoto, Suzuki Matsuo, SABU, and Jun Kunimura. The screenplay is by Sakichi Sato, known for 'The Golden Grasslands.' A 4K remastered version will be re-released in May 2026.
t9696.tmdb_overview_en: As sadomasochistic yakuza enforcer Kakihara searches for his missing boss he comes across Ichi, a repressed and psychotic killer who may be able to inflict levels of pain that Kakihara has only dreamed of.
t9696.tmdb_overview_jp: 暴力、セックス、ドラッグ、殺しが蔓延る多国籍街・歌舞伎町。その一角にあるヤクザマンションと呼ばれるビルに事務所を構える安生組の組長が、組の資金3億円と共に姿を消した。若頭・垣原は組長捜しに乗り出すが、その時既に組長はヤクザ壊滅を企む謎の手配師・ジジイによってマインドコントロールされた、靴の踵に仕込んだ鉈を武器とする泣き虫の殺し屋・イチに殺されていた。そのことを突き止めた垣原は、組長の仇を討つべく手下の高山や会長・中沢、イチに過去の自分を投影する鉄砲玉の金子、双子のサド刑事・二郎と三郎、敵対する組の船鬼や鈴木ら周囲を巻き込んでイチ捜しを開始。だが、実は究極のマゾである彼の目的は、やがてイチの無情な殺戮方法に対する興味へと移行していく。そして、遂にイチを捜し出した垣原は、イチに痛めつけられる期待に胸を膨らませるのであったが、肝腎のイチは不甲斐なく彼の期待に応えてはくれなかった。そこで、絶望した垣原は自らの耳に針を刺し自分を痛めつけると、イチに倒される妄想を見ながら投身自殺するのであった。

t26886.synopsis: 「CURE」「カリスマ」など話題作が続く黒沢清監督の「回路」（00）以来2年振りの新作。TV「サトラレ」などで人気のオダギリジョー、浅野忠信、藤竜也の3人が初共演。工場で働く雄二が、唯一心を許せる存在は同僚の守だけ。しかし、守はある日、大切に育てていたクラゲを雄二に残して、突然、姿を消す。呆然とする雄二の前に、守の父親が現れ、雄二は彼とともに暮らすようになる。
t26886.synopsis_en: Yuji Nimura spends a quiet, monotonous daily life with his coworker Mamoru Arida at the same moist towel factory. Yuji is reckless and struggles to get along with others. Seeing this, Mamoru one day proposes two signals that only the two of them can understand and tries to enforce them. Around that time, Yuji begins to take an interest in the highly venomous 'sea wasp' jellyfish that Mamoru keeps. One day, Mamoru entrusts the jellyfish to Yuji and suddenly disappears. Mamoru is imprisoned as a suspect in the murder of the factory owner and his wife. From then on, Yuji, though bewildered, begins caring for the jellyfish as if possessed by something.
t26886.tmdb_overview_en: Buddies working at an oshibori factory bond over an uncontrollable rage neither can control, as well as a strange jellyfish they keep as a pet.
t26886.tmdb_overview_jp: 仁村雄二は、同じおしぼり工場で働く同僚・有田守と公私ともに淡々とした日常を過ごしている。雄二は他人と上手く渡り合えず無鉄砲な性格。そんな彼を見兼ねた守はある日、彼ら2人だけしか分からない2つのサインを提案し、それを徹底させようとする。その頃から雄二は守が飼っている猛毒の“アカクラゲ”に興味を示すようになった。ある時、守はそのクラゲを雄二に託して突然姿を消す。守は工場の社長夫妻殺害の容疑者として収監されていた。以来、雄二は戸惑いながらも、何かに取り憑かれたようにクラゲの世話を始める。

t109291.tmdb_overview_en: The lives of a young cop, a sanitation worker and a brooding pharmacist violently intersect on a bus that's hijacked by a suicidal political flunky, then cross paths again months later.

t19044.tmdb_overview_en: Live-action adaptation of a madcap manga about art, opposites, love and a whole lot of cosplay.

t47578.movie_title: 『里見八犬伝』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t47578.synopsis_en: Kinji Fukasaku directs this adaptation of Toshio Kamata's legendary novel "Shin Satomi Hakkenden," a fresh take on Bakin Takizawa's classic "Nanso Satomi Hakkenden." Starring the glamorous duo Hiroko Yakushimaru and Hiroyuki Sanada, it became a massive hit characteristic of Kadokawa Films, which dominated the era and breathed new life into Japanese cinema. Tamazusa, who once married into the Hikita domain and indulged in debauchery and tyranny before being destroyed by the Satomi clan, returns as a demon queen to exact revenge. She orders her son Motofuji Hikita and his retainers to attack the Satomi's Tateyama Castle. The Satomi clan is annihilated, but Princess Shizu and a few retainers escape, pursued by Tamazusa's forces. The eight warriors, each possessing a jewel inscribed with one of the virtues—benevolence, righteousness, propriety, wisdom, loyalty, faith, filial piety, and brotherly love—scattered from Princess Fuse's body, live their separate lives. Guided by fate, they gather around Princess Shizu and rise to battle, aiming to crush Tamazusa's ambitions.
t47578.tmdb_overview_en: The evil Hikita clan rises from the dead to fulfill a curse on the Satomi clan by restoring the face of their warlord by using the skin of Princess Shizu. In the process of trying to capture her, the clan murders her entire family, but Princess Shizu escapes their clutches. She enlists the aid of eight samurai warriors, possessors of powerful magic crystal, led by Dosetsu (Sonny Chiba!) to help rescue the remaining members of her court and revenge her family. Along the way, they must fight undead warriors, evil spirits, poisonous beauties and a giant centipede.
t47578.tmdb_overview_jp: 滝沢馬琴の「南総里見八犬伝」に新解釈を加えた鎌田敏夫の伝奇小説「新・里見八犬伝」を、薬師丸ひろ子と真田広之の豪華共演で、深作欣二監督が映画化。当時一世を風靡し、日本映画界に新風を吹き込んでいた角川映画ならではの魅力的な大ヒット作となった。 かつて素藤の父に輿入れし蟇田領で酒池肉林と暴虐の限りを尽くした玉梓 (たまづさ) は、里見家に討ち滅ぼされた怨念を晴らすために妖怪の首領として蘇えり、息子の蟇田素藤 (ひきたもとふじ) と家来に命じ、里見家の館山城に攻め入った。里見家は滅ぼされ、静姫と一部の家来は生き延びるが、玉梓の追手が迫ってくる。伏姫の体から飛び散った、仁・義・礼・智・忠・信・孝・悌の各字を刻んだ八つの霊玉を持った八剣士は、それぞれの立場で生きていた。やがて彼らは運命に導かれ、静姫のもとに集まり、玉梓の野望を砕くため、戦いを挑む。

t43963.movie_title: 『蘇える金狼』４Ｋデジタル修復版
t43963.movie_title_en: The Resurrection of the Golden Wolf
t43963.synopsis_en: Legendary popular actor Yusaku Matsuda stars as a lone wolf with two faces—a salaryman and an outlaw—in this hit Kadokawa action film based on the novel of the same name by Haruhiko Oyabu, which was a huge success upon its release. Following his explosive popularity in the pioneering TV drama 'Taiyo ni Hoero!', Matsuda teams up again with director Tohru Murakawa and cinematographer Seizo Sengen—who also worked with him on the 'Game' film series and the drama 'Daitokai PARTII'—to break new ground in domestic hard-action cinema. A must-see film, Matsuda enhanced his wild charisma by experiencing live-fire shooting abroad for his role. Murakawa's signature long-take cinematography brings unique intensity to the gunfight scenes, and the final line is said to be an ad-lib by Matsuda himself, not in the script. Tetsuya Asakura appears to be an ordinary salaryman by day, but by night he trains his body and plots to take over a massive corporation. One day, he uses drugs he obtained to seduce his boss's mistress, Kyoko Nagai. Soon after, he discovers that a man named Sakurai is blackmailing company executives over an embezzlement scandal. Asakura skillfully manipulates Sakurai and the company to successfully become engaged to the president's daughter, Eriko. Meanwhile, burning with jealousy, Kyoko makes a fateful decision.
t43963.tmdb_overview_en: A seemingly run-of-the-mill corporate salaryman leads a double life as a vicious criminal by night. In a delicious scheme of payback, he seeks to dominate the corporation that employs him by day.
t43963.tmdb_overview_jp: 伝説の人気男優、松田優作が、大藪春彦の同名小説を原作に、サラリーマンとアウトローという２つの顔を持つ一匹狼に扮し、公開当時大ヒットした角川映画の人気アクション。先駆けるTV「太陽にほえろ！」などで人気爆発していた松田が、同じ角川映画としては「人間の証明」に続く作品となり、映画「遊戯」シリーズ3本やドラマ「大都会　PARTII」でも組んだ監督・村川透＆撮影・仙元誠三らとチームを組み、国産ハードアクションの新境地を開いた要注目作。役作りのため海外で実銃射撃を経験するなど、俳優・松田はワイルドな魅力を従来よりアップ。銃撃戦の場面では村川監督ならではの長回し撮影も独自の迫力を発揮。ラストシーンのせりふは脚本にない松田自身のアドリブだという。 朝倉哲也は表向きは平凡なサラリーマンだが、夜は身体を鍛えて巨大資本乗っ取りを企んでいる。朝倉はある日、手に入れた麻薬で上司の愛人、永井京子を手なずけた。しばらくして会社幹部達の横領事件をネタに、桜井という男がゆすりに来ていることを突き止めた。朝倉は桜井と会社を巧みに利用して社長令嬢の絵理子と婚約することに成功するが、その一方で嫉妬に燃える京子は、ある決意をしていた。

t125251.synopsis_en: Set in Mukojima, Tokyo, during the Taisho era. Siblings Gen and Aoiro live with their writer father and stepmother. Gen takes care of Aoiro, covering for their sick stepmother, but Aoiro starts hanging out with a bad crowd. They protect each other at times and have big fights at others, living together as siblings, until Aoiro falls ill with tuberculosis.
t125251.tmdb_overview_en: Set in 1926 when Japanese tradition was much stronger, this drama looks at the inner workings of a small family, especially the relationship between a sister and brother.
t125251.tmdb_overview_jp: 大正時代の東京・向島。げんと碧郎の姉弟は、作家の父と継母のもとで暮らしている。げんは病気の継母の分まで碧郎の世話を焼くが、碧郎は不良仲間とつるむように。時にかばいあい、時に大喧嘩をしながら共に生きる姉弟だったが、碧郎は結核に倒れてしまう。

t60216.program_title: ワイルダーならこうする！ ビリー・ワイルダー特集
t60216.synopsis_en: A rare action thriller from Billy Wilder, depicting British soldiers fighting to survive. After the British army suffers defeat at the hands of Rommel's German forces, Corporal Bramble, who escaped death, disguises himself as a hotel waiter who died the previous day and attempts to make contact with German soldiers. Fortunately, the deceased waiter was a German spy, allowing him to leak classified information to the Allies. Erich von Stroheim, a director Wilder had long admired, appears in the role of a general.
t60216.tmdb_overview_en: During the 1942 North African campaign, a British straggler passes as a waiter at the hotel commandeered as Erwin Rommel's headquarters. He has thoughts of assassinating Rommel but his cover may provide an even better use.

t109715.synopsis: 重厚なドラマを求めた東映本社幹部陣により、田中澄江が脚本に招かれた。貴族の姉弟が奴隷に身を落とし、その受難を立身出世によって克服する物語に対し、アニメーターたちは社会の権力構造にあまりに無自覚であると強く反発したが、背景と人物が見事に調和した大和絵のような映像は息を呑む美しさを湛えている。
t109715.synopsis_en: Summoned by Toei's top brass seeking a weighty drama, screenwriter Sumie Tanaka was brought on board. The story follows aristocratic siblings reduced to slavery, overcoming their suffering through social advancement. Animators strongly objected to the narrative's obliviousness to societal power structures, yet the breathtakingly beautiful Yamato-e style visuals, where backgrounds and characters harmonize perfectly, captivate the viewer.
t109715.tmdb_overview_en: After their father quarrels with local military men, Anju and Zushio are forced to flee, but they are captured and sold into slavery. When their mother dies, they are sold to Sansho the Bailiff, a cruel man who subjects them to hideous torments. While Anju falls into a lake and is transformed into a swan, Zushio escapes and after being adopted to a nobleman grows to a young man. He will then fight to defeat the evil Dayu and free all the slaves.
